import RequestProject.Erdos287.PostV64V71.AnalyticFrontier
import RequestProject.Erdos287.PostV64V71.RoughPart
import RequestProject.Erdos287.PostV64V71.SourcePinned
import RequestProject.Erdos287.PostV64V71.ComponentFactorisation

/-!
# Erdős #287 — V67–V71 regression fixtures

**These fixtures verify exact algebra / finite combinatorics only.**  They do **not** establish
any prime-distribution statement, the major-arc asymptotic, a minor-arc bound, or all-`M`
closure.  Finite checks use `decide` / `decide +kernel` (kernel evaluation; no `native_decide`).
-/

open scoped BigOperators

namespace Erdos287.PostV64V71.Fixtures

open Erdos287 Erdos287.PostV64V71

/-! ## `Ξ_H` numerator fingerprint -/

/-- `S_3 = {0, 1, 1/2, 1/3, 3/2, 4/3, 5/6, 11/6}` has 8 distinct values. -/
theorem recipSums_three_card : (recipSums 3).card = 8 := by decide +kernel

/-- `Ξ_2 = 1 · 1 · 3 = 3`. -/
theorem Xi_two : Xi 2 = 3 := by decide +kernel

/-- `Ξ_3 = 1·1·1·3·4·5·11 = 660` (distinct nonzero values; reduced numerators). -/
theorem Xi_three : Xi 3 = 660 := by decide +kernel

/-- `B_3 = 6/1 + 6/2 + 6/3 = 11`. -/
theorem BH_three : BH 3 = 11 := by decide

/-- The integer size bank at `H = 3`: `660 ≤ 11^7`. -/
theorem Xi_three_size : Xi 3 ≤ BH 3 ^ ((recipSums 3).card - 1) := Xi_le_BH_pow 3

/-! ## Good-row emptiness (contrapositive use) -/

/-- `A = {2, 4, 6, 12}` has `∑ 1/a = 1` and contains the multiple `6` of `3`, with
`⌊12/3⌋ = 4`; hence, by `good_large_prime_row_empty`, `3 ∣ Ξ_4`. -/
theorem three_dvd_Xi_four : 3 ∣ Xi 4 := by
  by_contra h
  exact good_large_prime_row_empty {2, 4, 6, 12} 12 4 3 Nat.prime_three
    (by decide) (by decide) (by norm_num [Finset.sum_insert]) (by norm_num) h 6 (by decide)
    (by norm_num)

/-- Independent kernel check of the same divisibility. -/
theorem three_dvd_Xi_four' : 3 ∣ Xi 4 := by decide +kernel

/-! ## Determinant tuples and the subbox dictionary -/

/-- `(k, q, t, r, ε) = (2, 7, 1, 13, 1)`: `2·7 - 1·13 = 1`, `10 < 14 < 15`, so it lies in the
box for `M = 20`, `H = 4` (`y = 5`). -/
theorem tuple_mem_box : ((2, 7, 1, 13, 1) : DTup) ∈ detBox 20 4 := by
  rw [mem_detBox]; norm_num

/-- `det [[2, 1], [13, 7]] = 2·7 - 1·13 = 1`. -/
theorem tuple_det : Matrix.det !![(2 : ℤ), 1; 13, 7] = 1 := by
  rw [det_eq]; norm_num

/-- The subbox dictionary sends `(n, m, k, t) = (14, 13, 2, 1)` to `(2, 7, 1, 13, 1)`. -/
theorem quad_fixture : quadToTup ((14, 13), (2, 1)) = ((2, 7, 1, 13, 1) : DTup) := by
  simp [quadToTup]

theorem quad_fixture_mem : quadToTup ((14, 13), (2, 1)) ∈ detBox 20 8 := by
  refine quadToTup_mem (K := 2) (by norm_num) ?_
  simp only [quadSet, Finset.mem_filter, Finset.mem_product, mem_Iset, Finset.mem_Icc, Adj]
  norm_num

/-- Rough factor ⟺ determinant tuple, on the fixture: `13 ∣ 2·7 - 1`. -/
theorem rough_fixture : (13 : ℤ) ∣ ((2 * 7 : ℕ) : ℤ) - 1 := ⟨1, by norm_num⟩

/-! ## Weighted accounting identities -/

/-- With no exceptions, nothing is deleted: `D_θ^{gg}(∅) = D_θ`. -/
theorem Dgg_empty (M H : ℕ) : Dgg M H ∅ = Dtheta M H := by
  unfold Dgg Dtheta Dw
  congr 1
  exact Finset.filter_true_of_mem fun x _ => ⟨Finset.notMem_empty _, Finset.notMem_empty _⟩

/-- Prime-power contamination fixture: `Λ(4) = log 2` but `θ*(4) = 0`. -/
theorem contamination_fixture : LambdaW 4 = Real.log 2 ∧ thetaStar 4 = 0 := by
  refine ⟨?_, thetaStar_of_not_prime (by decide)⟩
  unfold LambdaW
  rw [show (4 : ℕ) = 2 ^ 2 by norm_num, ArithmeticFunction.vonMangoldt_apply_pow (by norm_num),
    ArithmeticFunction.vonMangoldt_apply_prime Nat.prime_two]
  norm_num

/-- On primes the two weights agree: `Λ(13) = θ*(13)`. -/
theorem prime_weight_fixture : thetaStar 13 = LambdaW 13 := thetaStar_of_prime (by norm_num)

/-! ## Local admissibility / parity -/

/-- `2·1 - 1·1 = 1`; modulo `5 ∤ 2·1` there are exactly two forbidden residues. -/
theorem forbidden_count_five :
    (Finset.univ.filter (fun u : ZMod 5 =>
      (((1 : ℕ) : ZMod 5) * u + ((1 : ℤ) : ZMod 5)) *
        (((2 : ℕ) : ZMod 5) * u + ((1 : ℤ) : ZMod 5)) = 0)).card = 2 := by
  haveI : Fact (Nat.Prime 5) := ⟨by norm_num⟩
  rw [local_forbidden_residue_count 5 (k := 2) (t := 1) (a := 1) (b := 1) (ε := 1) (Or.inl rfl)
    (by norm_num)]
  decide

/-- Direct kernel cross-check of the same count. -/
theorem forbidden_count_five' :
    (Finset.univ.filter (fun u : ZMod 5 => (u + 1) * (2 * u + 1) = 0)).card = 2 := by decide

/-- Parity collapse: modulo `2 ∣ 2·1` there is exactly one forbidden residue. -/
theorem forbidden_count_two :
    (Finset.univ.filter (fun u : ZMod 2 =>
      (((1 : ℕ) : ZMod 2) * u + ((1 : ℤ) : ZMod 2)) *
        (((2 : ℕ) : ZMod 2) * u + ((1 : ℤ) : ZMod 2)) = 0)).card = 1 := by
  haveI : Fact (Nat.Prime 2) := ⟨Nat.prime_two⟩
  rw [local_forbidden_residue_count 2 (k := 2) (t := 1) (a := 1) (b := 1) (ε := 1) (Or.inl rfl)
    (by norm_num)]
  decide

/-- Admissibility of the fixture tuple `2·7 - 1·13 = 1`. -/
theorem admissible_fixture : Nat.Coprime 2 1 ∧ Odd (2 + 1) ∧ (7 : ℕ) ≠ 13 :=
  local_determinant_admissibility (k := 2) (t := 1) (q := 7) (r := 13) (ε := 1) (Or.inl rfl)
    (by norm_num) (by norm_num) (by norm_num) (by norm_num) (by norm_num)

/-- Local factor ratio at `ℓ = 3`: `(3-1)/(3-2) = 2`. -/
theorem local_ratio_three : localDensity 1 3 / localDensity 2 3 = 2 := by
  rw [local_factor_ratio (by norm_num)]; norm_num

/-! ## V67 pinned identity, component factorisation -/

/-- The repair fixture for the literal `D ∣ X(E)` reading. -/
example : ∃ P D Y : ℕ, 0 < Y ∧ Y < 2 * D ∧ (D : ℤ) ∣ (P : ℤ) * ((D : ℤ) - Y) ∧ Y ≠ D :=
  pinned_D_dvd_counterfixture

/-- Immediate arithmetic death: a negative target has no independent solution. -/
example : compCount (fun n => n) {1, 3} (-1) = 0 := compCount_of_neg _ _ (by norm_num)

/-- `{1}` and `{3}` are separated, so `F_{{1,3}} = F_{{1}} · F_{{3}}`. -/
example : compPoly (fun n => n) ({1} ∪ {3}) = compPoly (fun n => n) {1} * compPoly (fun n => n) {3} :=
  compPoly_union _ ⟨by decide, by decide⟩

end Erdos287.PostV64V71.Fixtures

import RequestProject.Erdos287.PostV64V71.SourceRows

/-!
# Erdős #287 — V68/V69 exceptional primes `E_H(M)` and residual denominator `D₂(M)`

**Status: BANK (LEAN PROVED)** for the exact divisibility statements.  The analytic size
estimates (`log Ξ_H < 2M/L⁵`, `log D₂ < 0.872 M / log M`) are **not** proved here; they are
recorded as named propositions in `TailClosure.lean` / `CurrentLedger.lean`.

Convention: `y = ⌊M/H⌋` (natural floor).  For a natural `q`, `q > ⌊M/H⌋ ↔ q > M/H`.

* `exceptionalPrimes M H = {q prime : ⌊M/H⌋ < q ≤ M, q ∣ Ξ_H}` (`E_H(M)`);
* `prod_exceptionalPrimes_dvd_Xi` — `∏_{q∈E_H} q ∣ Ξ_H`;
* `BE M H = ∑_{q∈E_H} log q` and `BE_le_log_Xi` — `B_E ≤ log Ξ_H`;
* `Dlo y M = ∏_{p ≤ y prime} p^{⌊log_p M⌋}`, `D2 M H = Dlo ⌊M/H⌋ M · ∏_{q∈E_H} q`;
* `selected_dvd_D2` — every denominator of a hypothetical counterexample divides `D₂(M)`,
  provided `M < (⌊M/H⌋ + 1)²` (every prime `> M/H` divides each `n ≤ M` at most once).
-/

open scoped BigOperators

namespace Erdos287.PostV64V71

open Erdos287

/-- `E_H(M)`: the exceptional primes `q ∈ (M/H, M]` dividing `Ξ_H`. -/
def exceptionalPrimes (M H : ℕ) : Finset ℕ :=
  (Finset.Ioc (M / H) M).filter (fun q => q.Prime ∧ q ∣ Xi H)

theorem mem_exceptionalPrimes {M H q : ℕ} :
    q ∈ exceptionalPrimes M H ↔ (M / H < q ∧ q ≤ M) ∧ q.Prime ∧ q ∣ Xi H := by
  simp [exceptionalPrimes]

/-- `∏_{q∈E_H} q ∣ Ξ_H`. -/
theorem prod_exceptionalPrimes_dvd_Xi (M H : ℕ) : (∏ q ∈ exceptionalPrimes M H, q) ∣ Xi H := by
  refine Finset.prod_primes_dvd _ (fun q hq => ?_) (fun q hq => ?_)
  · exact (mem_exceptionalPrimes.1 hq).2.1.prime
  · exact (mem_exceptionalPrimes.1 hq).2.2

/-- The exceptional log budget `B_E = ∑_{q∈E_H} log q`. -/
noncomputable def BE (M H : ℕ) : ℝ := ∑ q ∈ exceptionalPrimes M H, Real.log q

theorem BE_nonneg (M H : ℕ) : 0 ≤ BE M H :=
  Finset.sum_nonneg fun q _ => Real.log_natCast_nonneg q

/-- `B_E ≤ log Ξ_H`. -/
theorem BE_le_log_Xi (M H : ℕ) : BE M H ≤ Real.log (Xi H) := by
  have hpos : ∀ q ∈ exceptionalPrimes M H, (q : ℝ) ≠ 0 := fun q hq => by
    have := (mem_exceptionalPrimes.1 hq).2.1.pos; positivity
  have hle : (∏ q ∈ exceptionalPrimes M H, q) ≤ Xi H :=
    Nat.le_of_dvd (Xi_pos H) (prod_exceptionalPrimes_dvd_Xi M H)
  have hprodpos : 0 < (∏ q ∈ exceptionalPrimes M H, (q : ℝ)) :=
    Finset.prod_pos fun q hq => by have := (mem_exceptionalPrimes.1 hq).2.1.pos; positivity
  unfold BE
  rw [← Real.log_prod hpos]
  apply Real.log_le_log hprodpos
  have : ((∏ q ∈ exceptionalPrimes M H, q : ℕ) : ℝ) ≤ (Xi H : ℝ) := by exact_mod_cast hle
  simpa using this

/-- `D_lo(y, M) = ∏_{p ≤ y prime} p^{⌊log_p M⌋}` (all required maximal powers of base primes). -/
def Dlo (y M : ℕ) : ℕ := ∏ p ∈ (Finset.Icc 1 y).filter Nat.Prime, p ^ Nat.log p M

/-- The V68/V69 residual denominator `D₂(M) = D_lo · ∏_{q ∈ E_H(M)} q`. -/
def D2 (M H : ℕ) : ℕ := Dlo (M / H) M * ∏ q ∈ exceptionalPrimes M H, q

/-- `M < (⌊M/H⌋+1)·q` whenever `q > ⌊M/H⌋`. -/
theorem lt_mul_of_div_lt {M H q : ℕ} (hH : 0 < H) (hq : M / H < q) : M < q * H := by
  have := Nat.lt_mul_div_succ M hH
  have h2 : M / H + 1 ≤ q := hq
  calc M < H * (M / H + 1) := this
    _ ≤ H * q := Nat.mul_le_mul_left _ h2
    _ = q * H := mul_comm _ _

namespace Gap2CE

variable (ce : Erdos287.Gap2CE)

/-- **Selected denominators divide `D₂(M)`.**  Assume `H ≥ 1` and `M < (⌊M/H⌋ + 1)²`.  Then
every `n ∈ A` divides `D₂(M)`. -/
theorem selected_dvd_D2 {H : ℕ} (hH : 0 < H) (hy : ce.M < (ce.M / H + 1) ^ 2) :
    ∀ n ∈ ce.A, n ∣ D2 ce.M H := by
  intro n hn
  have hn0 : 0 < n := ce.hpos n hn
  have hnM : n ≤ ce.M := (le_M ce) hn
  rw [Nat.dvd_iff_prime_pow_dvd_dvd]
  intro p k hp hpk
  rcases Nat.eq_zero_or_pos k with rfl | hk
  · simp
  have hpkle : p ^ k ≤ ce.M := le_trans (Nat.le_of_dvd hn0 hpk) hnM
  by_cases hpy : p ≤ ce.M / H
  · -- small prime: `p^k ∣ p^{⌊log_p M⌋} ∣ D_lo`
    have hklog : k ≤ Nat.log p ce.M :=
      Nat.le_log_of_pow_le hp.one_lt hpkle
    have h1 : p ^ k ∣ p ^ Nat.log p ce.M := pow_dvd_pow p hklog
    have h2 : p ^ Nat.log p ce.M ∣ Dlo (ce.M / H) ce.M := by
      unfold Dlo
      apply Finset.dvd_prod_of_mem
      simp only [Finset.mem_filter, Finset.mem_Icc]
      exact ⟨⟨hp.one_lt.le, hpy⟩, hp⟩
    exact dvd_trans (dvd_trans h1 h2) (dvd_mul_right _ _)
  · -- large prime: `k = 1` and `p ∈ E_H`
    push_neg at hpy
    have hk1 : k = 1 := by
      by_contra hk1
      have hk2 : 2 ≤ k := by omega
      have : p ^ 2 ≤ p ^ k := Nat.pow_le_pow_right hp.pos hk2
      have h3 : (ce.M / H + 1) ^ 2 ≤ p ^ 2 := Nat.pow_le_pow_left hpy 2
      omega
    subst hk1
    rw [pow_one] at hpk ⊢
    have hpM : p ≤ ce.M := le_trans (Nat.le_of_dvd hn0 hpk) hnM
    have hpXi : p ∣ Xi H := by
      by_contra hc
      exact (all_good_multiples_omitted ce) hp (lt_mul_of_div_lt hH hpy) hc hpk hn
    have hpE : p ∈ exceptionalPrimes ce.M H := mem_exceptionalPrimes.2 ⟨⟨hpy, hpM⟩, hp, hpXi⟩
    exact dvd_trans (Finset.dvd_prod_of_mem _ hpE) (dvd_mul_left _ _)

end Gap2CE

end Erdos287.PostV64V71

@@BEGIN_FILE bytes=8071 sha256=3ff1a1ad98a554b4654a39aa92c4746ed50d3a1bde5b0b11741647d0db2f86c6 path=LEAN_PROJECT/RequestProject/Erdos287/PostV64V71/RoughPart.lean@@
import RequestProject.Erdos287.PostV64V71.DeterminantBox

/-!
# Erdős #287 — V70 all-multiple neighbour LCM and its rough part

**Status: BANK (LEAN PROVED).**

For an exception set `E` (`y = ⌊M/H⌋`):

* `goodMultiples M H E = {kq : 1 ≤ k ≤ H, y < q ≤ M prime, q ∉ E, M/2 < kq < 3M/4}`;
* `neighbourSet M H E = {kq - 1, kq + 1 : kq ∈ goodMultiples}`;
* `LambdaX M H E = lcm(neighbourSet)` (`Λ_x(M, E)`);
* `roughPrimes`, `roughPart` — the prime factors `r > y` of `Λ_x` and `R_x = ∏ r^{v_r(Λ_x)}`.

Results:

* `factorization_lcm_le` — `v_p(lcm s) ≤ m` if `v_p(n) ≤ m` for all `n ∈ s` (nonzero);
* `roughPrimes_subset_exceptional` — for the actual `E = E_H(M)` of a hypothetical
  counterexample, every rough prime factor of `Λ_x` lies in `E_H` (it divides a *selected*
  forced neighbour, so it cannot be good);
* `roughPart_dvd_Xi` — **`R_x(M, E_H) ∣ Ξ_H`** (assuming `M < (y+1)²`, so `v_r(Λ_x) ≤ 1`);
* `log_roughPart_lt` — conditionally on `log Ξ_H < B`, `log R_x < B`.
-/

open scoped BigOperators

namespace Erdos287.PostV64V71

open Erdos287

/-- Good multiples `kq` (relative to `E`) in the V70 window `M/2 < kq < 3M/4`. -/
def goodMultiples (M H : ℕ) (E : Finset ℕ) : Finset ℕ :=
  ((Finset.Icc 1 H ×ˢ Finset.Ioc (M / H) M).filter
    (fun p => p.2.Prime ∧ p.2 ∉ E ∧ M < 2 * (p.1 * p.2) ∧ 4 * (p.1 * p.2) < 3 * M)).image
    (fun p => p.1 * p.2)

/-- The forced-neighbour set `{kq ± 1}`. -/
def neighbourSet (M H : ℕ) (E : Finset ℕ) : Finset ℕ :=
  (goodMultiples M H E).image (· - 1) ∪ (goodMultiples M H E).image (· + 1)

/-- `Λ_x(M, E) = lcm{kq ± 1}`. -/
def LambdaX (M H : ℕ) (E : Finset ℕ) : ℕ := (neighbourSet M H E).lcm id

/-- The rough primes `r > ⌊M/H⌋` dividing `Λ_x`. -/
def roughPrimes (M H : ℕ) (E : Finset ℕ) : Finset ℕ :=
  (LambdaX M H E).primeFactors.filter (M / H < ·)

/-- The rough part `R_x = ∏_{r ∈ roughPrimes} r^{v_r(Λ_x)}`. -/
def roughPart (M H : ℕ) (E : Finset ℕ) : ℕ :=
  ∏ r ∈ roughPrimes M H E, r ^ (LambdaX M H E).factorization r

theorem mem_goodMultiples {M H : ℕ} {E : Finset ℕ} {n : ℕ} :
    n ∈ goodMultiples M H E ↔ ∃ k q, (1 ≤ k ∧ k ≤ H) ∧ (M / H < q ∧ q ≤ M) ∧ q.Prime ∧ q ∉ E ∧
      M < 2 * (k * q) ∧ 4 * (k * q) < 3 * M ∧ k * q = n := by
  simp only [goodMultiples, Finset.mem_image, Finset.mem_filter, Finset.mem_product,
    Finset.mem_Icc, Finset.mem_Ioc, Prod.exists]
  constructor
  · rintro ⟨k, q, ⟨⟨hk, hq⟩, hp, hE, h1, h2⟩, rfl⟩; exact ⟨k, q, hk, hq, hp, hE, h1, h2, rfl⟩
  · rintro ⟨k, q, hk, hq, hp, hE, h1, h2, rfl⟩; exact ⟨k, q, ⟨⟨hk, hq⟩, hp, hE, h1, h2⟩, rfl⟩

/-- `v_p(lcm s) ≤ m` whenever every (nonzero) `n ∈ s` has `v_p(n) ≤ m`. -/
theorem factorization_lcm_le (s : Finset ℕ) (p m : ℕ) (h0 : ∀ n ∈ s, n ≠ 0)
    (h : ∀ n ∈ s, n.factorization p ≤ m) : (s.lcm id).factorization p ≤ m := by
  classical
  induction s using Finset.induction_on with
  | empty => simp
  | insert a s ha ih =>
    rw [Finset.lcm_insert]
    have ha0 : a ≠ 0 := h0 a (Finset.mem_insert_self a s)
    have hs0 : s.lcm id ≠ 0 := by
      rw [Ne, Finset.lcm_eq_zero_iff]
      intro hz
      exact h0 0 (Finset.mem_insert_of_mem (by simpa using hz)) rfl
    have := Nat.factorization_lcm ha0 hs0
    show (Nat.lcm a (s.lcm id)).factorization p ≤ m
    rw [this, Finsupp.sup_apply]
    exact sup_le (h a (Finset.mem_insert_self a s))
      (ih (fun n hn => h0 n (Finset.mem_insert_of_mem hn))
        (fun n hn => h n (Finset.mem_insert_of_mem hn)))

theorem neighbourSet_pos {M H : ℕ} {E : Finset ℕ} {n : ℕ} (hn : n ∈ neighbourSet M H E) :
    n ≠ 0 := by
  simp only [neighbourSet, Finset.mem_union, Finset.mem_image] at hn
  rcases hn with ⟨m, hm, rfl⟩ | ⟨m, hm, rfl⟩
  · obtain ⟨k, q, -, -, -, -, h1, h2, rfl⟩ := mem_goodMultiples.1 hm
    omega
  · omega

namespace Gap2CE

variable (ce : Erdos287.Gap2CE)

/-- Every forced neighbour (relative to `E_H`) is a selected denominator. -/
theorem neighbourSet_subset_A (hM : 4 ≤ ce.M) {H : ℕ} (hH : 0 < H) :
    neighbourSet ce.M H (exceptionalPrimes ce.M H) ⊆ ce.A := by
  intro n hn
  simp only [neighbourSet, Finset.mem_union, Finset.mem_image] at hn
  have key : ∀ m ∈ goodMultiples ce.M H (exceptionalPrimes ce.M H), m - 1 ∈ ce.A ∧ m + 1 ∈ ce.A := by
    intro m hm
    obtain ⟨k, q, -, hq, hp, hE, h1, h2, rfl⟩ := mem_goodMultiples.1 hm
    have hXi : ¬ q ∣ Xi H := fun h => hE (mem_exceptionalPrimes.2 ⟨hq, hp, h⟩)
    exact forced_neighbours_selected ce hM hp (lt_mul_of_div_lt hH hq.1) hXi h1 h2
  rcases hn with ⟨m, hm, rfl⟩ | ⟨m, hm, rfl⟩
  · exact (key m hm).1
  · exact (key m hm).2

/-- **Rough primes of `Λ_x(M, E_H)` are exceptional.** -/
theorem roughPrimes_subset_exceptional (hM : 4 ≤ ce.M) {H : ℕ} (hH : 0 < H) :
    roughPrimes ce.M H (exceptionalPrimes ce.M H) ⊆ exceptionalPrimes ce.M H := by
  intro r hr
  simp only [roughPrimes, Finset.mem_filter, Nat.mem_primeFactors] at hr
  obtain ⟨⟨hrp, hrdvd, -⟩, hry⟩ := hr
  -- `r` divides some neighbour `n`
  obtain ⟨n, hn, hrn⟩ : ∃ n ∈ neighbourSet ce.M H (exceptionalPrimes ce.M H), r ∣ n := by
    by_contra hc
    push_neg at hc
    have := factorization_lcm_le _ r 0 (fun n hn => neighbourSet_pos hn)
      (fun n hn => (Nat.factorization_eq_zero_of_not_dvd (hc n hn)).le)
    have h1 := (hrp.dvd_iff_one_le_factorization (by
      intro h0; unfold LambdaX at h0; rw [Finset.lcm_eq_zero_iff] at h0
      obtain ⟨x, hx, hx0⟩ := h0
      exact neighbourSet_pos hx hx0)).1 hrdvd
    unfold LambdaX at h1
    omega
  have hnA := neighbourSet_subset_A ce hM hH hn
  have hnM : n ≤ ce.M := le_M ce hnA
  have hrM : r ≤ ce.M := le_trans (Nat.le_of_dvd (Nat.pos_of_ne_zero (neighbourSet_pos hn)) hrn) hnM
  have hrXi : r ∣ Xi H := by
    by_contra hc
    exact all_good_multiples_omitted ce hrp (lt_mul_of_div_lt hH hry) hc hrn hnA
  exact mem_exceptionalPrimes.2 ⟨⟨hry, hrM⟩, hrp, hrXi⟩

/-- **`R_x(M, E_H) ∣ Ξ_H`** for a hypothetical counterexample (`M ≥ 4`, `H ≥ 1`,
`M < (⌊M/H⌋+1)²`). -/
theorem roughPart_dvd_Xi (hM : 4 ≤ ce.M) {H : ℕ} (hH : 0 < H)
    (hy : ce.M < (ce.M / H + 1) ^ 2) :
    roughPart ce.M H (exceptionalPrimes ce.M H) ∣ Xi H := by
  set E := exceptionalPrimes ce.M H
  have hsub := roughPrimes_subset_exceptional ce hM hH
  -- exponents are `≤ 1`
  have hexp : ∀ r ∈ roughPrimes ce.M H E, (LambdaX ce.M H E).factorization r ≤ 1 := by
    intro r hr
    have hr' := Finset.mem_filter.1 hr
    have hrp : r.Prime := (Nat.mem_primeFactors.1 hr'.1).1
    refine factorization_lcm_le _ r 1 (fun n hn => neighbourSet_pos hn) fun n hn => ?_
    by_contra hc
    push_neg at hc
    have h2 : r ^ 2 ∣ n :=
      (hrp.pow_dvd_iff_le_factorization (neighbourSet_pos hn)).2 hc
    have hnA := neighbourSet_subset_A ce hM hH hn
    have hnM : n ≤ ce.M := le_M ce hnA
    have hle : r ^ 2 ≤ n := Nat.le_of_dvd (Nat.pos_of_ne_zero (neighbourSet_pos hn)) h2
    have : (ce.M / H + 1) ^ 2 ≤ r ^ 2 := Nat.pow_le_pow_left hr'.2 2
    omega
  calc roughPart ce.M H E ∣ ∏ r ∈ roughPrimes ce.M H E, r := by
        unfold roughPart
        exact Finset.prod_dvd_prod_of_dvd _ _ fun r hr =>
          (pow_dvd_pow r (hexp r hr)).trans (by rw [pow_one])
    _ ∣ ∏ r ∈ E, r := Finset.prod_dvd_prod_of_subset _ _ _ hsub
    _ ∣ Xi H := prod_exceptionalPrimes_dvd_Xi _ _

/-- Conditionally on `log Ξ_H < B`: `log R_x(M, E_H) < B`. -/
theorem log_roughPart_lt (hM : 4 ≤ ce.M) {H : ℕ} (hH : 0 < H)
    (hy : ce.M < (ce.M / H + 1) ^ 2) {B : ℝ} (hXi : Real.log (Xi H) < B) :
    Real.log (roughPart ce.M H (exceptionalPrimes ce.M H)) < B := by
  refine lt_of_le_of_lt ?_ hXi
  have hd := roughPart_dvd_Xi ce hM hH hy
  have hpos : 0 < roughPart ce.M H (exceptionalPrimes ce.M H) :=
    Nat.pos_of_dvd_of_pos hd (Xi_pos H)
  apply Real.log_le_log (by exact_mod_cast hpos)
  exact_mod_cast Nat.le_of_dvd (Xi_pos H) hd

end Gap2CE

end Erdos287.PostV64V71

import RequestProject.Erdos287.PostQSigma.HardCore

/-!
# Erdős #287 — V67 direct selected-mass / pinned normalisation

**Status: BANK (LEAN PROVED), with one REPAIR.**

Literal raw-source dictionary (PostQSigma): `W = lcm(a,…,M)`, `T = ∑_{n∈[a,M]} W/n - W`,
`B(E) = ∑_{n∈E} W/n`, `X(E) = B(E) - T`, for an omission set `E ⊆ (a, M)`.

Pinned language: the selected set `A = [a, M] \ E`; a residual denominator `D` with
`n ∣ D` for every `n ∈ A` and `D ∣ W`; the pinning cofactor `P = W / D`; the integer selected
mass `Y(A) = ∑_{n∈A} D/n`.

* `pinned_selected_mass` — **`X(E) = P · (D - Y(A))`** (exact; no prime-row independence, no
  random-residue heuristic, no modulo-`W` surrogate);
* `pinned_selected_mass_iff` — `X(E) = 0 ↔ Y(A) = D`;
* `pinned_mass_bounds` — `0 < Y(A) < 2D` when `H(a,M) < 2`;
* `pinned_W_dvd_iff` — `W ∣ X(E) ↔ Y(A) = D` (given `0 < Y < 2D`);
* `pinned_D_dvd_iff_of_coprime` — `D ∣ X(E) ↔ X(E) = 0` **when `gcd(P, D) = 1`**.

**REPAIR.**  The literal candidate equivalence "`X(E) = 0 ↔ D ∣ X(E)`" is not valid in the stated
generality: the algebraic shape `X = P(D - Y)` admits `P = D = 2`, `Y = 1` (`0 < Y < 2D`,
`D ∣ X`, `Y ≠ D`) — `pinned_D_dvd_counterfixture`.  The correct third equivalent is `W ∣ X(E)`
(i.e. `PD ∣ X(E)`), or `D ∣ X(E)` under `gcd(P, D) = 1`.
-/

open scoped BigOperators

namespace Erdos287.PostV64V71

open Erdos287.ExactSource Erdos287.PostQSigma

/-- The selected set `A = [a, M] \ E`. -/
def Asel (a M : ℕ) (E : Finset ℕ) : Finset ℕ := Finset.Icc a M \ E

/-- The integer selected mass `Y(A) = ∑_{n∈A} D/n`. -/
def Ymass (D : ℕ) (A : Finset ℕ) : ℕ := ∑ n ∈ A, D / n

/-- **V67 pinned identity**: `X(E) = (W/D) · (D - Y(A))`. -/
theorem pinned_selected_mass {a M D : ℕ} {E : Finset ℕ} (hE : E ⊆ Finset.Ioo a M)
    (hD : ∀ n ∈ Asel a M E, n ∣ D) (hDW : D ∣ W a M ∅) :
    Xd a M E = ((W a M ∅ / D : ℕ) : ℤ) * ((D : ℤ) - Ymass D (Asel a M E)) := by
  set W0 := W a M ∅
  set P := W0 / D
  have hWPD : W0 = P * D := (Nat.div_mul_cancel hDW).symm
  have hEsub : E ⊆ Finset.Icc a M := fun n hn => Finset.Ioo_subset_Icc_self (hE hn)
  -- `∑_{n∈A} W/n = P · Y`
  have hsumA : ∑ n ∈ Asel a M E, W0 / n = P * Ymass D (Asel a M E) := by
    unfold Ymass
    rw [Finset.mul_sum]
    refine Finset.sum_congr rfl fun n hn => ?_
    rw [hWPD, Nat.mul_div_assoc P (hD n hn)]
  have hT : T a M ∅ = (∑ n ∈ Finset.Icc a M, ((W0 / n : ℕ) : ℤ)) - (W0 : ℤ) := by
    unfold T; rw [B, Finset.sdiff_empty]
  have hsplit : ∑ n ∈ Finset.Icc a M, ((W0 / n : ℕ) : ℤ) =
      ∑ n ∈ Asel a M E, ((W0 / n : ℕ) : ℤ) + ∑ n ∈ E, ((W0 / n : ℕ) : ℤ) := by
    unfold Asel; rw [Finset.sum_sdiff hEsub]
  have hA : ∑ n ∈ Asel a M E, ((W0 / n : ℕ) : ℤ) = (P : ℤ) * Ymass D (Asel a M E) := by
    rw [← Nat.cast_sum, hsumA]; push_cast; ring
  have hW0 : (W0 : ℤ) = (P : ℤ) * D := by exact_mod_cast hWPD
  unfold Xd
  rw [cast_Bm, hT, hsplit, hA, hW0]
  ring

/-- `X(E) = 0 ↔ Y(A) = D` (for `a > 0`, so `W ≠ 0`). -/
theorem pinned_selected_mass_iff {a M D : ℕ} {E : Finset ℕ} (ha : 0 < a)
    (hE : E ⊆ Finset.Ioo a M) (hD : ∀ n ∈ Asel a M E, n ∣ D) (hDW : D ∣ W a M ∅) :
    Xd a M E = 0 ↔ Ymass D (Asel a M E) = D := by
  rw [pinned_selected_mass hE hD hDW]
  have hW0 : W a M ∅ ≠ 0 := W_ne_zero ha
  have hD0 : D ≠ 0 := fun h => hW0 (Nat.eq_zero_of_zero_dvd (h ▸ hDW))
  have hP : W a M ∅ / D ≠ 0 := by
    intro h
    rw [Nat.div_eq_zero_iff] at h
    rcases h with h | h
    · exact hD0 h
    · exact absurd (Nat.le_of_dvd (Nat.pos_of_ne_zero hW0) hDW) (not_le.2 h)
  rw [mul_eq_zero, sub_eq_zero]
  constructor
  · rintro (h | h)
    · exact absurd (by exact_mod_cast h) hP
    · exact_mod_cast h.symm
  · intro h; right; exact_mod_cast h.symm

/-- `0 < Y(A) < 2D` when `H(a,M) < 2` (and `0 < a ≤ M`, `D > 0`). -/
theorem pinned_mass_bounds {a M D : ℕ} {E : Finset ℕ} (ha : 0 < a) (haM : a ≤ M)
    (hE : E ⊆ Finset.Ioo a M) (hD : ∀ n ∈ Asel a M E, n ∣ D) (hD0 : 0 < D)
    (hH : Hm a M < 2) : 0 < Ymass D (Asel a M E) ∧ Ymass D (Asel a M E) < 2 * D := by
  have haA : a ∈ Asel a M E := by
    unfold Asel
    refine Finset.mem_sdiff.2 ⟨Finset.mem_Icc.2 ⟨le_rfl, haM⟩, fun h => ?_⟩
    have := Finset.mem_Ioo.1 (hE h); omega
  have hpos : ∀ n ∈ Asel a M E, 0 < n := fun n hn => by
    have := Finset.mem_Icc.1 (Finset.mem_sdiff.1 hn).1; omega
  constructor
  · unfold Ymass
    refine lt_of_lt_of_le ?_ (Finset.single_le_sum (fun _ _ => Nat.zero_le _) haA)
    exact Nat.div_pos (Nat.le_of_dvd hD0 (hD a haA)) ha
  · have hcast : (Ymass D (Asel a M E) : ℚ) = D * ∑ n ∈ Asel a M E, (1 : ℚ) / n := by
      unfold Ymass; push_cast
      rw [Finset.mul_sum]
      refine Finset.sum_congr rfl fun n hn => ?_
      rw [Nat.cast_div (hD n hn) (by have := hpos n hn; positivity)]
      ring
    have hle : ∑ n ∈ Asel a M E, (1 : ℚ) / n ≤ Hm a M := by
      unfold Hm Asel
      exact Finset.sum_le_sum_of_subset_of_nonneg Finset.sdiff_subset
        fun n _ _ => by positivity
    have : (Ymass D (Asel a M E) : ℚ) < 2 * D := by
      rw [hcast]
      have hD0' : (0 : ℚ) < D := by exact_mod_cast hD0
      nlinarith
    exact_mod_cast this

/-- `D ∣ D - Y` with `0 < Y < 2D` forces `Y = D`. -/
theorem eq_of_dvd_sub {D Y : ℕ} (hY : 0 < Y ∧ Y < 2 * D) (h : (D : ℤ) ∣ (D : ℤ) - Y) :
    Y = D := by
  obtain ⟨c, hc⟩ := h
  have hD0 : (0 : ℤ) < D := by have := hY.2; omega
  have hlt1 : (D : ℤ) - Y < D := by have := hY.1; omega
  have hlt2 : -(D : ℤ) < D - Y := by have := hY.2; omega
  have hc0 : c = 0 := by
    by_contra hne
    rcases lt_or_gt_of_ne hne with hneg | hpos
    · have : (D : ℤ) * c ≤ -D := by nlinarith
      omega
    · have : (D : ℤ) ≤ D * c := by nlinarith
      omega
  rw [hc0, mul_zero] at hc
  omega

/-- `W ∣ X(E) ↔ Y(A) = D`, given `0 < Y(A) < 2D`. -/
theorem pinned_W_dvd_iff {a M D : ℕ} {E : Finset ℕ} (ha : 0 < a)
    (hE : E ⊆ Finset.Ioo a M) (hD : ∀ n ∈ Asel a M E, n ∣ D) (hDW : D ∣ W a M ∅)
    (hY : 0 < Ymass D (Asel a M E) ∧ Ymass D (Asel a M E) < 2 * D) :
    ((W a M ∅ : ℕ) : ℤ) ∣ Xd a M E ↔ Ymass D (Asel a M E) = D := by
  rw [pinned_selected_mass hE hD hDW]
  set P := W a M ∅ / D
  set Y := Ymass D (Asel a M E)
  have hW0 : W a M ∅ ≠ 0 := W_ne_zero ha
  have hWPD : W a M ∅ = P * D := (Nat.div_mul_cancel hDW).symm
  have hP0 : (P : ℤ) ≠ 0 := by
    intro h; apply hW0; rw [hWPD]; simp only [Nat.cast_eq_zero] at h; rw [h, zero_mul]
  have hWZ : ((W a M ∅ : ℕ) : ℤ) = (P : ℤ) * D := by exact_mod_cast hWPD
  rw [hWZ]
  constructor
  · intro h
    exact eq_of_dvd_sub hY ((mul_dvd_mul_iff_left hP0).1 h)
  · intro h; rw [h, sub_self, mul_zero]; exact dvd_zero _

/-- `D ∣ X(E) ↔ X(E) = 0` when `gcd(W/D, D) = 1` and `0 < Y(A) < 2D`. -/
theorem pinned_D_dvd_iff_of_coprime {a M D : ℕ} {E : Finset ℕ} (ha : 0 < a)
    (hE : E ⊆ Finset.Ioo a M) (hD : ∀ n ∈ Asel a M E, n ∣ D) (hDW : D ∣ W a M ∅)
    (hcop : Nat.Coprime (W a M ∅ / D) D)
    (hY : 0 < Ymass D (Asel a M E) ∧ Ymass D (Asel a M E) < 2 * D) :
    (D : ℤ) ∣ Xd a M E ↔ Xd a M E = 0 := by
  rw [pinned_selected_mass_iff ha hE hD hDW]
  constructor
  · intro h
    rw [pinned_selected_mass hE hD hDW] at h
    have hcopZ : IsCoprime (D : ℤ) ((W a M ∅ / D : ℕ) : ℤ) := by
      rw [Int.isCoprime_iff_gcd_eq_one, Int.gcd_natCast_natCast]; exact hcop.symm
    exact eq_of_dvd_sub hY (hcopZ.dvd_of_dvd_mul_left h)
  · intro h
    rw [pinned_selected_mass hE hD hDW, h, sub_self, mul_zero]
    exact dvd_zero _

/-- **REPAIR fixture**: the shape `X = P (D - Y)` with `0 < Y < 2D` does not force
`D ∣ X ⇒ Y = D` without coprimality (`P = D = 2`, `Y = 1`). -/
theorem pinned_D_dvd_counterfixture :
    ∃ P D Y : ℕ, 0 < Y ∧ Y < 2 * D ∧ (D : ℤ) ∣ (P : ℤ) * ((D : ℤ) - Y) ∧ Y ≠ D :=
  ⟨2, 2, 1, by norm_num, by norm_num, ⟨1, by norm_num⟩, by norm_num⟩

end Erdos287.PostV64V71

import RequestProject.Erdos287.PostV64V71.ReciprocalFingerprint
import RequestProject.Erdos287.Blocker
import RequestProject.Erdos287.ProblemStatement

/-!
# Erdős #287 — V69/V70 source rows: upper-half primes, all good multiples, forced neighbours

**Status: BANK (LEAN PROVED).**  All statements are about a literal hypothetical gap-`≤2`
counterexample (`Gap2CE`, which every exact `Erdos287Counterexample` is, via `toGap2CE`).
Write `N = min A`, `M = max A`.

* `two_mul_N_le_M` — `2N ≤ M` as soon as `M ≥ 4` (from `e(N-1) < M`);
* `upper_half_prime_omitted` — **V69**: a prime `p` with `M < 2p` is never in `A`
  (independent of `Ξ_H`: `p` is the unique `p`-multiple and the reciprocal equation modulo `p`
  rules it out);
* `upper_half_prime_neighbours` — for such `p ≤ M` (and `M ≥ 4`), `p - 1 ∈ A` and `p + 1 ∈ A`
  (the endpoint case `p + 1 = M` is included: then `p + 1 = M ∈ A`);
* `all_good_multiples_omitted` — **V70 Theorem 2.1**: if `q` is prime, `q > M/H`
  (`M < q·H`) and `q ∤ Ξ_H`, then **every** multiple of `q` is omitted;
* `forced_neighbours_selected` — for such `q` and `M/2 < kq < 3M/4`, both `kq - 1 ∈ A` and
  `kq + 1 ∈ A`;
* `adjacent_omissions_false` — two adjacent omissions inside `[N, M]` are impossible.
-/

open scoped BigOperators

namespace Erdos287.PostV64V71

open Erdos287

namespace Gap2CE

variable (ce : Erdos287.Gap2CE)

/-- `2N ≤ M` once `M ≥ 4`. -/
theorem two_mul_N_le_M (hM : 4 ≤ ce.M) : 2 * ce.N ≤ ce.M := by
  have hlo := ce.exp_lower
  have he := Real.exp_one_gt_d9
  by_contra hc
  push_neg at hc
  have h1 : (ce.M : ℝ) + 1 ≤ 2 * (ce.N : ℝ) := by exact_mod_cast hc
  have h2 : (4 : ℝ) ≤ ce.M := by exact_mod_cast hM
  nlinarith

/-- Every element lies in `[N, M]`. -/
theorem le_M {a : ℕ} (ha : a ∈ ce.A) : a ≤ ce.M := Finset.le_max' _ _ ha

/-- **V69 upper-half prime omission**: a prime `p` with `M < 2p` is never a denominator. -/
theorem upper_half_prime_omitted {p : ℕ} (hp : p.Prime) (hp2 : ce.M < 2 * p) : p ∉ ce.A := by
  intro hpA
  have hpM : p ≤ ce.M := (le_M ce) hpA
  exact ce.notMem_of_excludedPP (excludedPP_self_of_large hp hpM hp2) dvd_rfl hpA

/-- **Two adjacent omissions inside `[N, M]` are impossible.** -/
theorem adjacent_omissions_false {n : ℕ} (hn0 : ce.N ≤ n) (hn1 : n + 1 ≤ ce.M)
    (h1 : n ∉ ce.A) (h2 : n + 1 ∉ ce.A) : False :=
  ce.blockerPair_contradiction hn0 hn1 h1 h2

/-- An omitted `n` with `N < n < M` has both neighbours selected. -/
theorem neighbours_of_hole {n : ℕ} (hn0 : ce.N < n) (hn1 : n < ce.M) (hn : n ∉ ce.A) :
    n - 1 ∈ ce.A ∧ n + 1 ∈ ce.A := by
  constructor
  · have := ce.holes_isolated (n - 1) (by omega) (by omega)
    rw [Nat.sub_add_cancel (by omega)] at this
    exact this.resolve_right hn
  · exact (ce.holes_isolated n (by omega) (by omega)).resolve_left hn

/-- **V69 forced neighbours of an upper-half prime** (`M ≥ 4`, `M/2 < p ≤ M`):
`p - 1 ∈ A` and `p + 1 ∈ A`.  (If `p + 1 = M`, this is just `M ∈ A`.) -/
theorem upper_half_prime_neighbours (hM : 4 ≤ ce.M) {p : ℕ} (hp : p.Prime)
    (hp2 : ce.M < 2 * p) (hpM : p ≤ ce.M) : p - 1 ∈ ce.A ∧ p + 1 ∈ ce.A := by
  have hnot := (upper_half_prime_omitted ce) hp hp2
  have hN := (two_mul_N_le_M ce) hM
  have hpM' : p < ce.M := lt_of_le_of_ne hpM (fun h => hnot (h ▸ ce.M_mem))
  exact (neighbours_of_hole ce) (by omega) hpM' hnot

/-- **V70 Theorem 2.1 (all good multiples omitted).**  If `q` is prime, `q > M/H`
(i.e. `M < q·H`) and `q ∤ Ξ_H`, then no multiple of `q` belongs to `A`. -/
theorem all_good_multiples_omitted {H q : ℕ} (hq : q.Prime) (hqH : ce.M < q * H)
    (hXi : ¬ q ∣ Xi H) {n : ℕ} (hqn : q ∣ n) : n ∉ ce.A := fun hn =>
  good_large_prime_row_empty ce.A ce.M H q hq ce.hpos (fun _ ha => (le_M ce) ha) ce.hsum
    (div_le_of_lt_mul hqH) hXi n hn hqn

/-- **V70 forced neighbours.**  For a good prime `q` (`q` prime, `M < q·H`, `q ∤ Ξ_H`) and
`M/2 < kq < 3M/4`, both `kq - 1` and `kq + 1` are selected. -/
theorem forced_neighbours_selected (hM : 4 ≤ ce.M) {H q k : ℕ} (hq : q.Prime)
    (hqH : ce.M < q * H) (hXi : ¬ q ∣ Xi H) (hlo : ce.M < 2 * (k * q))
    (hhi : 4 * (k * q) < 3 * ce.M) : k * q - 1 ∈ ce.A ∧ k * q + 1 ∈ ce.A := by
  have hnot := (all_good_multiples_omitted ce) hq hqH hXi (dvd_mul_left q k)
  have hN := (two_mul_N_le_M ce) hM
  exact (neighbours_of_hole ce) (by omega) (by omega) hnot

end Gap2CE

/-! ## The same statements for exact `Erdos287Counterexample`s -/

namespace Erdos287Counterexample

variable {A : Finset ℕ} (h : Erdos287Counterexample A)

/-- V69 for exact counterexamples. -/
theorem upper_half_prime_omitted {p : ℕ} (hp : p.Prime) (hp2 : A.max' h.nonempty < 2 * p) :
    p ∉ A :=
  Gap2CE.upper_half_prime_omitted h.toGap2CE hp hp2

/-- V70 Theorem 2.1 for exact counterexamples. -/
theorem all_good_multiples_omitted {H q : ℕ} (hq : q.Prime) (hqH : A.max' h.nonempty < q * H)
    (hXi : ¬ q ∣ Xi H) {n : ℕ} (hqn : q ∣ n) : n ∉ A :=
  Gap2CE.all_good_multiples_omitted h.toGap2CE hq hqH hXi hqn

/-- V70 forced neighbours for exact counterexamples. -/
theorem forced_neighbours_selected (hM : 4 ≤ A.max' h.nonempty) {H q k : ℕ} (hq : q.Prime)
    (hqH : A.max' h.nonempty < q * H) (hXi : ¬ q ∣ Xi H)
    (hlo : A.max' h.nonempty < 2 * (k * q)) (hhi : 4 * (k * q) < 3 * A.max' h.nonempty) :
    k * q - 1 ∈ A ∧ k * q + 1 ∈ A :=
  Gap2CE.forced_neighbours_selected h.toGap2CE hM hq hqH hXi hlo hhi

end Erdos287Counterexample

end Erdos287.PostV64V71

/-!
# Erdős #287 — V71 tail closure: `DeterminantSupply287 ⇒` no counterexample above `2^1500`

**ERDŐS #287 REMAINS OPEN.**  This file proves *implications* only.

## Canonical height (discrete / analytic separation)

`Hcan M = ⌊(log M - 6 log log M) / log 2⌋₊`.  For `M ≥ 2^1500`, with `L = log M`,
`canonical_height_facts` proves (real analysis, fully in Lean):

* `1 ≤ Hcan M`;
* `Hcan M ≤ 3L/2`;
* `12 L⁶ < √M`.

## Named propositions (NOT proved, NOT assumed globally)

* `DeterminantSupply287` — **the current OPEN research owner**: for every `M ≥ 2^1500`,
  `D_Λ(M) > 13 M / (log M)³` (with `H = Hcan M`, `y = ⌊M/H⌋`).
* `FingerprintLogBound287` — the V68 explicit exceptional-prime log budget
  `log Ξ_H < 2 M / (log M)⁵` for `M ≥ 2^1500` (paper-level; it needs an explicit Chebyshev upper
  bound `ψ(H) ≲ 1.04 H` that is not available in Lean/Mathlib — Mathlib's `ψ(x) ≤ log 4 · x + …`
  is too weak by a hair).  It is an explicit **hypothesis** of the tail theorem.

## Proved implications

* `contamination_lt` — `8 H √M L² < M/L³` (so `D_Λ > 13M/L³ ⇒ D_θ > 12M/L³`);
* `loss_lt` — `B_E < 2M/L⁵ ⇒ 4 H L B_E < 12 M/L³`;
* `supply_implies_theta_supply` — `D_Λ > 13M/L³ ⇒ D_θ > 12M/L³`;
* `determinant_supply_excludes_source` — for a literal counterexample with `M ≥ 2^1500`:
  `D_Λ(M) > 13M/L³` and `log Ξ_H < 2M/L⁵` give a contradiction (some tuple survives deletion of
  all fingerprint-exception owners; both owners are good; `kq` and `tr` are adjacent mandatory
  omissions).  **No prime-distribution heuristic is used.**
* `determinant_supply_implies_no_tail` — `DeterminantSupply287 → FingerprintLogBound287 →
  NoCounterexampleAbove (2^1500)`;
* `finite_and_tail_imply_erdos287` — finite exclusion up to `U ≥ 2^1500 - 1` + tail ⇒ original
  ordered statement;
* `erdos287_of_determinant_supply` — the conditional global theorem;
* `erdos287_of_determinant_supply_repository_native` — uses only the proved `4·10⁹` bank and
  exposes the unresolved range `(4·10⁹, 2^1500)` as an explicit hypothesis.
-/

open scoped BigOperators

namespace Erdos287.PostV64V71

open Erdos287 Erdos287.PostQSigma

/-- The canonical V71 height `H = ⌊(log M - 6 log log M)/log 2⌋₊`. -/
noncomputable def Hcan (M : ℕ) : ℕ :=
  ⌊(Real.log M - 6 * Real.log (Real.log M)) / Real.log 2⌋₊

/-! ## Real-analysis facts for `M ≥ 2^1500` -/

theorem log_ge_of_large {M : ℕ} (hM : 2 ^ 1500 ≤ M) : 1039 < Real.log M := by
  have h2 : ((2 : ℝ) ^ 1500) ≤ (M : ℝ) := by exact_mod_cast hM
  have h3 : Real.log ((2 : ℝ) ^ 1500) ≤ Real.log M := Real.log_le_log (by positivity) h2
  rw [Real.log_pow] at h3
  have := Real.log_two_gt_d9
  push_cast at h3
  linarith

/-- `log L ≤ L/12` for `L ≥ 1039` (via `log s ≤ s - 1` at `s = √L`). -/
theorem log_le_div_twelve {L : ℝ} (hL : 1039 < L) : 6 * Real.log L ≤ L / 2 := by
  have hL0 : 0 < L := by linarith
  set s := Real.sqrt L with hs
  have hs0 : 0 < s := Real.sqrt_pos.2 hL0
  have hss : s ^ 2 = L := Real.sq_sqrt hL0.le
  have hs24 : 24 ≤ s := by
    rw [hs, Real.le_sqrt (by norm_num) hL0.le]; linarith
  have hlog : Real.log L = 2 * Real.log s := by
    rw [← hss, Real.log_pow]; push_cast; ring
  have h1 : Real.log s ≤ s - 1 := Real.log_le_sub_one_of_pos hs0
  rw [hlog, ← hss]
  nlinarith

/-- `12 L⁶ < √M` for `M ≥ 2^1500`, `L = log M` (via `exp x ≥ x¹²/12!`). -/
theorem twelve_log_pow_lt_sqrt {M : ℕ} (hM : 2 ^ 1500 ≤ M) :
    12 * Real.log M ^ 6 < Real.sqrt M := by
  have hL := log_ge_of_large hM
  set L := Real.log M with hLdef
  have hM0 : (0 : ℝ) < M := by
    have : (0 : ℕ) < M := lt_of_lt_of_le (by positivity) hM
    exact_mod_cast this
  have hsq : Real.sqrt M = Real.exp (L / 2) := by
    have h1 : (M : ℝ) = Real.exp (L / 2) ^ 2 := by
      rw [← Real.exp_nat_mul, hLdef]; push_cast
      rw [show (2 : ℝ) * (Real.log M / 2) = Real.log M by ring, Real.exp_log hM0]
    rw [h1, Real.sqrt_sq (Real.exp_pos _).le]
  rw [hsq]
  have hexp := Real.pow_div_factorial_le_exp (x := L / 2) (by linarith) 12
  have hfact : (Nat.factorial 12 : ℝ) = 479001600 := by norm_num [Nat.factorial]
  rw [hfact] at hexp
  have hL6 : (1039 : ℝ) ^ 6 ≤ L ^ 6 := pow_le_pow_left₀ (by norm_num) hL.le 6
  have hL6pos : 0 < L ^ 6 := by positivity
  have key : 12 * L ^ 6 < (L / 2) ^ 12 / 479001600 := by
    rw [lt_div_iff₀ (by norm_num), div_pow, show L ^ 12 = L ^ 6 * L ^ 6 by ring]
    have : (12 : ℝ) * 479001600 * 2 ^ 12 < L ^ 6 := by nlinarith
    rw [lt_div_iff₀ (by norm_num)]
    nlinarith
  linarith

/-- **Canonical-height facts** for `M ≥ 2^1500`. -/
theorem canonical_height_facts {M : ℕ} (hM : 2 ^ 1500 ≤ M) :
    1 ≤ Hcan M ∧ (Hcan M : ℝ) ≤ 3 / 2 * Real.log M ∧
      12 * Real.log M ^ 6 < Real.sqrt M := by
  have hL := log_ge_of_large hM
  set L := Real.log M with hLdef
  have h6 := log_le_div_twelve hL
  have hl2 := Real.log_two_gt_d9
  have hl2' := Real.log_two_lt_d9
  have hlogL : 0 ≤ Real.log L := Real.log_nonneg (by linarith)
  have hval_lo : 1 ≤ (L - 6 * Real.log L) / Real.log 2 := by
    rw [le_div_iff₀ (by linarith)]; linarith
  refine ⟨?_, ?_, twelve_log_pow_lt_sqrt hM⟩
  · unfold Hcan
    rw [← hLdef]
    exact Nat.one_le_floor_iff _ |>.2 hval_lo
  · unfold Hcan
    rw [← hLdef]
    have hnn : 0 ≤ (L - 6 * Real.log L) / Real.log 2 := by linarith
    refine le_trans (Nat.floor_le hnn) ?_
    rw [div_le_iff₀ (by linarith)]
    nlinarith

/-! ## The two closure margins -/

/-- **Contamination margin**: `8 H √M L² < M / L³` when `H ≤ 3L/2`, `L > 0`, `12 L⁶ < √M`. -/
theorem contamination_lt {M H L : ℝ} (hM : 0 < M) (hL : 0 < L)
    (hH : H ≤ 3 / 2 * L) (hsq : 12 * L ^ 6 < Real.sqrt M) :
    8 * H * Real.sqrt M * L ^ 2 < M / L ^ 3 := by
  have hs0 : 0 < Real.sqrt M := Real.sqrt_pos.2 hM
  have hss : Real.sqrt M * Real.sqrt M = M := Real.mul_self_sqrt hM.le
  rw [lt_div_iff₀ (by positivity)]
  have h1 : 8 * H * Real.sqrt M * L ^ 2 * L ^ 3 ≤ 12 * L ^ 6 * Real.sqrt M := by
    have : 8 * H * L ^ 5 ≤ 12 * L ^ 6 := by
      have hL5 : 0 ≤ L ^ 5 := by positivity
      nlinarith
    nlinarith
  have h2 : 12 * L ^ 6 * Real.sqrt M < Real.sqrt M * Real.sqrt M :=
    mul_lt_mul_of_pos_right hsq hs0
  linarith

/-- **Loss margin**: `0 ≤ B < 2M/L⁵`, `H ≤ 3L/2` ⇒ `4 H L B < 12 M/L³`. -/
theorem loss_lt {M H L B : ℝ} (hL : 0 < L) (hH : H ≤ 3 / 2 * L) (hB0 : 0 ≤ B)
    (hB : B < 2 * M / L ^ 5) : 4 * H * L * B < 12 * M / L ^ 3 := by
  have h1 : 4 * H * L * B ≤ 6 * L ^ 2 * B := by
    nlinarith [mul_nonneg (mul_nonneg hL.le (by linarith : 0 ≤ 3 / 2 * L - H)) hB0]
  have h2 : 6 * L ^ 2 * B < 6 * L ^ 2 * (2 * M / L ^ 5) :=
    mul_lt_mul_of_pos_left hB (by positivity)
  have h3 : 6 * L ^ 2 * (2 * M / L ^ 5) = 12 * M / L ^ 3 := by
    field_simp
    ring
  linarith

/-! ## Named propositions -/

/-- **`DeterminantSupply287` — CURRENT OPEN RESEARCH OWNER (definition only; never proved or
assumed globally).**  For every `M ≥ 2^1500`, `D_Λ(M) > 13 M/(log M)³`, where `D_Λ` is the V71
von Mangoldt determinant count with the canonical height `H = Hcan M` and `y = ⌊M/H⌋`. -/
def DeterminantSupply287 : Prop :=
  ∀ M : ℕ, 2 ^ 1500 ≤ M → 13 * (M : ℝ) / Real.log M ^ 3 < DLambda M (Hcan M)

/-- **`FingerprintLogBound287` — explicit exceptional-prime log budget (PAPER-LEVEL / EXTERNAL;
Lean-uninhabited).**  `log Ξ_H < 2M/(log M)⁵` for every `M ≥ 2^1500`, `H = Hcan M`. -/
def FingerprintLogBound287 : Prop :=
  ∀ M : ℕ, 2 ^ 1500 ≤ M → Real.log (Xi (Hcan M)) < 2 * (M : ℝ) / Real.log M ^ 5

/-- No exact Erdős #287 counterexample has maximum `≥ B`. -/
def NoCounterexampleAbove (B : ℕ) : Prop :=
  ∀ A : Finset ℕ, ∀ h : Erdos287Counterexample A, B ≤ A.max' h.nonempty → False

/-! ## The closure chain -/

/-- `D_Λ > 13M/L³ ⇒ D_θ > 12M/L³` (for `M ≥ 2^1500`, `H = Hcan M`). -/
theorem supply_implies_theta_supply {M : ℕ} (hM : 2 ^ 1500 ≤ M)
    (hD : 13 * (M : ℝ) / Real.log M ^ 3 < DLambda M (Hcan M)) :
    12 * (M : ℝ) / Real.log M ^ 3 < Dtheta M (Hcan M) := by
  obtain ⟨hH1, hH, hsq⟩ := canonical_height_facts hM
  have hL := log_ge_of_large hM
  have hM1 : 1 ≤ M := le_trans (Nat.one_le_two_pow) hM
  have hM0 : (0 : ℝ) < M := by exact_mod_cast hM1
  have hcont := (mangoldt_prime_power_error M (Hcan M) hM1).2
  have hlt := contamination_lt hM0 (by linarith) hH hsq
  have h13 : 13 * (M : ℝ) / Real.log M ^ 3 = 12 * (M : ℝ) / Real.log M ^ 3 +
      (M : ℝ) / Real.log M ^ 3 := by ring
  linarith

/-- After deleting all tuples with an owner in `E_H`, the `θ*` mass is still positive. -/
theorem Dgg_pos_of_supply {M : ℕ} (hM : 2 ^ 1500 ≤ M)
    (hD : 13 * (M : ℝ) / Real.log M ^ 3 < DLambda M (Hcan M))
    (hXi : Real.log (Xi (Hcan M)) < 2 * (M : ℝ) / Real.log M ^ 5) :
    0 < Dgg M (Hcan M) (exceptionalPrimes M (Hcan M)) := by
  obtain ⟨hH1, hH, hsq⟩ := canonical_height_facts hM
  have hL := log_ge_of_large hM
  have hθ := supply_implies_theta_supply hM hD
  have hloss := (exception_weight_loss M (Hcan M) (exceptionalPrimes M (Hcan M))).2
  have hBE : BE M (Hcan M) < 2 * (M : ℝ) / Real.log M ^ 5 :=
    lt_of_le_of_lt (BE_le_log_Xi M (Hcan M)) hXi
  have hlt := loss_lt (by linarith) hH (BE_nonneg M (Hcan M)) hBE
  unfold BE at hlt
  linarith

/-- **Determinant supply excludes the source.**  For a literal counterexample (as a `Gap2CE`)
with `M ≥ 2^1500`, the inequalities `D_Λ(M) > 13M/L³` and `log Ξ_H < 2M/L⁵` are contradictory. -/
theorem determinant_supply_excludes_source (ce : Erdos287.Gap2CE) (hM : 2 ^ 1500 ≤ ce.M)
    (hD : 13 * (ce.M : ℝ) / Real.log ce.M ^ 3 < DLambda ce.M (Hcan ce.M))
    (hXi : Real.log (Xi (Hcan ce.M)) < 2 * (ce.M : ℝ) / Real.log ce.M ^ 5) : False := by
  have hpos := Dgg_pos_of_supply hM hD hXi
  obtain ⟨hH1, -, -⟩ := canonical_height_facts hM
  set H := Hcan ce.M
  set E := exceptionalPrimes ce.M H
  obtain ⟨x, hx, hne⟩ := Finset.exists_ne_zero_of_sum_ne_zero hpos.ne'
  obtain ⟨hxbox, hqE, hrE⟩ := Finset.mem_filter.1 hx
  have hq : x.q.Prime := by
    by_contra h; exact hne (by rw [thetaStar_of_not_prime h, zero_mul])
  have hr : x.r.Prime := by
    by_contra h; exact hne (by rw [thetaStar_of_not_prime h, mul_zero])
  have m := mem_detBox.1 hxbox
  have hqXi : ¬ x.q ∣ Xi H := fun h => hqE (mem_exceptionalPrimes.2 ⟨m.2.1, hq, h⟩)
  have hrXi : ¬ x.r ∣ Xi H := fun h => hrE (mem_exceptionalPrimes.2 ⟨m.2.2.2.1, hr, h⟩)
  have hM4 : 4 ≤ ce.M :=
    le_trans (le_trans (show 4 ≤ 2 ^ 2 by norm_num) (Nat.pow_le_pow_right (by norm_num)
      (by norm_num))) hM
  exact Gap2CE.good_tuple_excludes ce hM4 (by omega) hxbox hq hr hqXi hrXi

/-- **Tail theorem (A).**  `DeterminantSupply287` and the explicit fingerprint log budget imply
that no exact counterexample has maximum `≥ 2^1500`. -/
theorem determinant_supply_implies_no_tail (hS : DeterminantSupply287)
    (hXi : FingerprintLogBound287) : NoCounterexampleAbove (2 ^ 1500) := by
  intro A h hM
  have hM' : 2 ^ 1500 ≤ h.toGap2CE.M := hM
  exact determinant_supply_excludes_source h.toGap2CE hM' (hS _ hM') (hXi _ hM')

/-! ## Terminal splices -/

/-- **Theorem B (conditional full splice).**  A finite exclusion up to `U` with
`2^1500 ≤ U + 1` (overlap condition) and the tail statement imply the original ordered-sequence
statement of Erdős #287. -/
theorem finite_and_tail_imply_erdos287 {U : ℕ} (hfin : FiniteExclusionUpTo U)
    (hU : 2 ^ 1500 ≤ U + 1) (htail : NoCounterexampleAbove (2 ^ 1500))
    (k : ℕ) (n : ℕ → ℕ) (hmono : ∀ i j, i < j → j < k → n i < n j)
    (hone : ∀ i, i < k → 1 < n i) (hsum : ∑ i ∈ Finset.range k, (1 : ℚ) / (n i) = 1) :
    ∃ i, i + 1 < k ∧ n i + 3 ≤ n (i + 1) := by
  refine erdos287_seq_of_no_counterexample (fun A hA => ?_) k n hmono hone hsum
  have := hfin A hA
  exact htail A hA (by omega)

/-- **Conditional global theorem.**  Finite exclusion through the overlap, `DeterminantSupply287`
(OPEN) and `FingerprintLogBound287` (paper-level) imply the original statement. -/
theorem erdos287_of_determinant_supply {U : ℕ} (hfin : FiniteExclusionUpTo U)
    (hU : 2 ^ 1500 ≤ U + 1) (hS : DeterminantSupply287) (hXi : FingerprintLogBound287)
    (k : ℕ) (n : ℕ → ℕ) (hmono : ∀ i j, i < j → j < k → n i < n j)
    (hone : ∀ i, i < k → 1 < n i) (hsum : ∑ i ∈ Finset.range k, (1 : ℚ) / (n i) = 1) :
    ∃ i, i + 1 < k ∧ n i + 3 ≤ n (i + 1) :=
  finite_and_tail_imply_erdos287 hfin hU (determinant_supply_implies_no_tail hS hXi)
    k n hmono hone hsum

/-- **Theorem C (repository-native; does NOT claim closure).**  Uses only the proved finite bank
`M ≤ 4·10⁹`.  The enormous unresolved range `4·10⁹ < M < 2^1500` is an explicit hypothesis
`hmid`, and the tail needs the OPEN `DeterminantSupply287` and `FingerprintLogBound287`. -/
theorem erdos287_of_determinant_supply_repository_native
    (hmid : ∀ A : Finset ℕ, ∀ h : Erdos287Counterexample A,
      4000000000 < A.max' h.nonempty → A.max' h.nonempty < 2 ^ 1500 → False)
    (hS : DeterminantSupply287) (hXi : FingerprintLogBound287) :
    ∀ A : Finset ℕ, ¬ Erdos287Counterexample A := by
  intro A hA
  have h1 := finiteExclusionUpTo_4e9 A hA
  by_cases hM : A.max' hA.nonempty < 2 ^ 1500
  · exact hmid A hA h1 hM
  · exact determinant_supply_implies_no_tail hS hXi A hA (by omega)

end Erdos287.PostV64V71

import RequestProject.Erdos287.PostV64V71.ExceptionAccounting

/-!
# Erdős #287 — V71 exact weighted adjacent correlation `C_K(M) ≤ D_Λ(M)`

**Status: BANK (LEAN PROVED).**  Finite combinatorics only.

* `Iset M = {n : M/2 < n < 3M/4}` (as `M < 2n`, `4n < 3M`);
* `fK K n = ∑_{k ≤ K, k ∣ n} Λ(n/k)`;
* `CK M K = ∑_{n, m ∈ I, |n - m| = 1} f_K(n) f_K(m)` (the authoritative combinatorial
  definition);
* `CK_eq_sum_quad` — the expansion of `C_K` as a sum over quadruples `(n, m, k, t)`;
* `weighted_subbox_le_full_supply` — for `4K ≤ H`: `C_K(M) ≤ D_Λ(M)` via the exact subbox
  dictionary `(n, m, k, t) ↦ (k, n/k, t, m/t, n - m)`; in particular for `K = ⌊H/4⌋`.
-/

open scoped BigOperators

namespace Erdos287.PostV64V71

open Erdos287

/-- The interval `I = (M/2, 3M/4)`. -/
def Iset (M : ℕ) : Finset ℕ := (Finset.range (M + 1)).filter (fun n => M < 2 * n ∧ 4 * n < 3 * M)

theorem mem_Iset {M n : ℕ} : n ∈ Iset M ↔ M < 2 * n ∧ 4 * n < 3 * M := by
  simp only [Iset, Finset.mem_filter, Finset.mem_range]
  constructor
  · exact fun h => h.2
  · intro h; exact ⟨by omega, h⟩

/-- `f_K(n) = ∑_{k ≤ K, k ∣ n} Λ(n/k)`. -/
noncomputable def fK (K n : ℕ) : ℝ := ∑ k ∈ (Finset.Icc 1 K).filter (· ∣ n), LambdaW (n / k)

/-- Adjacency `|n - m| = 1`. -/
def Adj (n m : ℕ) : Prop := n = m + 1 ∨ m = n + 1

instance (n m : ℕ) : Decidable (Adj n m) := by unfold Adj; infer_instance

/-- **`C_K(M)`**: the exact adjacent weighted correlation. -/
noncomputable def CK (M K : ℕ) : ℝ :=
  ∑ n ∈ Iset M, ∑ m ∈ Iset M, if Adj n m then fK K n * fK K m else 0

/-- The quadruple index set `{(n, m, k, t) : n, m ∈ I adjacent, k, t ≤ K, k ∣ n, t ∣ m}`. -/
def quadSet (M K : ℕ) : Finset ((ℕ × ℕ) × (ℕ × ℕ)) :=
  ((Iset M ×ˢ Iset M) ×ˢ (Finset.Icc 1 K ×ˢ Finset.Icc 1 K)).filter
    (fun x => Adj x.1.1 x.1.2 ∧ x.2.1 ∣ x.1.1 ∧ x.2.2 ∣ x.1.2)

/-- Expansion of `C_K` over quadruples. -/
theorem CK_eq_sum_quad (M K : ℕ) :
    CK M K = ∑ x ∈ quadSet M K, LambdaW (x.1.1 / x.2.1) * LambdaW (x.1.2 / x.2.2) := by
  unfold CK quadSet
  rw [Finset.sum_filter, Finset.sum_product, Finset.sum_product]
  refine Finset.sum_congr rfl fun n _ => Finset.sum_congr rfl fun m _ => ?_
  rw [Finset.sum_product]
  unfold fK
  rw [Finset.sum_mul_sum, Finset.sum_filter]
  by_cases hadj : Adj n m
  · rw [if_pos hadj]
    refine Finset.sum_congr rfl fun k _ => ?_
    rw [Finset.sum_filter]
    by_cases hk : k ∣ n
    · rw [if_pos hk]
      refine Finset.sum_congr rfl fun t _ => ?_
      by_cases ht : t ∣ m
      · rw [if_pos ht, if_pos ⟨hadj, hk, ht⟩]
      · rw [if_neg ht, if_neg (fun h => ht h.2.2)]
    · rw [if_neg hk]
      exact (Finset.sum_eq_zero fun t _ => if_neg (fun h => hk h.2.1)).symm
  · rw [if_neg hadj]
    symm
    refine Finset.sum_eq_zero fun k _ => Finset.sum_eq_zero fun t _ => if_neg (fun h => hadj h.1)

/-- The subbox dictionary `(n, m, k, t) ↦ (k, n/k, t, m/t, n - m)`. -/
def quadToTup (x : (ℕ × ℕ) × (ℕ × ℕ)) : DTup :=
  (x.2.1, x.1.1 / x.2.1, x.2.2, x.1.2 / x.2.2, (x.1.1 : ℤ) - x.1.2)

theorem quadToTup_mem {M K H : ℕ} (hKH : 4 * K ≤ H) {x : (ℕ × ℕ) × (ℕ × ℕ)}
    (hx : x ∈ quadSet M K) : quadToTup x ∈ detBox M H := by
  obtain ⟨⟨n, m⟩, ⟨k, t⟩⟩ := x
  simp only [quadSet, Finset.mem_filter, Finset.mem_product, Finset.mem_Icc] at hx
  obtain ⟨⟨⟨hn, hm⟩, ⟨hk1, hkK⟩, ⟨ht1, htK⟩⟩, hadj, hkn, htm⟩ := hx
  rw [mem_Iset] at hn hm
  have hnk : k * (n / k) = n := Nat.mul_div_cancel' hkn
  have hmt : t * (m / t) = m := Nat.mul_div_cancel' htm
  have hHpos : 0 < H := by omega
  -- `n/k > M/H` since `(n/k) H ≥ (n/k) 4k = 4n > M`
  have hq : M / H < n / k := by
    rw [Nat.div_lt_iff_lt_mul hHpos]
    have : (n / k) * (4 * k) ≤ (n / k) * H := Nat.mul_le_mul_left _ (by omega)
    have h4 : (n / k) * (4 * k) = 4 * n := by
      calc (n / k) * (4 * k) = 4 * (k * (n / k)) := by ring
        _ = 4 * n := by rw [hnk]
    omega
  have hr : M / H < m / t := by
    rw [Nat.div_lt_iff_lt_mul hHpos]
    have : (m / t) * (4 * t) ≤ (m / t) * H := Nat.mul_le_mul_left _ (by omega)
    have h4 : (m / t) * (4 * t) = 4 * m := by
      calc (m / t) * (4 * t) = 4 * (t * (m / t)) := by ring
        _ = 4 * m := by rw [hmt]
    omega
  rw [mem_detBox]
  simp only [quadToTup, DTup.k, DTup.q, DTup.t, DTup.r, DTup.eps]
  refine ⟨⟨hk1, by omega⟩, ⟨hq, le_trans (Nat.div_le_self _ _) (by omega)⟩, ⟨ht1, by omega⟩,
    ⟨hr, le_trans (Nat.div_le_self _ _) (by omega)⟩, ?_, ?_, ?_, ?_⟩
  · rcases hadj with h | h
    · left; omega
    · right; omega
  · rw [hnk, hmt]
  · rw [hnk]; exact hn.1
  · rw [hnk]; exact hn.2

theorem quadToTup_injOn (M K : ℕ) : Set.InjOn quadToTup (quadSet M K) := by
  intro x hx x' hx' h
  obtain ⟨⟨n, m⟩, ⟨k, t⟩⟩ := x
  obtain ⟨⟨n', m'⟩, ⟨k', t'⟩⟩ := x'
  simp only [quadSet, Finset.coe_filter, Set.mem_setOf_eq] at hx hx'
  simp only [quadToTup, Prod.mk.injEq] at h
  obtain ⟨hkk, hq, htt, hr, -⟩ := h
  subst hkk htt
  have hn : n = n' := by
    rw [← Nat.mul_div_cancel' hx.2.2.1, ← Nat.mul_div_cancel' hx'.2.2.1, hq]
  have hm : m = m' := by
    rw [← Nat.mul_div_cancel' hx.2.2.2, ← Nat.mul_div_cancel' hx'.2.2.2, hr]
  rw [hn, hm]

/-- **`C_K(M) ≤ D_Λ(M)`** whenever `4K ≤ H` (exact subbox dictionary). -/
theorem weighted_subbox_le_full_supply (M K H : ℕ) (hKH : 4 * K ≤ H) :
    CK M K ≤ DLambda M H := by
  rw [CK_eq_sum_quad]
  have himg : ∑ x ∈ quadSet M K, LambdaW (x.1.1 / x.2.1) * LambdaW (x.1.2 / x.2.2) =
      ∑ y ∈ (quadSet M K).image quadToTup, LambdaW y.q * LambdaW y.r := by
    rw [Finset.sum_image (quadToTup_injOn M K)]
    rfl
  rw [himg]
  unfold DLambda Dw
  refine Finset.sum_le_sum_of_subset_of_nonneg ?_ fun y _ _ =>
    mul_nonneg (LambdaW_nonneg _) (LambdaW_nonneg _)
  intro y hy
  obtain ⟨x, hx, rfl⟩ := Finset.mem_image.1 hy
  exact quadToTup_mem hKH hx

/-- The V71 instance `K = ⌊H/4⌋`. -/
theorem weighted_subbox_le_full_supply_quarter (M H : ℕ) : CK M (H / 4) ≤ DLambda M H :=
  weighted_subbox_le_full_supply M (H / 4) H (by omega)

end Erdos287.PostV64V71

import RequestProject.Erdos287.PostV87V90R.ContactCycle

/-!
# Erdős #287 — post-V87 → V90R: the affine adjacency compiler algebra

**ERDŐS #287 REMAINS OPEN.  This file is exact integer algebra.**

For positive integer slopes `aᵢ < aⱼ` with `d = aⱼ - aᵢ = gcd(aᵢ, aⱼ)` put

* `n⁻ᵢⱼ(t) = (aᵢ/d)(aⱼ t + 1)`, `n⁺ᵢⱼ(t) = (aⱼ/d)(aᵢ t + 1)`.

Proved unconditionally:

* `gcd_eq_sub_iff` — `gcd(aᵢ,aⱼ) = aⱼ - aᵢ ↔ (aⱼ - aᵢ) ∣ aᵢ`;
* `affine_adjacency` — **`n⁺ᵢⱼ(t) = n⁻ᵢⱼ(t) + 1`** for every `t`;
* the integrality / divisibility side conditions `nMinus_mul_d`, `nPlus_mul_d`,
  `form_dvd_nMinus`, `form_dvd_nPlus`, `nMinus_eq_cofactor_mul`, `nPlus_eq_cofactor_mul`.

`AffineContactCompiler r m K` is the finite compiler *data*: `K` affine forms `a t + 1` per
macroblock `j ∈ ZMod r`, with positivity, distinctness across graph edges and the gcd
condition on every edge of `ContactCycle r m`, plus an explicit scale-ratio bound.  No inhabitant
is constructed in this subtree for the W3 / `E287_11_4` parameters: the CRT prescription for
the slopes is not in the repository.  (The structure is *data with proved fields*, not a
`Prop`-valued placeholder.)
-/

namespace Erdos287.PostV87V90R

/-- `n⁻ᵢⱼ(t) = (aᵢ/d)(aⱼ t + 1)` with `d = aⱼ - aᵢ`. -/
def nMinus (ai aj t : ℕ) : ℕ := ai / (aj - ai) * (aj * t + 1)

/-- `n⁺ᵢⱼ(t) = (aⱼ/d)(aᵢ t + 1)` with `d = aⱼ - aᵢ`. -/
def nPlus (ai aj t : ℕ) : ℕ := aj / (aj - ai) * (ai * t + 1)

theorem sub_dvd_right {ai aj : ℕ} (hlt : ai < aj) (hd : (aj - ai) ∣ ai) : (aj - ai) ∣ aj := by
  have h := Nat.dvd_add hd (dvd_refl (aj - ai))
  rwa [Nat.add_sub_cancel' hlt.le] at h

/-- The gcd condition `d = gcd(aᵢ,aⱼ)` is equivalent to `d ∣ aᵢ` (for `aᵢ < aⱼ`). -/
theorem gcd_eq_sub_iff {ai aj : ℕ} (hlt : ai < aj) :
    Nat.gcd ai aj = aj - ai ↔ (aj - ai) ∣ ai := by
  constructor
  · intro h; rw [← h]; exact Nat.gcd_dvd_left _ _
  · intro hd
    exact Nat.dvd_antisymm (Nat.dvd_sub (Nat.gcd_dvd_right ai aj) (Nat.gcd_dvd_left ai aj))
      (Nat.dvd_gcd hd (sub_dvd_right hlt hd))

/-- **Affine adjacency identity.**  If `aᵢ < aⱼ` and `(aⱼ - aᵢ) ∣ aᵢ` (equivalently
`aⱼ - aᵢ = gcd(aᵢ,aⱼ)`), then `n⁺ᵢⱼ(t) = n⁻ᵢⱼ(t) + 1` for every `t`. -/
theorem affine_adjacency {ai aj : ℕ} (hlt : ai < aj) (hd : (aj - ai) ∣ ai) (t : ℕ) :
    nPlus ai aj t = nMinus ai aj t + 1 := by
  obtain ⟨d, rfl⟩ : ∃ d, aj = ai + d := ⟨aj - ai, by omega⟩
  have hdpos : 0 < d := by omega
  simp only [Nat.add_sub_cancel_left] at hd
  obtain ⟨u, rfl⟩ := hd
  unfold nPlus nMinus
  rw [Nat.add_sub_cancel_left]
  have e1 : d * u / d = u := Nat.mul_div_cancel_left _ hdpos
  have e2 : (d * u + d) / d = u + 1 := by
    rw [show d * u + d = d * (u + 1) by ring]; exact Nat.mul_div_cancel_left _ hdpos
  rw [e1, e2]
  ring

/-- Integrality: `n⁻ · d = aᵢ (aⱼ t + 1)`. -/
theorem nMinus_mul_d {ai aj : ℕ} (hd : (aj - ai) ∣ ai) (t : ℕ) :
    nMinus ai aj t * (aj - ai) = ai * (aj * t + 1) := by
  unfold nMinus
  rw [mul_comm (ai / (aj - ai)), mul_assoc, Nat.div_mul_cancel hd, mul_comm]

/-- Integrality: `n⁺ · d = aⱼ (aᵢ t + 1)`. -/
theorem nPlus_mul_d {ai aj : ℕ} (hlt : ai < aj) (hd : (aj - ai) ∣ ai) (t : ℕ) :
    nPlus ai aj t * (aj - ai) = aj * (ai * t + 1) := by
  unfold nPlus
  rw [mul_comm (aj / (aj - ai)), mul_assoc, Nat.div_mul_cancel (sub_dvd_right hlt hd), mul_comm]

/-- The prime-form value `aⱼ t + 1` divides `n⁻`, with cofactor `aᵢ/d`. -/
theorem nMinus_eq_cofactor_mul (ai aj t : ℕ) :
    nMinus ai aj t = (aj * t + 1) * (ai / (aj - ai)) := by
  unfold nMinus; ring

/-- The prime-form value `aᵢ t + 1` divides `n⁺`, with cofactor `aⱼ/d`. -/
theorem nPlus_eq_cofactor_mul (ai aj t : ℕ) :
    nPlus ai aj t = (ai * t + 1) * (aj / (aj - ai)) := by
  unfold nPlus; ring

theorem form_dvd_nMinus (ai aj t : ℕ) : (aj * t + 1) ∣ nMinus ai aj t :=
  ⟨_, nMinus_eq_cofactor_mul ai aj t⟩

theorem form_dvd_nPlus (ai aj t : ℕ) : (ai * t + 1) ∣ nPlus ai aj t :=
  ⟨_, nPlus_eq_cofactor_mul ai aj t⟩

/-- Concrete sanity fixture: slopes `2 < 4` (`d = 2 = gcd`), `t = 1`: `n⁻ = 5`, `n⁺ = 6`. -/
example : nMinus 2 4 1 = 5 ∧ nPlus 2 4 1 = 6 := by decide

/-- **Finite affine contact compiler (data with proved fields).**  `K` affine forms
`slope j i · t + 1` per macroblock `j ∈ ZMod r`; every edge of `ContactCycle r m` joins forms with
distinct slopes satisfying the gcd condition; all slopes lie within the ratio `ratio`. -/
structure AffineContactCompiler (r m K : ℕ) [NeZero r] where
  /-- The slopes. -/
  slope : ZMod r → Fin K → ℕ
  slope_pos : ∀ j i, 0 < slope j i
  /-- Forms in adjacent macroblocks have distinct slopes. -/
  edge_ne : ∀ j k i i', (ContactCycle r m).Adj j k → slope j i ≠ slope k i'
  /-- **Graph-edge gcd condition:** on every edge, `aⱼ - aᵢ = gcd(aᵢ, aⱼ)`. -/
  edge_gcd : ∀ j k i i', (ContactCycle r m).Adj j k → slope j i < slope k i' →
    Nat.gcd (slope j i) (slope k i') = slope k i' - slope j i
  /-- Explicit scale-ratio bound between any two slopes. -/
  ratio : ℕ
  scale_ratio : ∀ j i j' i', slope j' i' ≤ ratio * slope j i

namespace AffineContactCompiler

variable {r m K : ℕ} [NeZero r] (C : AffineContactCompiler r m K)

/-- On every oriented compiler edge, the two compiled positions are adjacent integers. -/
theorem edge_adjacent {j k : ZMod r} {i i' : Fin K} (hadj : (ContactCycle r m).Adj j k)
    (hlt : C.slope j i < C.slope k i') (t : ℕ) :
    nPlus (C.slope j i) (C.slope k i') t = nMinus (C.slope j i) (C.slope k i') t + 1 :=
  affine_adjacency hlt ((gcd_eq_sub_iff hlt).1 (C.edge_gcd j k i i' hadj hlt)) t

end AffineContactCompiler

end Erdos287.PostV87V90R

@@END_FILE@@
@@BEGIN_FILE bytes=11256 sha256=395650096773066d5d03abd3d65f86077bcf1e5e4153d76e5f224c95be170241 path=LEAN_PROJECT/RequestProject/Erdos287/PostV87V90R/AxiomAudit.lean@@
import RequestProject.Erdos287.PostV87V90R.ClosureDAG

/-!
# Erdős #287 (post-V87 → V90R) — axiom, provider and naming audit

* `#assert_std_axioms_v90 foo` — collects the transitive axioms of `foo` (as `#print axioms`
  does) and **fails the build** unless they are among `propext`, `Classical.choice`,
  `Quot.sound`.  `sorryAx`, custom axioms and the `native_decide` axiom `Lean.ofReduceBool` are
  therefore rejected.
* `#assert_unconditional foo` — fails if the *statement* of `foo` mentions any open provider /
  owner constant (an exact theorem must not secretly assume a provider).
* `#assert_conditional foo` — fails unless the statement of `foo` mentions an open provider
  (a conditional theorem must visibly carry its assumption).
* `#audit_providers_v90` — scans every declaration of `Erdos287.PostV87V90R` whose statement
  *concludes* a guarded provider / owner / open-statement constant and fails if it has no
  hypothesis of guarded type, or if it has a hypothesis of type `False` or `IsEmpty _`
  (vacuous `False.elim` / `IsEmpty` constructions).  Structure constructors and auxiliary
  recursors are skipped (their hypotheses *are* the fields).
-/

open Lean Elab Command Meta

/-- Fail unless `id` depends only on `propext`, `Classical.choice`, `Quot.sound`. -/
elab "#assert_std_axioms_v90 " id:ident : command => do
  let n ← liftCoreM <| realizeGlobalConstNoOverloadWithInfo id
  let axs ← liftCoreM <| Lean.collectAxioms n
  let ok : List Name := [``propext, ``Classical.choice, ``Quot.sound]
  for a in axs do
    unless ok.contains a do
      throwError "{n} depends on non-standard axiom {a}"
  logInfo m!"{n} : standard axioms only {axs}"

/-- Open provider / owner / open-statement constants guarded by the audit. -/
def guardedV90 : List Name :=
  [`Erdos287.PostV87V90R.WidthThreeMomentProvider, `Erdos287.PostV87V90R.WindowMomentData,
   `Erdos287.PostV87V90R.NarrowWidthClosureProvider, `Erdos287.PostV87V90R.E287_11_4_Provider,
   `Erdos287.PostV87V90R.AffineContactCompiler, `Erdos287.PostV87V90R.AnnulusBarrier287,
   `Erdos287.PostV87V90R.W3Statement, `Erdos287.PostV87V90R.TailExclusion,
   `Erdos287.PostV71V87.FiniteExclusionBelow,
   `Erdos287.PostV71V87.CrossScaleSynchronization287]

/-- Open *providers* (the analytic / closure inputs) — mention marks a theorem conditional. -/
def providersV90 : List Name :=
  [`Erdos287.PostV87V90R.WidthThreeMomentProvider, `Erdos287.PostV87V90R.WindowMomentData,
   `Erdos287.PostV87V90R.NarrowWidthClosureProvider, `Erdos287.PostV87V90R.E287_11_4_Provider,
   `Erdos287.PostV87V90R.AnnulusBarrier287, `Erdos287.PostV71V87.FiniteExclusionBelow,
   `Erdos287.PostV71V87.CrossScaleSynchronization287]

/-- Fail if the statement of `id` mentions an open provider. -/
elab "#assert_unconditional " id:ident : command => do
  let n ← liftCoreM <| realizeGlobalConstNoOverloadWithInfo id
  let ci ← getConstInfo n
  let used := ci.type.getUsedConstants
  for p in providersV90 do
    if used.contains p then
      throwError "{n} is labelled unconditional but its statement mentions provider {p}"
  logInfo m!"{n} : statement mentions no open provider"

/-- Fail unless the statement of `id` mentions an open provider. -/
elab "#assert_conditional " id:ident : command => do
  let n ← liftCoreM <| realizeGlobalConstNoOverloadWithInfo id
  let ci ← getConstInfo n
  let used := ci.type.getUsedConstants
  let hits := providersV90.filter used.contains
  if hits.isEmpty then
    throwError "{n} is labelled conditional but its statement mentions no open provider"
  logInfo m!"{n} : conditional on {hits}"

/-- Audit that no declaration of the subtree constructs a guarded provider outright or from a
vacuous hypothesis. -/
elab "#audit_providers_v90" : command => do
  let env ← getEnv
  let pre : Name := `Erdos287.PostV87V90R
  for p in guardedV90 do
    unless env.contains p do throwError "guarded constant {p} not found"
  let skipSuffix : List String :=
    ["mk", "casesOn", "recOn", "rec", "brecOn", "binductionOn", "below", "ibelow",
     "noConfusion", "noConfusionType", "ctorIdx", "ctorElim", "ctorElimType", "injEq", "inj",
     "sizeOf_spec"]
  let mut hits : Array MessageData := #[]
  let mut bad : Array Name := #[]
  for (n, ci) in env.constants.toList do
    unless pre.isPrefixOf n do continue
    if n.isInternal then continue
    if (ci matches .ctorInfo _) || (ci matches .recInfo _) then continue
    if let .str _ s := n then
      if skipSuffix.contains s then continue
    let res ← liftTermElabM <| forallTelescope ci.type fun xs concl => do
      let some h := concl.getAppFn.constName? | return none
      unless guardedV90.contains h do return none
      let mut good := false
      let mut vac := false
      for x in xs do
        let ty ← inferType x
        let hd ← forallTelescope ty fun _ b => pure b.getAppFn.constName?
        if let some hn := hd then
          if guardedV90.contains hn then good := true
        let ty' ← whnfR ty
        if let some hn := ty'.getAppFn.constName? then
          if hn == ``False || hn == ``IsEmpty || hn == ``Empty then vac := true
      return some (h, good, vac)
    if let some (h, good, vac) := res then
      hits := hits.push m!"{n} ⊢ {h} (guarded hypothesis: {good}, vacuous hypothesis: {vac})"
      if !good || vac then bad := bad.push n
  unless bad.isEmpty do
    throwError "provider constructed without a guarded hypothesis or from a vacuous one: {bad}"
  logInfo m!"provider audit passed; guarded-concluding declarations:\n{MessageData.joinSep hits.toList "\n"}"

@@BEGIN_FILE bytes=16614 sha256=6001faed20f21816836b4c29a110931ce47059543693d2264263b14c1c51fd88 path=LEAN_PROJECT/RequestProject/Erdos287/PostV87V90R/ClosureDAG.lean@@
import RequestProject.Erdos287.PostV87V90R.RegressionSuite

/-!
# Erdős #287 (post-V87 → V90R) — machine-checked closure DAG

Every node carries a status

* `exact` — kernel-proved here with no provider hypothesis;
* `conditional` — kernel-proved here from an explicit, never-constructed provider;
* `externalBank` — imported, previously kernel-checked material (the audited `PostV71V87`
  bank, Mathlib's Cauchy–Schwarz);
* `open` — an explicit provider interface or an unformalised claim;
* `retired` — a former closing route / owner shown insufficient or overstrong (KILL);

the Lean declaration it refers to (double-backtick literals, so renaming breaks the build) and
its direct dependencies.  Checked by `decide` (kernel reduction, no `native_decide`):

* `dag_acyclic` — every edge strictly decreases the rank;
* `dag_exact_closed` / `dag_exact_support` — exact nodes depend only on exact or external-bank
  nodes;
* `dag_conditional_has_open` — every conditional node traces to an open input;
* `dag_no_retired_use` — no exact or conditional node has a retired node in its support;
* `dag_erdos287_open`, `dag_erdos287_no_decl`, `dag_erdos287_open_support` — global #287 is
  OPEN, with no declaration claiming it, and its open inputs are exactly the W3 provider, the
  compiler existence, the narrow-width owner and the finite splice;
* `dag_crossScale_retired`, `dag_narrow_is_owner` — the cross-scale owner is retired and the
  current owner is the narrow-width closure.

The "no theorem name overstates its assumptions" check is a meta-level check in
`AxiomAudit.lean` (`#assert_conditional` / `#assert_unconditional`).
-/

namespace Erdos287.PostV87V90R.DAG

/-- Node status. -/
inductive Status
  | exact
  | conditional
  | externalBank
  | open
  | retired
  deriving DecidableEq, Repr

/-- Nodes. -/
inductive Node
  -- external banks
  | postV71V87Bank
  | mathlibCauchy
  -- model
  | modelCompat
  | harmonicWidth
  -- V88 retained exact facts
  | v88Replication
  | v88GuardOwner
  | v88LcmTransfer

  | 0, n => [n]
  | k + 1, n => (n :: (deps n).flatMap (supportWithin k)).dedup

  decide

  decide

/-- Global #287 depends on both the narrow-width owner and the finite splice, both open. -/

    narrowOwner ∈ support erdos287 ∧ finiteExclusion ∈ support erdos287 ∧
      status narrowOwner = .open ∧ status finiteExclusion = .open := by decide

import Mathlib

/-!
# Erdős #287 — post-V87 → V90R: the V90 cyclic contact graph

**ERDŐS #287 REMAINS OPEN.  This file is pure finite combinatorics.**

`ContactCycle r m` is the graph on `ZMod r` in which `x ~ y` iff the cyclic difference
`(y - x).val` lies in the *useful* range `m, m+1, …, r - m` (the circular complete graph
usually written `K_{r/m}`).  In the V90 notation `G(r, k)` the non-edges are the pairs at
cyclic distance `≤ k`, so `G(r, k) = ContactCycle r (k+1)`; we provide the abbreviation `G r k`.

Main results (all unconditional):

* `alpha_contactCycle` — for `1 ≤ m` and `2m ≤ r`, `α(ContactCycle r m) = m`;
  equivalently `α(G(r, m-1)) = m` (`alpha_G`).  The upper bound is a general proof via a
  Cauchy–Davenport-type estimate for sums with an interval in `ZMod r`
  (`card_shiftSet_ge`); no finite enumeration is used.
* `alpha_G_11_2` — `α(G(11,2)) = 3`, whose useful differences are `3,…,8`
  (`G_11_2_adj_iff`), plus the independent `decide` regression check
  `G_11_2_four_subsets_have_edge`.
* `width_ratio` — for `r = 4m+1`, `(r - m)/m = 3 + 1/m`; `widthParam_spec` — for every real
  `s > 3`, the explicit `m = ⌊1/(s-3)⌋₊ + 1 ≥ 1` satisfies `3 + 1/m < s`.
-/

open scoped BigOperators
open Classical

namespace Erdos287.PostV87V90R

/-- The useful-difference relation: `(y - x).val ∈ [m, r - m]`. -/
def UsefulDiff (r m : ℕ) (x y : ZMod r) : Prop := m ≤ (y - x).val ∧ (y - x).val ≤ r - m

/-- **The cyclic contact graph** on `ZMod r` with useful differences `m, …, r - m`. -/
def ContactCycle (r m : ℕ) [NeZero r] : SimpleGraph (ZMod r) where
  Adj x y := x ≠ y ∧ UsefulDiff r m x y
  symm := by
    intro x y ⟨hne, h1, h2⟩
    refine ⟨hne.symm, ?_⟩
    have hxy : x - y = -(y - x) := by ring
    have hz : y - x ≠ 0 := sub_ne_zero.mpr hne.symm
    have hlt := ZMod.val_lt (y - x)
    unfold UsefulDiff
    rw [hxy, ZMod.neg_val, if_neg hz]
    omega
  loopless := ⟨fun x h => h.1 rfl⟩

instance (r m : ℕ) [NeZero r] : DecidableRel (ContactCycle r m).Adj := fun x y => by
  unfold ContactCycle UsefulDiff; infer_instance

theorem contactCycle_adj_iff {r m : ℕ} [NeZero r] {x y : ZMod r} :
    (ContactCycle r m).Adj x y ↔ x ≠ y ∧ m ≤ (y - x).val ∧ (y - x).val ≤ r - m := Iff.rfl

/-- V90 notation: `G(r, k)` has non-edges at cyclic distance `≤ k`, i.e. useful differences
`k+1, …, r-k-1`. -/
abbrev G (r k : ℕ) [NeZero r] : SimpleGraph (ZMod r) := ContactCycle r (k + 1)

/-! ## Independence number (finite) -/

section Indep

variable {V : Type*} [Fintype V]

/-- A finset is independent if it contains no edge. -/
def IndepFinset (Γ : SimpleGraph V) (S : Finset V) : Prop :=
  ∀ x ∈ S, ∀ y ∈ S, ¬ Γ.Adj x y

/-- The independence number `α(Γ)` (maximum cardinality of an independent finset). -/
noncomputable def alpha (Γ : SimpleGraph V) : ℕ :=
  ((Finset.univ : Finset (Finset V)).filter (IndepFinset Γ)).sup Finset.card

theorem card_le_alpha {Γ : SimpleGraph V} {S : Finset V} (h : IndepFinset Γ S) :
    S.card ≤ alpha Γ :=
  Finset.le_sup (f := Finset.card) (Finset.mem_filter.2 ⟨Finset.mem_univ _, h⟩)

theorem alpha_le {Γ : SimpleGraph V} {k : ℕ}
    (h : ∀ S : Finset V, IndepFinset Γ S → S.card ≤ k) : alpha Γ ≤ k :=
  Finset.sup_le fun S hS => h S (Finset.mem_filter.1 hS).2

/-- **Pigeonhole consumer.**  A finset with more than `α(Γ)` elements contains an edge. -/
theorem exists_adj_of_alpha_lt {Γ : SimpleGraph V} {S : Finset V} (h : alpha Γ < S.card) :
    ∃ x ∈ S, ∃ y ∈ S, Γ.Adj x y := by
  by_contra hc
  push_neg at hc
  have := card_le_alpha (Γ := Γ) (S := S) hc
  omega

/-- `α` is attained. -/
theorem exists_indep_card_alpha (Γ : SimpleGraph V) :
    ∃ S : Finset V, IndepFinset Γ S ∧ S.card = alpha Γ := by
  obtain ⟨S, hS, h⟩ := Finset.exists_mem_eq_sup
    ((Finset.univ : Finset (Finset V)).filter (IndepFinset Γ))
    ⟨∅, Finset.mem_filter.2 ⟨Finset.mem_univ _, by simp [IndepFinset]⟩⟩ Finset.card
  exact ⟨S, (Finset.mem_filter.1 hS).2, h.symm⟩

end Indep

/-! ## Sums with an interval in `ZMod r` -/

section Sumset

variable {r : ℕ} [NeZero r]

/-- A nonempty subset of `ZMod r` closed under `+1` is everything. -/
theorem eq_univ_of_add_one_closed {T : Finset (ZMod r)} (hne : T.Nonempty)
    (h : ∀ x ∈ T, x + 1 ∈ T) : T = Finset.univ := by
  obtain ⟨x0, hx0⟩ := hne
  have hall : ∀ n : ℕ, x0 + (n : ZMod r) ∈ T := by
    intro n
    induction n with
    | zero => simpa using hx0
    | succ n ih =>
      have := h _ ih
      simpa [add_assoc] using this
  ext y
  simp only [Finset.mem_univ, iff_true]
  have := hall (y - x0).val
  rwa [ZMod.natCast_zmod_val, add_sub_cancel] at this

/-- The shifted interval sum `S + {c, c+1, …, c+L-1}`. -/
noncomputable def shiftSet (S : Finset (ZMod r)) (c L : ℕ) : Finset (ZMod r) :=
  Finset.univ.filter (fun x => ∃ s ∈ S, ∃ k < L, x = s + ((c + k : ℕ) : ZMod r))

theorem mem_shiftSet {S : Finset (ZMod r)} {c L : ℕ} {x : ZMod r} :
    x ∈ shiftSet S c L ↔ ∃ s ∈ S, ∃ k < L, x = s + ((c + k : ℕ) : ZMod r) := by
  simp [shiftSet]

theorem shiftSet_mono {S : Finset (ZMod r)} {c L : ℕ} :
    shiftSet S c L ⊆ shiftSet S c (L + 1) := by
  intro x hx
  obtain ⟨s, hs, k, hk, rfl⟩ := mem_shiftSet.1 hx
  exact mem_shiftSet.2 ⟨s, hs, k, by omega, rfl⟩

theorem add_one_mem_shiftSet {S : Finset (ZMod r)} {c L : ℕ} {x : ZMod r}
    (hx : x ∈ shiftSet S c L) : x + 1 ∈ shiftSet S c (L + 1) := by
  obtain ⟨s, hs, k, hk, rfl⟩ := mem_shiftSet.1 hx
  refine mem_shiftSet.2 ⟨s, hs, k + 1, by omega, ?_⟩
  push_cast; ring

theorem card_shiftSet_one (S : Finset (ZMod r)) (c : ℕ) :
    (shiftSet S c 1).card = S.card := by
  have : shiftSet S c 1 = S.image (fun s => s + (c : ZMod r)) := by
    ext x
    simp only [mem_shiftSet, Finset.mem_image]
    constructor
    · rintro ⟨s, hs, k, hk, rfl⟩
      have : k = 0 := by omega
      subst this
      exact ⟨s, hs, by simp⟩
    · rintro ⟨s, hs, rfl⟩
      exact ⟨s, hs, 0, by omega, by simp⟩
  rw [this, Finset.card_image_of_injective _ (add_left_injective _)]

/-- **Cauchy–Davenport-type bound for an interval.**  For nonempty `S ⊆ ZMod r` and
`L ≥ 1`, `|S + {c, …, c+L-1}| ≥ min(r, |S| + L - 1)`. -/
theorem card_shiftSet_ge {S : Finset (ZMod r)} (hS : S.Nonempty) (c : ℕ) :
    ∀ L : ℕ, 1 ≤ L → min r (S.card + L - 1) ≤ (shiftSet S c L).card := by
  intro L hL
  induction L, hL using Nat.le_induction with
  | base =>
    rw [card_shiftSet_one]
    exact min_le_right _ _
  | succ L hL ih =>
    by_cases hu : shiftSet S c L = Finset.univ
    · have h1 : (shiftSet S c L).card ≤ (shiftSet S c (L + 1)).card :=
        Finset.card_le_card shiftSet_mono
      rw [hu, Finset.card_univ, ZMod.card] at h1
      exact le_trans (min_le_left _ _) h1
    · have hne : (shiftSet S c L).Nonempty := by
        obtain ⟨s, hs⟩ := hS
        exact ⟨s + ((c + 0 : ℕ) : ZMod r), mem_shiftSet.2 ⟨s, hs, 0, by omega, rfl⟩⟩
      have : ¬ ∀ x ∈ shiftSet S c L, x + 1 ∈ shiftSet S c L :=
        fun h => hu (eq_univ_of_add_one_closed hne h)
      push_neg at this
      obtain ⟨x, hx, hx1⟩ := this
      have hsub : insert (x + 1) (shiftSet S c L) ⊆ shiftSet S c (L + 1) := by
        intro y hy
        rcases Finset.mem_insert.1 hy with rfl | hy
        · exact add_one_mem_shiftSet hx
        · exact shiftSet_mono hy
      have h2 := Finset.card_le_card hsub
      rw [Finset.card_insert_of_notMem hx1] at h2
      have : min r (S.card + (L + 1) - 1) ≤ min r (S.card + L - 1) + 1 := by omega
      omega

end Sumset

/-! ## `α(ContactCycle r m) = m` -/

section Alpha

variable {r m : ℕ} [NeZero r]

/-- **Upper bound.**  Every independent set of `ContactCycle r m` (`1 ≤ m`, `2m ≤ r`) has at
most `m` elements. -/
theorem indep_card_le (hm : 1 ≤ m) (hr : 2 * m ≤ r) {S : Finset (ZMod r)}
    (hS : IndepFinset (ContactCycle r m) S) : S.card ≤ m := by
  rcases S.eq_empty_or_nonempty with rfl | hne
  · simp
  have hdisj : Disjoint (shiftSet S m (r - 2 * m + 1)) S := by
    rw [Finset.disjoint_left]
    intro x hx hxS
    obtain ⟨s, hs, k, hk, rfl⟩ := mem_shiftSet.1 hx
    apply hS s hs _ hxS
    have hval : ((s + ((m + k : ℕ) : ZMod r)) - s).val = m + k := by
      rw [add_sub_cancel_left, ZMod.val_natCast, Nat.mod_eq_of_lt (by omega)]
    refine ⟨?_, ?_, ?_⟩
    · intro h
      have : ((s + ((m + k : ℕ) : ZMod r)) - s).val = 0 := by
        rw [← h, sub_self, ZMod.val_zero]
      omega
    · omega
    · omega
  have hcard := card_shiftSet_ge hne m (r - 2 * m + 1) (by omega)
  have hsum : (shiftSet S m (r - 2 * m + 1)).card + S.card ≤ r := by
    rw [← Finset.card_union_of_disjoint hdisj]
    calc _ ≤ (Finset.univ : Finset (ZMod r)).card := Finset.card_le_univ _
      _ = r := ZMod.card r
  have hSpos : 0 < S.card := Finset.card_pos.2 hne
  rcases le_total r (S.card + (r - 2 * m + 1) - 1) with h | h
  · rw [min_eq_left h] at hcard; omega
  · rw [min_eq_right h] at hcard; omega

/-- The arc `{0, 1, …, m-1}`. -/
noncomputable def arc (r m : ℕ) : Finset (ZMod r) :=
  (Finset.range m).image (fun i : ℕ => (i : ZMod r))

omit [NeZero r] in
theorem arc_card (hr : m ≤ r) : (arc r m).card = m := by
  unfold arc
  rw [Finset.card_image_of_injOn, Finset.card_range]
  intro i hi j hj hij
  simp only [Finset.coe_range, Set.mem_Iio] at hi hj
  have := congrArg ZMod.val hij
  simp only [ZMod.val_natCast] at this
  rwa [Nat.mod_eq_of_lt (by omega), Nat.mod_eq_of_lt (by omega)] at this

/-- **Lower bound.**  The arc of `m` consecutive vertices is independent. -/
theorem arc_indep (hr : 2 * m ≤ r) : IndepFinset (ContactCycle r m) (arc r m) := by
  intro x hx y hy hadj
  obtain ⟨i, hi, rfl⟩ := Finset.mem_image.1 hx
  obtain ⟨j, hj, rfl⟩ := Finset.mem_image.1 hy
  simp only [Finset.mem_range] at hi hj
  obtain ⟨hne, h1, h2⟩ := hadj
  rcases le_total i j with hij | hij
  · have : ((j : ZMod r) - (i : ZMod r)) = ((j - i : ℕ) : ZMod r) := by
      rw [Nat.cast_sub hij]
    rw [this, ZMod.val_natCast, Nat.mod_eq_of_lt (by omega)] at h1
    omega
  · have hc : ((j : ZMod r) - (i : ZMod r)) = -((i - j : ℕ) : ZMod r) := by
      rw [Nat.cast_sub hij]; ring
    have hz : ((i - j : ℕ) : ZMod r) ≠ 0 := by
      intro h0
      apply hne
      have : ((j : ZMod r) - (i : ZMod r)) = 0 := by rw [hc, h0, neg_zero]
      exact (sub_eq_zero.1 this).symm
    have hpos : 0 < i - j := by
      rcases Nat.eq_zero_or_pos (i - j) with h | h
      · exact absurd (by rw [h]; simp) hz
      · exact h
    rw [hc, ZMod.neg_val, if_neg hz, ZMod.val_natCast, Nat.mod_eq_of_lt (by omega)] at h2
    omega

/-- **V90 cyclic independence theorem.**  For `1 ≤ m` and `2m ≤ r`,
`α(ContactCycle r m) = m`. -/
theorem alpha_contactCycle (hm : 1 ≤ m) (hr : 2 * m ≤ r) :
    alpha (ContactCycle r m) = m := by
  apply le_antisymm
  · exact alpha_le fun S hS => indep_card_le hm hr hS
  · calc m = (arc r m).card := (arc_card (by omega)).symm
      _ ≤ _ := card_le_alpha (arc_indep hr)

/-- The same theorem in V90 notation: `α(G(r, m-1)) = m` for `1 ≤ m`, `2m ≤ r`. -/
theorem alpha_G (hm : 1 ≤ m) (hr : 2 * m ≤ r) : alpha (G r (m - 1)) = m := by
  have : m - 1 + 1 = m := by omega
  unfold G; rw [this]; exact alpha_contactCycle hm hr

/-- **Occupancy-to-edge consumer.**  Any `m + 1` vertices of `ContactCycle r m` contain a
useful edge. -/
theorem exists_useful_edge (hm : 1 ≤ m) (hr : 2 * m ≤ r) {O : Finset (ZMod r)}
    (hO : m + 1 ≤ O.card) : ∃ x ∈ O, ∃ y ∈ O, (ContactCycle r m).Adj x y :=
  exists_adj_of_alpha_lt (by rw [alpha_contactCycle hm hr]; omega)

end Alpha

/-! ## The specialisation `G(11,2)` -/

/-- The useful differences of `G(11,2)` are exactly `3, 4, 5, 6, 7, 8`. -/
theorem G_11_2_adj_iff (x y : ZMod 11) :
    (G 11 2).Adj x y ↔ (y - x).val ∈ ({3, 4, 5, 6, 7, 8} : Finset ℕ) := by
  have hlt := ZMod.val_lt (y - x)
  simp only [G, contactCycle_adj_iff, Finset.mem_insert, Finset.mem_singleton]
  constructor
  · rintro ⟨-, h1, h2⟩; omega
  · intro h
    refine ⟨?_, by omega, by omega⟩
    rintro rfl
    simp at h

/-- **`α(G(11,2)) = 3`** (the general theorem with `m = 3`, `r = 11`). -/
theorem alpha_G_11_2 : alpha (G 11 2) = 3 := alpha_G (m := 3) (by norm_num) (by norm_num)

set_option maxRecDepth 20000 in
/-- **Finite regression check** (independent of the general proof, kernel `decide` on a Boolean
enumeration of all 330 four-subsets of `{0,…,10}`): every 4-subset contains a pair whose cyclic
difference `(y - x) mod 11` lies in `{3,…,8}`. -/
theorem G_11_2_four_subsets_have_edge :
    ((List.range 11).sublistsLen 4).all
      (fun l => l.any fun x => l.any fun y => decide ((y + 11 - x) % 11 ∈ [3, 4, 5, 6, 7, 8])) =
      true := by
  decide

/-- Regression: `{0,1,2}` is an independent 3-set of `G(11,2)` — three occupied blocks do
**not** force a contact. -/
theorem G_11_2_three_indep :
    ∀ x ∈ ({0, 1, 2} : Finset (ZMod 11)), ∀ y ∈ ({0, 1, 2} : Finset (ZMod 11)),
      (y - x).val ∉ ({3, 4, 5, 6, 7, 8} : Finset ℕ) := by
  decide

/-! ## Width ratio -/

/-- For `r = 4m + 1`, `(r - m)/m = 3 + 1/m`. -/
theorem width_ratio {m r : ℕ} (hm : 1 ≤ m) (hr : r = 4 * m + 1) :
    ((r : ℝ) - m) / m = 3 + 1 / m := by
  subst hr
  have : (m : ℝ) ≠ 0 := by exact_mod_cast (by omega : m ≠ 0)
  push_cast
  field_simp
  ring

/-- The explicit width parameter `m(s) = ⌊1/(s-3)⌋₊ + 1`. -/
noncomputable def widthParam (s : ℝ) : ℕ := ⌊1 / (s - 3)⌋₊ + 1

theorem one_le_widthParam (s : ℝ) : 1 ≤ widthParam s := by
  unfold widthParam; omega

/-- **Constructive width choice.**  For every real `s > 3`, `m = ⌊1/(s-3)⌋₊ + 1 ≥ 1`
satisfies `3 + 1/m < s`. -/
theorem widthParam_spec {s : ℝ} (hs : 3 < s) : 3 + 1 / (widthParam s : ℝ) < s := by
  unfold widthParam
  have hpos : 0 < s - 3 := by linarith
  have hlt : 1 / (s - 3) < (⌊1 / (s - 3)⌋₊ : ℝ) + 1 := Nat.lt_floor_add_one _
  have hm : (0 : ℝ) < (⌊1 / (s - 3)⌋₊ : ℝ) + 1 := by positivity
  push_cast
  have : 1 / ((⌊1 / (s - 3)⌋₊ : ℝ) + 1) < s - 3 := by
    rw [div_lt_iff₀ hm]
    rw [div_lt_iff₀ hpos] at hlt
    linarith
  linarith

theorem exists_width_parameter {s : ℝ} (hs : 3 < s) :
    ∃ m : ℕ, 1 ≤ m ∧ 3 + 1 / (m : ℝ) < s :=
  ⟨widthParam s, one_le_widthParam s, widthParam_spec hs⟩

/-- For `r = 4m+1` with `m = widthParam s`, the graph width `(r - m)/m` is below `s`. -/
theorem width_lt_of_widthParam {s : ℝ} (hs : 3 < s) :
    (((4 * widthParam s + 1 : ℕ) : ℝ) - widthParam s) / widthParam s < s := by
  rw [width_ratio (one_le_widthParam s) rfl]
  exact widthParam_spec hs

/-! ## The general V90 annulus barrier (isolated; OPEN here, unused downstream)

The real-line averaging theorem "edges only at log-distance in `[D₋, D₊]` ⟹
`α ≥ ⌈|V| D₋ / (D₋ + D₊)⌉`" is **not** proved here: it needs a continuous averaging over
shifts.  It is recorded as the explicit statement `AnnulusBarrier287` and is **not used** by any
downstream theorem: the W3 and `E287_11_4` consumers use only `alpha_contactCycle`. -/

/-- **(OPEN geometric provider, unused downstream.)** -/
def AnnulusBarrier287 : Prop :=
  ∀ (Dm Dp : ℝ), 0 < Dm → Dm ≤ Dp → ∀ (V : Finset ℝ) (Γ : SimpleGraph ℝ),
    (∀ x ∈ V, ∀ y ∈ V, Γ.Adj x y → Dm ≤ |x - y| ∧ |x - y| ≤ Dp) →
    ∃ S ⊆ V, (∀ x ∈ S, ∀ y ∈ S, ¬ Γ.Adj x y) ∧
      (V.card : ℝ) * Dm / (Dm + Dp) ≤ S.card

end Erdos287.PostV87V90R
