import RequestProject.Erdos287.PostV71V87

/-!
# Erdős #287 — post-V87 → V90R: compatibility with the audited `PostV71V87` model

**ERDŐS #287 REMAINS OPEN.**

This subtree introduces **no new source model**.  It consumes, unchanged, the exact objects of
`Erdos287.PostV71V87`:

* `Word` — selected denominators `A ⊆ [a, M]`, both endpoints selected, gap-two
  (`gap : ∀ x, a ≤ x → x + 1 ≤ M → x ∈ A ∨ x + 1 ∈ A`);
* `ExactWord` — a `Word` with reciprocal mass exactly one;
* `Word.selRow q` — the selected part of the `q`-row;
* `ExactWord.toCounterexample` / `ofCounterexample` — the two directions of the exact
  equivalence with the project-wide `Erdos287Counterexample`.

The adapter theorems below are the only bridge: `counterexample_iff_exactWord` (an exact
equivalence), the endpoint identifications, and the harmonic width bounds
`e(a - 1) < M ≤ e²(a + 1)` re-exported for exact words.  The *omitted* denominators of a word
are the window positions not in `A`; `omitted_neighbours` restates the gap-two condition in
that language.
-/

open scoped BigOperators

namespace Erdos287.PostV87V90R

open Erdos287 Erdos287.PostV71V87

/-- **Model compatibility (exact equivalence).**  A finite set is an Erdős #287 counterexample
iff it is the selected set of an exact word of the `PostV71V87` model with left endpoint `> 1`. -/
theorem counterexample_iff_exactWord (A : Finset ℕ) :
    Erdos287Counterexample A ↔ ∃ W : ExactWord, 1 < W.a ∧ W.A = A := by
  constructor
  · intro h
    exact ⟨ofCounterexample h, ofCounterexample_one_lt_a h, rfl⟩
  · rintro ⟨W, ha, rfl⟩
    exact W.toCounterexample ha

/-- The left endpoint of the word attached to a counterexample is `min A`. -/
theorem ofCounterexample_a {A : Finset ℕ} (h : Erdos287Counterexample A) :
    (ofCounterexample h).a = A.min' h.nonempty := rfl

/-- The right endpoint of the word attached to a counterexample is `max A`. -/
theorem ofCounterexample_M {A : Finset ℕ} (h : Erdos287Counterexample A) :
    (ofCounterexample h).M = A.max' h.nonempty := rfl

/-- **Harmonic lower width bound** for exact words: `e (a - 1) < M`. -/
theorem ExactWord.exp_lower (W : ExactWord) (ha : 1 < W.a) :
    Real.exp 1 * ((W.a : ℝ) - 1) < W.M := by
  have h := (W.toCounterexample ha).toGap2CE.exp_lower
  rwa [W.gap2_N_eq ha, W.gap2_M_eq ha] at h

/-- **Harmonic upper width bound** for exact words: `M ≤ e² (a + 1)`. -/
theorem ExactWord.exp_upper (W : ExactWord) (ha : 1 < W.a) :
    (W.M : ℝ) ≤ Real.exp 1 ^ 2 * ((W.a : ℝ) + 1) := by
  have h := (W.toCounterexample ha).toGap2CE.exp_upper
  rwa [W.gap2_N_eq ha, W.gap2_M_eq ha] at h

/-- Gap-two in the language of omitted denominators: two consecutive window positions cannot
both be omitted. -/
theorem omitted_neighbours (W : Word) {n : ℕ} (hn : W.a ≤ n) (hn1 : n + 1 ≤ W.M)
    (h0 : n ∉ W.A) (h1 : n + 1 ∉ W.A) : False :=
  (W.gap n hn hn1).elim h0 h1

/-- Every selected denominator of a `q`-row is in the selected row `selRow q`. -/
theorem mem_selRow_iff (W : Word) {q n : ℕ} : n ∈ W.selRow q ↔ n ∈ W.A ∧ q ∣ n := by
  simp [Word.selRow]

end Erdos287.PostV87V90R

import Mathlib

/-!
# Erdős #287 — post-V87 → V90R: the repaired pair-energy (moment) consumer

**ERDŐS #287 REMAINS OPEN.  This file is finite probability / real algebra only.**

We work in a *finite* weighted probability space `F : FiniteWeights` (finitely many integer
parameters `t ∈ F.T` with non-negative weights summing to one), so there is no hidden
measure-theoretic content.  For non-negative integer block counts `Y t j` (blocks `j` in a
finite type `ι`) put

* `P t = ∑ⱼ Y t j`, `Q t = ∑ⱼ C(Y t j, 2)`, `Z t = #{j : Y t j > 0}`.

Results (all unconditional):

* `pointwise_cauchy` — `P² ≤ Z (P + 2Q)` at every parameter;
* `moment_cauchy` — `(𝔼P)² ≤ (𝔼Z)(𝔼P + 2𝔼Q)`, hence `𝔼Z ≥ (𝔼P)²/(𝔼P + 2𝔼Q)`
  (`expected_occupancy_lower`);
* `exists_occupancy_of_moment` — if `(𝔼P)² > m(𝔼P + 2𝔼Q)` there is a parameter `t`
  **of positive weight** with `Z t ≥ m + 1` (an actual existence theorem);
* `moment_numerical` / `occupancy_of_normalized_moments` — the `C`-normalisation: from
  `𝔼P ≥ μ > 0`, `𝔼Q ≤ C μ²/(2r)`, `C < r/m` and `μ > m r/(r - m C)`, occupancy `≥ m + 1`;
* `occupancy_11_3` — the specialisation `r = 11`, `m = 3`: `C < 11/3` **together with**
  `μ > 33/(11 - 3C)`;
* `qbal_le_pairs` — the exact integer balancing lemma: if at most `m` blocks are occupied,
  `∑ⱼ C(Yⱼ,2) ≥ q_m(∑ⱼ Yⱼ)` where `q_m(n) = ∑_{i<n} ⌊i/m⌋` is the balanced pair count;
* `sharp_mean_consumer` — the finite-weight Jensen version: if `Z ≤ m` on the support then
  `𝔼Q ≥ q̃_m(𝔼P)` (piecewise-linear interpolation of `q_m`), hence
  `exists_occupancy_of_sharp`: `𝔼Q < q̃_m(𝔼P)` ⟹ a parameter with `Z ≥ m + 1`.

The obsolete constant `11/6` is **not** used anywhere; see `RegressionSuite.lean`.
-/

open scoped BigOperators
open Finset

namespace Erdos287.PostV87V90R

/-- A finite weighted probability space on integer parameters. -/
structure FiniteWeights where
  /-- The finite parameter set. -/
  T : Finset ℕ
  /-- The weights. -/
  w : ℕ → ℝ
  w_nonneg : ∀ t ∈ T, 0 ≤ w t
  w_sum : ∑ t ∈ T, w t = 1

namespace FiniteWeights

variable (F : FiniteWeights)

/-- Expectation. -/
noncomputable def E (f : ℕ → ℝ) : ℝ := ∑ t ∈ F.T, F.w t * f t

theorem E_const (c : ℝ) : F.E (fun _ => c) = c := by
  simp [E, ← Finset.sum_mul, F.w_sum]

theorem E_add (f g : ℕ → ℝ) : F.E (fun t => f t + g t) = F.E f + F.E g := by
  simp [E, mul_add, Finset.sum_add_distrib]

theorem E_smul (c : ℝ) (f : ℕ → ℝ) : F.E (fun t => c * f t) = c * F.E f := by
  simp [E, Finset.mul_sum]; refine Finset.sum_congr rfl fun t _ => by ring

theorem E_mono {f g : ℕ → ℝ} (h : ∀ t ∈ F.T, 0 < F.w t → f t ≤ g t) : F.E f ≤ F.E g := by
  unfold E
  apply Finset.sum_le_sum
  intro t ht
  rcases (F.w_nonneg t ht).lt_or_eq with hw | hw
  · exact mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left (h t ht hw) hw.le
  · rw [← hw]; simp

theorem E_nonneg {f : ℕ → ℝ} (h : ∀ t ∈ F.T, 0 ≤ f t) : 0 ≤ F.E f :=
  Finset.sum_nonneg fun t ht => mul_nonneg (F.w_nonneg t ht) (h t ht)

end FiniteWeights

/-! ## Block statistics -/

section Blocks

variable {ι : Type*} [Fintype ι]

/-- Total count `P = ∑ⱼ Yⱼ`. -/
def Pcount (Y : ℕ → ι → ℕ) (t : ℕ) : ℕ := ∑ j, Y t j

/-- Pair count `Q = ∑ⱼ C(Yⱼ, 2)`. -/
def Qcount (Y : ℕ → ι → ℕ) (t : ℕ) : ℕ := ∑ j, (Y t j).choose 2

/-- Number of occupied blocks `Z = #{j : Yⱼ > 0}`. -/
def Zcount (Y : ℕ → ι → ℕ) (t : ℕ) : ℕ := (univ.filter (fun j => 0 < Y t j)).card

theorem sq_eq_add_two_choose (n : ℕ) : n ^ 2 = n + 2 * n.choose 2 := by
  induction n with
  | zero => simp
  | succ n ih =>
    rw [Nat.choose_succ_succ, Nat.choose_one_right]
    nlinarith [ih]

theorem sq_eq_add_two_choose_real (n : ℕ) : (n : ℝ) ^ 2 = n + 2 * (n.choose 2 : ℝ) := by
  exact_mod_cast sq_eq_add_two_choose n

/-- `P + 2Q = ∑ⱼ Yⱼ²`. -/
theorem P_add_two_Q (Y : ℕ → ι → ℕ) (t : ℕ) :
    (Pcount Y t : ℝ) + 2 * Qcount Y t = ∑ j, ((Y t j : ℕ) : ℝ) ^ 2 := by
  simp only [Pcount, Qcount, Nat.cast_sum, Finset.mul_sum, ← Finset.sum_add_distrib]
  exact Finset.sum_congr rfl fun j _ => (sq_eq_add_two_choose_real _).symm

theorem Zcount_eq_sum (Y : ℕ → ι → ℕ) (t : ℕ) :
    (Zcount Y t : ℝ) = ∑ j, (if 0 < Y t j then (1 : ℝ) else 0) := by
  simp [Zcount]

/-- **Pointwise Cauchy:** `P² ≤ Z (P + 2Q)`. -/
theorem pointwise_cauchy (Y : ℕ → ι → ℕ) (t : ℕ) :
    (Pcount Y t : ℝ) ^ 2 ≤ Zcount Y t * ((Pcount Y t : ℝ) + 2 * Qcount Y t) := by
  rw [P_add_two_Q, Zcount_eq_sum]
  have : (Pcount Y t : ℝ) = ∑ j, ((Y t j : ℕ) : ℝ) := by simp [Pcount]
  rw [this]
  apply Finset.sum_sq_le_sum_mul_sum_of_sq_eq_mul
  · intro j _; split_ifs <;> norm_num
  · intro j _; positivity
  · intro j _
    split_ifs with h
    · ring
    · have : Y t j = 0 := by omega
      simp [this]

variable (F : FiniteWeights)

/-- **Expectation Cauchy:** `(𝔼P)² ≤ (𝔼Z)(𝔼P + 2𝔼Q)`. -/
theorem moment_cauchy (Y : ℕ → ι → ℕ) :
    F.E (fun t => Pcount Y t) ^ 2 ≤
      F.E (fun t => Zcount Y t) * (F.E (fun t => Pcount Y t) + 2 * F.E (fun t => Qcount Y t)) := by
  have hP : F.E (fun t => Pcount Y t) = ∑ x ∈ F.T ×ˢ (univ : Finset ι), F.w x.1 * Y x.1 x.2 := by
    simp [FiniteWeights.E, Pcount, Finset.sum_product, Finset.mul_sum]
  have hZ : F.E (fun t => Zcount Y t) =
      ∑ x ∈ F.T ×ˢ (univ : Finset ι), F.w x.1 * (if 0 < Y x.1 x.2 then (1 : ℝ) else 0) := by
    simp only [FiniteWeights.E, Zcount_eq_sum, Finset.sum_product, Finset.mul_sum]
  have hS : F.E (fun t => Pcount Y t) + 2 * F.E (fun t => Qcount Y t) =
      ∑ x ∈ F.T ×ˢ (univ : Finset ι), F.w x.1 * ((Y x.1 x.2 : ℕ) : ℝ) ^ 2 := by
    rw [← F.E_smul, ← F.E_add]
    simp only [FiniteWeights.E, P_add_two_Q, Finset.sum_product, Finset.mul_sum]
  rw [hS, hP, hZ]
  apply Finset.sum_sq_le_sum_mul_sum_of_sq_eq_mul
  · intro x hx
    have := F.w_nonneg x.1 (Finset.mem_product.1 hx).1
    split_ifs <;> simp [this]
  · intro x hx
    have := F.w_nonneg x.1 (Finset.mem_product.1 hx).1
    positivity
  · intro x _
    split_ifs with h
    · ring
    · have : Y x.1 x.2 = 0 := by omega
      simp [this]

/-- **Expected occupancy lower bound** `𝔼Z ≥ (𝔼P)²/(𝔼P + 2𝔼Q)` (when the denominator is
positive). -/
theorem expected_occupancy_lower (Y : ℕ → ι → ℕ)
    (hden : 0 < F.E (fun t => Pcount Y t) + 2 * F.E (fun t => Qcount Y t)) :
    F.E (fun t => Pcount Y t) ^ 2 /
        (F.E (fun t => Pcount Y t) + 2 * F.E (fun t => Qcount Y t)) ≤
      F.E (fun t => Zcount Y t) := by
  rw [div_le_iff₀ hden]
  exact moment_cauchy F Y

/-- **Moment-to-occupancy existence theorem.**  If `(𝔼P)² > m (𝔼P + 2𝔼Q)` then some
parameter of positive weight has at least `m + 1` occupied blocks. -/
theorem exists_occupancy_of_moment (Y : ℕ → ι → ℕ) (m : ℕ)
    (h : (m : ℝ) * (F.E (fun t => Pcount Y t) + 2 * F.E (fun t => Qcount Y t)) <
      F.E (fun t => Pcount Y t) ^ 2) :
    ∃ t ∈ F.T, 0 < F.w t ∧ m + 1 ≤ Zcount Y t := by
  by_contra hc
  push_neg at hc
  have hZ : F.E (fun t => Zcount Y t) ≤ m := by
    calc F.E (fun t => Zcount Y t) ≤ F.E (fun _ => (m : ℝ)) := by
          apply F.E_mono
          intro t ht hw
          have := hc t ht hw
          exact_mod_cast (by omega : Zcount Y t ≤ m)
      _ = m := F.E_const _
  have hS : 0 ≤ F.E (fun t => Pcount Y t) + 2 * F.E (fun t => Qcount Y t) := by
    have h1 : 0 ≤ F.E (fun t => Pcount Y t) := F.E_nonneg fun t _ => by positivity
    have h2 : 0 ≤ F.E (fun t => Qcount Y t) := F.E_nonneg fun t _ => by positivity
    linarith
  have := moment_cauchy F Y
  have := mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right hZ hS
  linarith

/-! ## `C`-normalisation -/

/-- **Numerical core of the `C`-normalisation.**  If `x ≥ μ > 0`, `0 ≤ q ≤ C μ²/(2r)`,
`C < r/m` and `μ > m r/(r - m C)` (with `r > 0`, `m ≥ 1`), then `x² > m (x + 2q)`. -/
theorem moment_numerical {x q μ C r : ℝ} {m : ℕ} (hr : 0 < r) (hm : 1 ≤ m) (hμ : 0 < μ)
    (hx : μ ≤ x) (hq0 : 0 ≤ q) (hq : q ≤ C * μ ^ 2 / (2 * r)) (hC : C < r / m)
    (hμbig : (m : ℝ) * r / (r - m * C) < μ) : (m : ℝ) * (x + 2 * q) < x ^ 2 := by
  have hm' : (1 : ℝ) ≤ m := by exact_mod_cast hm
  have hmpos : (0 : ℝ) < m := by linarith
  have hD : 0 < r - m * C := by
    rw [lt_div_iff₀ hmpos] at hC; linarith
  have hC0 : 0 ≤ C := by
    have : 0 ≤ C * μ ^ 2 / (2 * r) := le_trans hq0 hq
    have hpos : 0 < μ ^ 2 / (2 * r) := by positivity
    have : 0 ≤ C * (μ ^ 2 / (2 * r)) := by rw [← mul_div_assoc]; exact this
    exact nonneg_of_mul_nonneg_left this hpos
  have hμD : (m : ℝ) * r < μ * (r - m * C) := by
    rw [div_lt_iff₀ hD] at hμbig; linarith
  -- `μ ≥ m`
  have hμm : (m : ℝ) ≤ μ := by
    have h1 : μ * (r - m * C) ≤ μ * r :=
      mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left (by nlinarith [mul_nonneg hmpos.le hC0]) hμ.le
    have h2 : (m : ℝ) * r < μ * r := by linarith
    exact le_of_lt (lt_of_mul_lt_mul_right h2 hr.le)
  -- `μ² - mμ > m C μ²/r`
  have key : (m : ℝ) * C * μ ^ 2 / r < μ ^ 2 - m * μ := by
    rw [div_lt_iff₀ hr]
    nlinarith
  have hq2 : (m : ℝ) * (2 * q) ≤ m * C * μ ^ 2 / r := by
    have : 2 * q ≤ C * μ ^ 2 / r := by
      have := mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left hq (by norm_num : (0 : ℝ) ≤ 2)
      calc 2 * q ≤ 2 * (C * μ ^ 2 / (2 * r)) := this
        _ = C * μ ^ 2 / r := by field_simp
    calc (m : ℝ) * (2 * q) ≤ m * (C * μ ^ 2 / r) := mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left this hmpos.le
      _ = m * C * μ ^ 2 / r := by ring
  have hmono : μ ^ 2 - m * μ ≤ x ^ 2 - m * x := by nlinarith
  nlinarith

/-- **Normalised moments ⟹ occupancy.**  With `r > 0`, `m ≥ 1`: if `𝔼P ≥ μ > 0`,
`𝔼Q ≤ C μ²/(2r)`, `C < r/m` and `μ > m r/(r - mC)`, then some parameter of positive weight has
at least `m + 1` occupied blocks. -/
theorem occupancy_of_normalized_moments (Y : ℕ → ι → ℕ) {μ C r : ℝ} {m : ℕ} (hr : 0 < r)
    (hm : 1 ≤ m) (hμ : 0 < μ) (hP : μ ≤ F.E (fun t => Pcount Y t))
    (hQ : F.E (fun t => Qcount Y t) ≤ C * μ ^ 2 / (2 * r)) (hC : C < r / m)
    (hμbig : (m : ℝ) * r / (r - m * C) < μ) :
    ∃ t ∈ F.T, 0 < F.w t ∧ m + 1 ≤ Zcount Y t :=
  exists_occupancy_of_moment F Y m
    (moment_numerical hr hm hμ hP (F.E_nonneg fun t _ => by positivity) hQ hC hμbig)

/-- **Specialisation `r = 11`, `m = 3`:** `C < 11/3` *together with* the first-moment
condition `μ > 33/(11 - 3C)` gives a parameter with at least four occupied blocks. -/
theorem occupancy_11_3 (Y : ℕ → ι → ℕ) {μ C : ℝ} (hμ : 0 < μ)
    (hP : μ ≤ F.E (fun t => Pcount Y t))
    (hQ : F.E (fun t => Qcount Y t) ≤ C * μ ^ 2 / (2 * 11)) (hC : C < 11 / 3)
    (hμbig : 33 / (11 - 3 * C) < μ) :
    ∃ t ∈ F.T, 0 < F.w t ∧ 4 ≤ Zcount Y t := by
  have := occupancy_of_normalized_moments F Y (r := 11) (m := 3) (by norm_num) (by norm_num) hμ
    hP hQ (by norm_num; linarith) (by norm_num; linarith)
  simpa using this

/-! ## Exact integer balancing and the sharp finite-mean consumer -/

/-- The balanced pair count `q_m(n) = ∑_{i<n} ⌊i/m⌋`: the minimum of `∑ C(yⱼ,2)` over
distributions of `n` among at most `m` blocks (attained by the balanced distribution). -/
def qbal (m n : ℕ) : ℕ := ∑ i ∈ range n, i / m

theorem qbal_succ (m n : ℕ) : qbal m (n + 1) = qbal m n + n / m := by
  simp [qbal, Finset.sum_range_succ]

theorem choose_two_eq_pred (k : ℕ) (hk : 1 ≤ k) : k.choose 2 = (k - 1).choose 2 + (k - 1) := by
  obtain ⟨j, rfl⟩ : ∃ j, k = j + 1 := ⟨k - 1, by omega⟩
  simp [Nat.choose_succ_succ, add_comm]

/-- **Exact integer balancing lemma.**  If at most `m` of the counts `yⱼ` are positive then
`q_m(∑ yⱼ) ≤ ∑ C(yⱼ, 2)`. -/
theorem qbal_le_pairs (m : ℕ) : ∀ (n : ℕ) (y : ι → ℕ), ∑ j, y j = n →
    (univ.filter (fun j => 0 < y j)).card ≤ m → qbal m n ≤ ∑ j, (y j).choose 2 := by
  classical
  intro n
  induction n with
  | zero => intro y _ _; simp [qbal]
  | succ n ih =>
    intro y hsum hcard
    have hne : (univ : Finset ι).Nonempty := by
      by_contra h
      rw [Finset.not_nonempty_iff_eq_empty] at h
      rw [h] at hsum; simp at hsum
    obtain ⟨j0, -, hmax⟩ := Finset.exists_max_image univ y hne
    -- `n + 1 ≤ Z · y j0 ≤ m · y j0`
    have hbound : n + 1 ≤ m * y j0 := by
      have h1 : ∑ j, y j = ∑ j ∈ univ.filter (fun j => 0 < y j), y j := by
        rw [Finset.sum_filter]
        exact Finset.sum_congr rfl fun j _ => by split_ifs with h <;> omega
      have h2 : ∑ j ∈ univ.filter (fun j => 0 < y j), y j ≤
          (univ.filter (fun j => 0 < y j)).card * y j0 := by
        have := Finset.sum_le_card_nsmul (univ.filter (fun j => 0 < y j)) y (y j0)
          (fun j _ => hmax j (mem_univ _))
        simpa using this
      calc n + 1 = ∑ j, y j := hsum.symm
        _ ≤ _ := h1 ▸ h2
        _ ≤ m * y j0 := Nat.mul_le_mul_right _ hcard
    have hm : 0 < m := by
      rcases Nat.eq_zero_or_pos m with h | h
      · rw [h] at hbound; omega
      · exact h
    have hy0 : 1 ≤ y j0 := by
      rcases Nat.eq_zero_or_pos (y j0) with h | h
      · rw [h] at hbound; omega
      · exact h
    set y' : ι → ℕ := Function.update y j0 (y j0 - 1) with hy'
    have hsum' : ∑ j, y' j = n := by
      have e1 := Finset.add_sum_erase univ y (mem_univ j0)
      have e2 := Finset.add_sum_erase univ y' (mem_univ j0)
      have e3 : ∑ j ∈ univ.erase j0, y' j = ∑ j ∈ univ.erase j0, y j :=
        Finset.sum_congr rfl fun j hj => by
          rw [hy', Function.update_of_ne (Finset.ne_of_mem_erase hj)]
      have : y' j0 = y j0 - 1 := by simp [hy']
      omega
    have hcard' : (univ.filter (fun j => 0 < y' j)).card ≤ m := by
      refine le_trans (Finset.card_le_card ?_) hcard
      intro j hj
      simp only [Finset.mem_filter, mem_univ, true_and] at hj ⊢
      by_cases hj0 : j = j0
      · subst hj0; omega
      · rwa [hy', Function.update_of_ne hj0] at hj
    have hih := ih y' hsum' hcard'
    have hpairs : ∑ j, (y j).choose 2 = ∑ j, (y' j).choose 2 + (y j0 - 1) := by
      have e1 := Finset.add_sum_erase univ (fun j => (y j).choose 2) (mem_univ j0)
      have e2 := Finset.add_sum_erase univ (fun j => (y' j).choose 2) (mem_univ j0)
      have e3 : ∑ j ∈ univ.erase j0, (y' j).choose 2 = ∑ j ∈ univ.erase j0, (y j).choose 2 :=
        Finset.sum_congr rfl fun j hj => by
          rw [hy', Function.update_of_ne (Finset.ne_of_mem_erase hj)]
      have : y' j0 = y j0 - 1 := by simp [hy']
      have hc := choose_two_eq_pred (y j0) hy0
      simp only at e1 e2
      rw [this] at e2
      omega
    have hdiv : n / m ≤ y j0 - 1 := by
      have : n / m < y j0 := (Nat.div_lt_iff_lt_mul hm).2 (by rw [mul_comm]; omega)
      omega
    rw [qbal_succ, hpairs]
    omega

/-- Discrete convexity of `q_m`: `q_m(n) ≥ q_m(k) + ⌊k/m⌋ (n - k)` for all `n, k`. -/
theorem qbal_supporting_line (m k n : ℕ) :
    (qbal m k : ℝ) + ((k / m : ℕ) : ℝ) * ((n : ℝ) - k) ≤ qbal m n := by
  rcases le_total k n with hkn | hnk
  · have hsplit : ∑ i ∈ range k, i / m + ∑ i ∈ Ico k n, i / m = ∑ i ∈ range n, i / m :=
      Finset.sum_range_add_sum_Ico _ hkn
    have hlow : (n - k) * (k / m) ≤ ∑ i ∈ Ico k n, i / m := by
      have := Finset.card_nsmul_le_sum (Ico k n) (fun i => i / m) (k / m)
        (fun i hi => Nat.div_le_div_right (Finset.mem_Ico.1 hi).1)
      simpa using this
    have h : qbal m k + (n - k) * (k / m) ≤ qbal m n := by
      unfold qbal; omega
    have hc : ((n - k : ℕ) : ℝ) = (n : ℝ) - k := by rw [Nat.cast_sub hkn]
    have : ((qbal m k + (n - k) * (k / m) : ℕ) : ℝ) ≤ qbal m n := by exact_mod_cast h
    push_cast [hc] at this
    linarith
  · have hsplit : ∑ i ∈ range n, i / m + ∑ i ∈ Ico n k, i / m = ∑ i ∈ range k, i / m :=
      Finset.sum_range_add_sum_Ico _ hnk
    have hup : ∑ i ∈ Ico n k, i / m ≤ (k - n) * (k / m) := by
      have := Finset.sum_le_card_nsmul (Ico n k) (fun i => i / m) (k / m)
        (fun i hi => Nat.div_le_div_right (Finset.mem_Ico.1 hi).2.le)
      simpa using this
    have h : qbal m k ≤ qbal m n + (k - n) * (k / m) := by
      unfold qbal; omega
    have hc : ((k - n : ℕ) : ℝ) = (k : ℝ) - n := by rw [Nat.cast_sub hnk]
    have : (qbal m k : ℝ) ≤ ((qbal m n + (k - n) * (k / m) : ℕ) : ℝ) := by exact_mod_cast h
    push_cast [hc] at this
    linarith

/-- The piecewise-linear interpolation `q̃_m(x)` of the balanced pair count. -/
noncomputable def qlin (m : ℕ) (x : ℝ) : ℝ :=
  (qbal m ⌊x⌋₊ : ℝ) + ((⌊x⌋₊ / m : ℕ) : ℝ) * (x - ⌊x⌋₊)

theorem qlin_natCast (m n : ℕ) : qlin m n = qbal m n := by
  simp [qlin]

/-- **Sharp finite-mean consumer (Jensen form).**  If at every parameter of positive weight at
most `m` blocks are occupied, then `𝔼Q ≥ q̃_m(𝔼P)`. -/
theorem sharp_mean_consumer (Y : ℕ → ι → ℕ) (m : ℕ)
    (hZ : ∀ t ∈ F.T, 0 < F.w t → Zcount Y t ≤ m) :
    qlin m (F.E (fun t => Pcount Y t)) ≤ F.E (fun t => Qcount Y t) := by
  set k := ⌊F.E (fun t => Pcount Y t)⌋₊
  have hline : ∀ t ∈ F.T, 0 < F.w t →
      (qbal m k : ℝ) + ((k / m : ℕ) : ℝ) * ((Pcount Y t : ℝ) - k) ≤ Qcount Y t := by
    intro t ht hw
    have h1 := qbal_supporting_line m k (Pcount Y t)
    have h2 : qbal m (Pcount Y t) ≤ Qcount Y t :=
      qbal_le_pairs m (Pcount Y t) (Y t) rfl (hZ t ht hw)
    have : (qbal m (Pcount Y t) : ℝ) ≤ Qcount Y t := by exact_mod_cast h2
    linarith
  have := F.E_mono hline
  rw [F.E_add, F.E_const, F.E_smul] at this
  have hsub : F.E (fun t => (Pcount Y t : ℝ) - k) = F.E (fun t => Pcount Y t) - k := by
    have := F.E_add (fun t => (Pcount Y t : ℝ)) (fun _ => -(k : ℝ))
    rw [F.E_const] at this
    simpa [sub_eq_add_neg] using this
  rw [hsub] at this
  simpa [qlin] using this

/-- **Sharp occupancy existence.**  `𝔼Q < q̃_m(𝔼P)` forces a parameter of positive weight with
at least `m + 1` occupied blocks. -/
theorem exists_occupancy_of_sharp (Y : ℕ → ι → ℕ) (m : ℕ)
    (h : F.E (fun t => Qcount Y t) < qlin m (F.E (fun t => Pcount Y t))) :
    ∃ t ∈ F.T, 0 < F.w t ∧ m + 1 ≤ Zcount Y t := by
  by_contra hc
  push_neg at hc
  have := sharp_mean_consumer F Y m (fun t ht hw => by have := hc t ht hw; omega)
  linarith

end Blocks

end Erdos287.PostV87V90R

@@BEGIN_FILE bytes=6956 sha256=177b7d30ba53188758e41fdc035332b259fdd51e2d7d56a3f7af75de15ee09a1 path=LEAN_PROJECT/RequestProject/Erdos287/PostV87V90R/NarrowWidth.lean@@
import RequestProject.Erdos287.PostV87V90R.WidthThree

/-!
# Erdős #287 — post-V87 → V90R: the narrow-width owner and `E287_11_4` (CONDITIONAL)

**ERDŐS #287 REMAINS OPEN.**

## The current owner

After W3 (all fixed widths `s > 3`) and the harmonic bound `e(a-1) < M`, the remaining
sufficiently large sources live in the chamber `e(a-1) < M < s·a` (approximately
`e ≤ M/a ≤ 3`).  `NarrowWidth287 s onset W` is membership of an exact word in this chamber
(no `o(1)` anywhere: `s` is a fixed real `> 3`).  `narrowWidth_bounds` proves the exact
harmonic two-sided restriction.

`NarrowWidthClosureProvider s` (OPEN, never constructed) is precisely the exclusion of the
chamber beyond an explicit onset.

## Splices (all CONDITIONAL)

* `tail_of_W3_narrow` : W3 provider → narrow closure → tail exclusion;
* `tail_of_W3family_narrow` : W3 provider family → narrow closure → tail exclusion;
* `erdos287_of_W3_narrow_finite` : W3 provider → narrow closure →
  `FiniteExclusionBelow (max onsets)` → no Erdős #287 counterexample.

## `E287_11_4`

`E287_11_4_Provider s` (OPEN, never constructed) asserts, for every residual window beyond a
uniform onset: a fixed 11-macroblock compiler for `ContactCycle 11 3 = G(11,2)`, one parameter
with window control (source window, adjacency orientation, row bound, big prime) and **four
distinct occupied macroblocks** whose occupancy *is* primality of actual form values.
Then `4 > α(G(11,2)) = 3` (`E287_11_4_geometry`) yields a useful occupied edge, hence adjacent
compulsory omissions, hence a contradiction:

* `E287_11_4` : `E287_11_4_Provider s → NarrowWidthClosureProvider s`;
* `tail_of_E287_11_4` : W3 provider → `E287_11_4_Provider` → tail exclusion.

*Audit note.*  Parity / endpoint / mask information is not needed by the consumer (only exact
mass and gap-two enter, via row rigidity), so it is not demanded of the provider.
-/

open scoped BigOperators
open Classical

namespace Erdos287.PostV87V90R

open Erdos287 Erdos287.PostV71V87

/-- **The narrow-width chamber** (current owner): an exact word with `a > 1`, `M ≥ onset` and
`M < s a`. -/
def NarrowWidth287 (s : ℝ) (onset : ℕ) (W : ExactWord) : Prop :=
  1 < W.a ∧ onset ≤ W.M ∧ (W.M : ℝ) < s * W.a

/-- Exact harmonic restriction of the chamber: `e (a - 1) < M < s a`. -/
theorem narrowWidth_bounds {s : ℝ} {onset : ℕ} {W : ExactWord} (h : NarrowWidth287 s onset W) :
    Real.exp 1 * ((W.a : ℝ) - 1) < W.M ∧ (W.M : ℝ) < s * W.a :=
  ⟨ExactWord.exp_lower W h.1, h.2.2⟩

/-- **(OPEN provider)** Exclusion of the narrow chamber beyond an explicit onset. -/
structure NarrowWidthClosureProvider (s : ℝ) where
  hs : 3 < s
  onset : ℕ
  exclude : ∀ W : ExactWord, NarrowWidth287 s onset W → False

/-- Tail exclusion beyond `M0`. -/
def TailExclusion (M0 : ℕ) : Prop := ∀ W : ExactWord, 1 < W.a → M0 ≤ W.M → False

/-- **Splice (CONDITIONAL).**  W3 at width `s' ≤ s` plus narrow closure at `s` give tail
exclusion. -/
theorem tail_of_W3Statement_narrow {s s' : ℝ} (hss : s' ≤ s) {Ms : ℕ}
    (h3 : ∀ W : ExactWord, 1 < W.a → Ms ≤ W.M → s' * W.a ≤ W.M → False)
    (N : NarrowWidthClosureProvider s) : TailExclusion (max Ms N.onset) := by
  intro W ha hM
  by_cases hw : s' * W.a ≤ W.M
  · exact h3 W ha (le_trans (le_max_left _ _) hM) hw
  · push_neg at hw
    exact N.exclude W ⟨ha, le_trans (le_max_right _ _) hM, by
      have : (0 : ℝ) ≤ W.a := by positivity
      nlinarith⟩

/-- **W3 provider → narrow closure → tail exclusion (CONDITIONAL).** -/
theorem tail_of_W3_narrow {s : ℝ} (P : WidthThreeMomentProvider s)
    (N : NarrowWidthClosureProvider s) : TailExclusion (max P.onset N.onset) :=
  tail_of_W3Statement_narrow le_rfl (W3_of_provider P) N

/-- **W3 provider family → narrow closure → tail exclusion (CONDITIONAL).** -/
theorem tail_of_W3family_narrow
    (Pfam : ∀ s : ℝ, 3 < s → s ≤ 7 → WidthThreeMomentProvider s) {s : ℝ}
    (N : NarrowWidthClosureProvider s) : ∃ M0, TailExclusion M0 := by
  have hs' : 3 < min s 7 := lt_min N.hs (by norm_num)
  let P := Pfam (min s 7) hs' (min_le_right _ _)
  exact ⟨_, tail_of_W3Statement_narrow (min_le_left s 7) (W3_of_provider P) N⟩

/-- **Global splice (CONDITIONAL).**  W3 provider, narrow closure and finite exclusion below the
explicit combined onset give: no Erdős #287 counterexample exists. -/
theorem erdos287_of_W3_narrow_finite {s : ℝ} (P : WidthThreeMomentProvider s)
    (N : NarrowWidthClosureProvider s) (hfin : FiniteExclusionBelow (max P.onset N.onset)) :
    ∀ A : Finset ℕ, ¬ Erdos287Counterexample A := by
  intro A hA
  by_cases hlt : A.max' hA.nonempty < max P.onset N.onset
  · exact hfin A hA hlt
  · push_neg at hlt
    exact tail_of_W3_narrow P N (ofCounterexample hA) (ofCounterexample_one_lt_a hA) hlt

/-! ## `E287_11_4` -/

/-- Residual windows: `1 < a`, `onset ≤ M`, `M < s a`, `e(a-1) < M`. -/
def ResidualWindow (s : ℝ) (onset a M : ℕ) : Prop :=
  1 < a ∧ onset ≤ M ∧ (M : ℝ) < s * a ∧ Real.exp 1 * ((a : ℝ) - 1) < M

/-- **(OPEN provider) `E287_11_4`.**  A fixed 11-macroblock compiler for `G(11,2)`, a uniform
onset, and for every residual window a single parameter with window control at which at least
four distinct macroblocks are occupied by prime form values. -/
structure E287_11_4_Provider (s : ℝ) where
  hs : 3 < s
  K : ℕ
  compiler : AffineContactCompiler 11 3 K
  H : ℕ
  onset : ℕ
  occupancy : ∀ a M : ℕ, ResidualWindow s onset a M →
    ∃ t, WindowControl compiler a M H t ∧ 4 ≤ (occupied compiler t).card

/-- The consumer geometry: `α(G(11,2)) = 3 < 4`. -/
theorem E287_11_4_geometry : alpha (G 11 2) < 4 := by rw [alpha_G_11_2]; norm_num

/-- **`E287_11_4` (CONDITIONAL).**  The provider closes the narrow chamber. -/
def E287_11_4 {s : ℝ} (P : E287_11_4_Provider s) : NarrowWidthClosureProvider s where
  hs := P.hs
  onset := P.onset
  exclude := fun W ⟨ha, hM, hs⟩ => by
    obtain ⟨t, hW, hocc⟩ := P.occupancy W.a W.M ⟨ha, hM, hs, ExactWord.exp_lower W ha⟩
    exact occupancy_contact_false (m := 3) (r := 11) W P.compiler (by norm_num) (by norm_num)
      hW hocc

/-- **`E287_11_4` + W3 → tail exclusion (CONDITIONAL).** -/
theorem tail_of_E287_11_4 {s : ℝ} (P3 : WidthThreeMomentProvider s) (P : E287_11_4_Provider s) :
    TailExclusion (max P3.onset P.onset) :=
  tail_of_W3_narrow P3 (E287_11_4 P)

/-- **Non-vacuity:** residual windows exist beyond every onset, for every `s > 3`. -/
theorem residualWindow_exists {s : ℝ} (hs : 3 < s) (onset : ℕ) :
    ∃ a M : ℕ, ResidualWindow s onset a M := by
  refine ⟨onset + 2, 3 * (onset + 2), by omega, by omega, ?_, ?_⟩
  · push_cast
    have : (0 : ℝ) < (onset : ℝ) + 2 := by positivity
    nlinarith
  · have he := Real.exp_one_lt_d9
    push_cast
    have : (0 : ℝ) ≤ (onset : ℝ) := by positivity
    nlinarith [Real.exp_pos 1]

end Erdos287.PostV87V90R

@@BEGIN_FILE bytes=6353 sha256=6b1f89a865f81939bb312f3c7cba5a15e047e38916bd504d376f662d081335ab path=LEAN_PROJECT/RequestProject/Erdos287/PostV87V90R/OccupancyContact.lean@@
import RequestProject.Erdos287.PostV87V90R.RowRigidity
import RequestProject.Erdos287.PostV87V90R.AffineCompiler
import RequestProject.Erdos287.PostV87V90R.MomentConsumer

/-!
# Erdős #287 — post-V87 → V90R: occupancy-to-contact consumer (unconditional)

**ERDŐS #287 REMAINS OPEN.**

Given a finite compiler `C : AffineContactCompiler r m K`, a window `[a, M]`, a cofactor
bound `H` and a parameter `t`, the *window control* `WindowControl C a M H t` collects exactly the
numerical facts consumed downstream:

* **source window** — on every oriented compiler edge the compiled positions satisfy
  `a ≤ n⁻(t)` and `n⁺(t) ≤ M`;
* **row bound / scale control** — `M < (slope · t + 1)(H + 1)` for every form (so all selected
  multiples of a form value have cofactor `≤ H`);
* **big prime** — `B_H < slope · t + 1` for every form.

Macroblock `j` is *occupied* at `t` when one of its forms takes a prime value.

Unconditional consumers:

* `false_of_edge` — two occupied macroblocks joined by an edge of `ContactCycle r m` produce a
  `ContactWitness` (adjacency identity + row rigidity), contradicting gap-two;
* `occupancy_contact_false` — **`m + 1` occupied macroblocks at one parameter are impossible**
  (by `α(ContactCycle r m) = m`);
* `moment_contact_false`, `sharp_contact_false` — the same from the repaired moment inequalities
  (Cauchy form, resp. sharp balanced form) on a finite weighted parameter set.
-/

open scoped BigOperators
open Finset Classical

namespace Erdos287.PostV87V90R

open Erdos287 Erdos287.PostV71V87

variable {r m K : ℕ} [NeZero r]

/-- The per-window, per-parameter numerical conditions consumed by the contact argument. -/
structure WindowControl (C : AffineContactCompiler r m K) (a M H t : ℕ) : Prop where
  window : ∀ j k i i', (ContactCycle r m).Adj j k → C.slope j i < C.slope k i' →
    a ≤ nMinus (C.slope j i) (C.slope k i') t ∧ nPlus (C.slope j i) (C.slope k i') t ≤ M
  rowBound : ∀ j i, M < (C.slope j i * t + 1) * (H + 1)
  bigPrime : ∀ j i, BH H < C.slope j i * t + 1

/-- Macroblocks occupied at parameter `t`: some form value is prime. -/
noncomputable def occupied (C : AffineContactCompiler r m K) (t : ℕ) : Finset (ZMod r) :=
  univ.filter (fun j => ∃ i, (C.slope j i * t + 1).Prime)

/-- Block counts: number of prime form values in macroblock `j` at parameter `t`. -/
noncomputable def blockCount (C : AffineContactCompiler r m K) : ℕ → ZMod r → ℕ :=
  fun t j => (univ.filter (fun i : Fin K => (C.slope j i * t + 1).Prime)).card

theorem Zcount_blockCount (C : AffineContactCompiler r m K) (t : ℕ) :
    Zcount (blockCount C) t = (occupied C t).card := by
  unfold Zcount occupied blockCount
  congr 1
  ext j
  simp [Finset.card_pos, Finset.filter_nonempty_iff]

/-- An oriented occupied compiler edge yields a contact witness. -/
noncomputable def contactWitness_of_oriented (W : ExactWord) (C : AffineContactCompiler r m K)
    {H t : ℕ} (hW : WindowControl C W.a W.M H t) {j k : ZMod r} {i i' : Fin K}
    (hadj : (ContactCycle r m).Adj j k) (hlt : C.slope j i < C.slope k i')
    (hpj : (C.slope j i * t + 1).Prime) (hpk : (C.slope k i' * t + 1).Prime) :
    ContactWitness W where
  p := C.slope k i' * t + 1
  q := C.slope j i * t + 1
  H := H
  n := nMinus (C.slope j i) (C.slope k i') t
  hp := hpk
  hq := hpj
  hpB := hW.bigPrime k i'
  hqB := hW.bigPrime j i
  hpM := hW.rowBound k i'
  hqM := hW.rowBound j i
  hpn := form_dvd_nMinus _ _ _
  hqn := by rw [← C.edge_adjacent hadj hlt t]; exact form_dvd_nPlus _ _ _
  hn := (hW.window j k i i' hadj hlt).1
  hn1 := by rw [← C.edge_adjacent hadj hlt t]; exact (hW.window j k i i' hadj hlt).2

/-- **Edge consumer.**  Two occupied macroblocks joined by a useful edge are impossible. -/
theorem false_of_edge (W : ExactWord) (C : AffineContactCompiler r m K) {H t : ℕ}
    (hW : WindowControl C W.a W.M H t) {j k : ZMod r} (hadj : (ContactCycle r m).Adj j k)
    (hj : j ∈ occupied C t) (hk : k ∈ occupied C t) : False := by
  obtain ⟨i, hi⟩ := (mem_filter.1 hj).2
  obtain ⟨i', hi'⟩ := (mem_filter.1 hk).2
  rcases lt_or_gt_of_ne (C.edge_ne j k i i' hadj) with h | h
  · exact (contactWitness_of_oriented W C hW hadj h hi hi').false
  · exact (contactWitness_of_oriented W C hW hadj.symm h hi' hi).false

/-- **Occupancy-to-contact consumer.**  For `1 ≤ m`, `2m ≤ r`: at no parameter with window
control can `m + 1` macroblocks be occupied. -/
theorem occupancy_contact_false (W : ExactWord) (C : AffineContactCompiler r m K) {H t : ℕ}
    (hm : 1 ≤ m) (hr : 2 * m ≤ r) (hW : WindowControl C W.a W.M H t)
    (hocc : m + 1 ≤ (occupied C t).card) : False := by
  obtain ⟨j, hj, k, hk, hadj⟩ := exists_useful_edge hm hr hocc
  exact false_of_edge W C hW hadj hj hk

/-- **Moment-to-contact consumer (Cauchy form).**  The repaired normalised moment
inequalities on a finite weighted parameter set with window control on its support are
incompatible with an exact word. -/
theorem moment_contact_false (W : ExactWord) (C : AffineContactCompiler r m K) {H : ℕ}
    (hm : 1 ≤ m) (hr : 2 * m ≤ r) (F : FiniteWeights) {μ Cpair : ℝ} (hμ : 0 < μ)
    (hP : μ ≤ F.E (fun t => (Pcount (blockCount C) t : ℝ)))
    (hQ : F.E (fun t => (Qcount (blockCount C) t : ℝ)) ≤ Cpair * μ ^ 2 / (2 * r))
    (hC : Cpair < r / m) (hμbig : (m : ℝ) * r / (r - m * Cpair) < μ)
    (hctrl : ∀ t ∈ F.T, 0 < F.w t → WindowControl C W.a W.M H t) : False := by
  have hr0 : (0 : ℝ) < r := Nat.cast_pos.2 (NeZero.pos r)
  obtain ⟨t, ht, hw, hZ⟩ :=
    occupancy_of_normalized_moments F (blockCount C) hr0 hm hμ hP hQ hC hμbig
  rw [Zcount_blockCount] at hZ
  exact occupancy_contact_false W C hm hr (hctrl t ht hw) hZ

/-- **Moment-to-contact consumer (sharp balanced form).** -/
theorem sharp_contact_false (W : ExactWord) (C : AffineContactCompiler r m K) {H : ℕ}
    (hm : 1 ≤ m) (hr : 2 * m ≤ r) (F : FiniteWeights)
    (hQ : F.E (fun t => (Qcount (blockCount C) t : ℝ)) <
      qlin m (F.E (fun t => (Pcount (blockCount C) t : ℝ))))
    (hctrl : ∀ t ∈ F.T, 0 < F.w t → WindowControl C W.a W.M H t) : False := by
  obtain ⟨t, ht, hw, hZ⟩ := exists_occupancy_of_sharp F (blockCount C) m hQ
  rw [Zcount_blockCount] at hZ
  exact occupancy_contact_false W C hm hr (hctrl t ht hw) hZ

end Erdos287.PostV87V90R

import RequestProject.Erdos287.PostV87V90R.NarrowWidth
import RequestProject.Erdos287.PostV87V90R.RetiredRoutes

/-!
# Erdős #287 — post-V87 → V90R: semantic regression suite

**ERDŐS #287 REMAINS OPEN.**  Each item is a kernel-checked negative control.

1. `C_lt_11_3_alone_insufficient` — `C < 11/3` without the first-moment size condition does
   **not** yield occupancy (explicit one-point fixture).
2. `obsolete_11_6_not_threshold` — a pair constant `C = 3 ≥ 11/6` still satisfies the repaired
   `r = 11, m = 3` hypotheses; `11/6` is not a threshold and occurs nowhere downstream (also
   grep-checked by `audit.sh`).
3. `crossScale_not_reduction` — `CrossScaleSynchronization287` is equivalent to tail exclusion.
4. `width_exclusion_not_global` — width exclusion at every `s > 3` does not imply emptiness.
5. `fixed_s_not_pointwise_three` — excluding every fixed `s > 3` does not give `M ≤ 3a` at any
   finite `M`.
6. `wideWindow_exists`, `residualWindow_exists` (non-vacuity of the providers' domains) and
   `wordQuantified_provider_trivial` (why the providers are window-quantified); the build-time
   `#audit_providers_v90` additionally rejects `True`/`False.elim`/`IsEmpty` constructions.
7. `predicate_provider_trivial` — a provider storing only a predicate is trivially inhabited;
   `windowMomentData_exposes` — the real provider exposes the numerical inequalities.
8. `finite_verifier_not_asymptotic` — a finite verification (`n² + n + 41` prime for
   `n < 40`) is not the asymptotic statement (fails at `n = 40`).
9. `three_blocks_no_contact` — the `G(11,2)` geometry proves only the consumer: three occupied
   blocks force nothing.
10. `finite_bank_gap` — finite exclusion below a smaller bound does not fill the onset gap.
-/

open scoped BigOperators
open Classical

namespace Erdos287.PostV87V90R

open Erdos287 Erdos287.PostV71V87

/-! ## 1. `C < 11/3` alone is not the theorem -/

/-- The one-point weight space. -/
noncomputable def pointWeights : FiniteWeights where
  T := {0}
  w := fun _ => 1
  w_nonneg := fun _ _ => zero_le_one
  w_sum := by simp

theorem pointWeights_E (f : ℕ → ℝ) : pointWeights.E f = f 0 := by
  simp [FiniteWeights.E, pointWeights]

/-- One count in block `0`, nothing elsewhere. -/
def singleCount : ℕ → ZMod 11 → ℕ := fun _ j => if j = 0 then 1 else 0

theorem singleCount_P : Pcount singleCount 0 = 1 := by decide
theorem singleCount_Q : Qcount singleCount 0 = 0 := by decide
theorem singleCount_Z : Zcount singleCount 0 = 1 := by decide

/-- **Regression 1.**  `𝔼P ≥ μ > 0`, `𝔼Q ≤ C μ²/22` and `C < 11/3` do **not** force four
occupied blocks: the first-moment size condition `μ > 33/(11 - 3C)` is indispensable. -/
theorem C_lt_11_3_alone_insufficient :
    ¬ ∀ (F : FiniteWeights) (Y : ℕ → ZMod 11 → ℕ) (μ C : ℝ), 0 < μ →
      μ ≤ F.E (fun t => (Pcount Y t : ℝ)) →
      F.E (fun t => (Qcount Y t : ℝ)) ≤ C * μ ^ 2 / (2 * 11) → C < 11 / 3 →
      ∃ t ∈ F.T, 0 < F.w t ∧ 4 ≤ Zcount Y t := by
  intro h
  obtain ⟨t, ht, -, hZ⟩ := h pointWeights singleCount 1 0 one_pos
    (by rw [pointWeights_E, singleCount_P]; norm_num)
    (by rw [pointWeights_E, singleCount_Q]; norm_num) (by norm_num)
  have : t = 0 := by simpa [pointWeights] using ht
  subst this
  rw [singleCount_Z] at hZ
  omega

/-- The same fixture violates the first-moment size condition, as it must. -/
theorem singleCount_violates_first_moment : ¬ ((33 : ℝ) / (11 - 3 * 0) < 1) := by norm_num

/-! ## 2. `11/6` is obsolete -/

/-- **Regression 2.**  `C = 3` is above the obsolete `11/6`, yet satisfies the repaired
condition `C < 11/3`, with first-moment size requirement `33/(11 - 9) = 16.5`. -/
theorem obsolete_11_6_not_threshold :
    (11 : ℝ) / 6 < 3 ∧ (3 : ℝ) < 11 / 3 ∧ (33 : ℝ) / (11 - 3 * 3) < 17 := by norm_num

/-! ## 3. Cross-scale synchronisation is overstrong -/

/-- **Regression 3.** -/
theorem crossScale_not_reduction (M0 : ℕ) :
    CrossScaleSynchronization287 M0 ↔ TailExclusion M0 :=
  crossScale_retired_equiv_tail M0

/-! ## 4–5. Width exclusion versus global / pointwise statements -/

/-- Width exclusion at width `s` for an abstract predicate on windows. -/
def WidthExcluded (Bad : ℕ → ℕ → Prop) (s : ℝ) : Prop :=
  ∃ Ms : ℕ, ∀ a M : ℕ, Bad a M → Ms ≤ M → s * a ≤ M → False

/-- **Regression 4.**  Exclusion at every width `s > 3` does not imply emptiness: the windows
`M = 3a` survive every fixed `s > 3` (the narrow-width owner is indispensable). -/
theorem width_exclusion_not_global :
    ∃ Bad : ℕ → ℕ → Prop, (∀ s : ℝ, 3 < s → WidthExcluded Bad s) ∧
      ∀ M0 : ℕ, ∃ a M, M0 ≤ M ∧ Bad a M := by
  refine ⟨fun a M => M = 3 * a ∧ 1 < a, fun s hs => ⟨0, fun a M ⟨hM, ha⟩ _ hle => ?_⟩,
    fun M0 => ⟨M0 + 2, 3 * (M0 + 2), by omega, rfl, by omega⟩⟩
  subst hM
  have : (0 : ℝ) < a := by exact_mod_cast (by omega : 0 < a)
  push_cast at hle
  nlinarith

/-- **Regression 5.**  The windows `(a, 3a + 1)` are excluded at every fixed width `s > 3`
beyond an onset, yet *every* one of them has `M > 3a`: the W3 family does not give a pointwise
`M/a ≤ 3` at finite `M`. -/
theorem fixed_s_not_pointwise_three :
    (∀ s : ℝ, 3 < s → ∃ Ms : ℕ, ∀ a : ℕ, Ms ≤ 3 * a + 1 → ((3 * a + 1 : ℕ) : ℝ) < s * a) ∧
      ∀ a : ℕ, 3 * a < 3 * a + 1 := by
  refine ⟨fun s hs => ⟨3 * (⌊1 / (s - 3)⌋₊ + 1) + 1, fun a ha => ?_⟩, fun a => by omega⟩
  have hpos : 0 < s - 3 := by linarith
  have ha' : ⌊1 / (s - 3)⌋₊ + 1 ≤ a := by omega
  have h1 : 1 / (s - 3) < (a : ℝ) := by
    have := Nat.lt_floor_add_one (1 / (s - 3))
    have : ((⌊1 / (s - 3)⌋₊ + 1 : ℕ) : ℝ) ≤ a := by exact_mod_cast ha'
    push_cast at this
    linarith
  rw [div_lt_iff₀ hpos] at h1
  push_cast
  nlinarith

/-! ## 6. Providers are window-quantified and non-vacuous -/

/-- **Regression 6 (semantic audit).**  A moment field quantified over hypothetical exact words
(instead of windows) would be trivially inhabited from tail exclusion itself — circular.  This
is why `WidthThreeMomentProvider` quantifies over windows (`WideWindow`, provably inhabited by
`wideWindow_exists`). -/
theorem wordQuantified_provider_trivial {r m K : ℕ} [NeZero r] (C : AffineContactCompiler r m K)
    (H M0 : ℕ) (htail : TailExclusion M0) :
    ∀ W : ExactWord, 1 < W.a → M0 ≤ W.M → Nonempty (WindowMomentData C H W.a W.M) :=
  fun W ha hM => (htail W ha hM).elim

/-- Wide windows exist beyond every onset (`3 < s ≤ 7`): the W3 provider's moment field is not
vacuous. -/
theorem w3_domain_nonempty {s : ℝ} (hs : 3 < s) (hs7 : s ≤ 7) (onset : ℕ) :
    ∃ a M : ℕ, WideWindow s onset a M :=
  wideWindow_exists hs hs7 onset

/-- Residual windows exist beyond every onset: the `E287_11_4` occupancy field is not vacuous. -/
theorem e287_domain_nonempty {s : ℝ} (hs : 3 < s) (onset : ℕ) :
    ∃ a M : ℕ, ResidualWindow s onset a M :=
  residualWindow_exists hs onset

/-! ## 7. Predicate-only providers are worthless -/

/-- A "provider" that only stores a proposition and its proof. -/
structure PredicateOnlyProvider where
  claim : Prop
  proof : claim

/-- **Regression 7.**  Such a record is inhabited by `True`; it carries no information. -/
theorem predicate_provider_trivial : Nonempty PredicateOnlyProvider := ⟨⟨True, trivial⟩⟩

/-- The real window moment data exposes the numerical inequalities actually consumed. -/
theorem windowMomentData_exposes {r m K : ℕ} [NeZero r] {C : AffineContactCompiler r m K}
    {H a M : ℕ} (D : WindowMomentData C H a M) :
    0 < D.μ ∧ D.μ ≤ D.F.E (fun t => (Pcount (blockCount C) t : ℝ)) ∧
      D.F.E (fun t => (Qcount (blockCount C) t : ℝ)) ≤ D.Cpair * D.μ ^ 2 / (2 * r) ∧
      D.Cpair < r / m ∧ (m : ℝ) * r / (r - m * D.Cpair) < D.μ :=
  ⟨D.hμ, D.firstMoment, D.pairMoment, D.pairConstant, D.firstMomentLarge⟩

/-! ## 8. Finite verification is not asymptotic prime supply -/

/-- **Regression 8.**  `n² + n + 41` is prime for every `n < 40` (a finite verification) but
not for `n = 40`: no finite check implies the corresponding asymptotic prime-supply statement. -/
theorem finite_verifier_not_asymptotic :
    (∀ n < 40, (n ^ 2 + n + 41).Prime) ∧ ¬ (40 ^ 2 + 40 + 41).Prime := by
  refine ⟨fun n hn => ?_, by norm_num⟩
  interval_cases n <;> norm_num

/-! ## 9. The 11-block geometry proves only the consumer -/

/-- **Regression 9.**  Three occupied blocks (`{0,1,2}`) contain no useful edge of `G(11,2)`:
the graph theorem supplies the consumer geometry, never occupancy. -/
theorem three_blocks_no_contact :
    ∃ O : Finset (ZMod 11), O.card = 3 ∧ IndepFinset (G 11 2) O :=
  ⟨arc 11 3, arc_card (by norm_num), arc_indep (by norm_num)⟩

/-! ## 10. Finite-bank exclusion does not fill the onset gap -/

/-- **Regression 10.**  Tail exclusion beyond `10` and finite exclusion below `3` leave the
value `5` uncovered: a finite bank below a smaller bound than the (unknown) W3 onset proves
nothing about the gap. -/
theorem finite_bank_gap :
    ∃ Bad : ℕ → Prop, (∀ M, 10 ≤ M → ¬ Bad M) ∧ (∀ M, M < 3 → ¬ Bad M) ∧ ∃ M, Bad M :=
  ⟨fun M => M = 5, fun M h h5 => by omega, fun M h h5 => by omega, 5, rfl⟩

end Erdos287.PostV87V90R

import RequestProject.Erdos287.PostV87V90R.ModelCompatibility

/-!
# Erdős #287 — post-V87 → V90R: V88 retained facts, retired consumers, closure-first failures

**ERDŐS #287 REMAINS OPEN.**

No V88 source document is present in the repository.  Only the following *elementary* V88
statements could be reconstructed with complete proofs; every other V88 item is recorded as
OPEN/INFORMAL in the report (no theorem is invented for it).

## V88 retained exact facts (BANK)

* `conductor_replication` — an absent modulus replicates to all its multiples;
* `primePower_replication` — an absent prime power `p^e` replicates to all `p^f`, `f ≥ e`;
* `guardOwner_unique` — re-export of the audited `Word.guard_triple_owner_unique`;
* `lcm_transfer` — absence transfers from either factor to the lcm.

## V88 negative conclusion: the single-minimal-grid / global-overload architecture

`isolated_omissions_realizable`: *any* pattern of omissions with no two consecutive interior
positions is realised by a genuine gap-two word.  Consequently (`single_grid_realizable`) the
forced omissions of one absent modulus `d ≥ 2` never exceed the gap-two capacity, and
(`even_multigrid_realizable`) neither does the union of the forced omissions of any family of
even moduli.  This is the exact capacity comparison behind the retirement of
"single-grid global overload" and "multi-grid overload of unchanged global capacity" as
sufficient consumers.

## Closure-first failures (KILL regression facts)

* `exterior_obligations_do_not_combine` — individually satisfiable exterior obligations need
  not have a common witness;
* `proximity_density_no_contact` — proximity plus density does not give guard contact.

## Retired owner

* `crossScale_retired_equiv_tail` — the audited `CrossScaleSynchronization287 M0` is
  *equivalent* to tail exclusion; it is an overstrong owner, not a reduction.
-/

open scoped BigOperators

namespace Erdos287.PostV87V90R

open Erdos287 Erdos287.PostV71V87

/-! ## V88 retained exact facts -/

/-- **Conductor replication.**  If `d` is absent from a word, so is every multiple of `d`. -/
theorem conductor_replication (W : Word) {d : ℕ} (hd : W.Absent d) (k : ℕ) :
    W.Absent (d * k) :=
  fun n hn h => hd n hn (dvd_trans (dvd_mul_right d k) h)

/-- **Prime-power replication.**  An absent `p^e` forces every `p^f` with `f ≥ e` absent. -/
theorem primePower_replication (W : Word) {p e f : ℕ} (hd : W.Absent (p ^ e)) (hf : e ≤ f) :
    W.Absent (p ^ f) :=
  fun n hn h => hd n hn (dvd_trans (pow_dvd_pow p hf) h)

/-- **Guard-owner uniqueness** (re-export): a guard triple centred at `y` contains at most one
multiple of a modulus `ℓ ≥ 3`. -/
theorem guardOwner_unique {ℓ y u w : ℕ} (hℓ : 3 ≤ ℓ)
    (hu : y ≤ u + 1 ∧ u ≤ y + 1) (hw : y ≤ w + 1 ∧ w ≤ y + 1) (hud : ℓ ∣ u) (hwd : ℓ ∣ w) :
    u = w :=
  Word.guard_triple_owner_unique hℓ hu hw hud hwd

/-- **LCM transfer.**  Absence of either factor transfers to the lcm. -/
theorem lcm_transfer (W : Word) {d₁ d₂ : ℕ} (h : W.Absent d₁ ∨ W.Absent d₂) :
    W.Absent (Nat.lcm d₁ d₂) := by
  rcases h with h | h
  · exact fun n hn hl => h n hn (dvd_trans (Nat.dvd_lcm_left d₁ d₂) hl)
  · exact fun n hn hl => h n hn (dvd_trans (Nat.dvd_lcm_right d₁ d₂) hl)

/-! ## Capacity comparison: isolated omission patterns are always realisable -/

/-- **Exact capacity theorem.**  For any window `[a, M]` (`0 < a ≤ M`) and any predicate `O`
with no two consecutive true values, there is a gap-two word on `[a, M]` whose omitted interior
positions are exactly those satisfying `O`. -/
theorem isolated_omissions_realizable {a M : ℕ} (ha : 0 < a) (haM : a ≤ M) (O : ℕ → Prop)
    [DecidablePred O] (hiso : ∀ n, O n → ¬ O (n + 1)) :
    ∃ W : Word, W.a = a ∧ W.M = M ∧ ∀ n, a < n → n < M → (n ∈ W.A ↔ ¬ O n) := by
  refine ⟨{ A := (Finset.Icc a M).filter (fun n => n = a ∨ n = M ∨ ¬ O n)
            a := a, M := M, a_pos := ha
            sub := Finset.filter_subset _ _
            a_mem := Finset.mem_filter.2 ⟨Finset.mem_Icc.2 ⟨le_rfl, haM⟩, Or.inl rfl⟩
            M_mem := Finset.mem_filter.2 ⟨Finset.mem_Icc.2 ⟨haM, le_rfl⟩, Or.inr (Or.inl rfl)⟩
            gap := ?_ }, rfl, rfl, ?_⟩
  · intro x hx hxM
    by_cases h : O x
    · right
      exact Finset.mem_filter.2 ⟨Finset.mem_Icc.2 ⟨by omega, hxM⟩, Or.inr (Or.inr (hiso x h))⟩
    · left
      exact Finset.mem_filter.2 ⟨Finset.mem_Icc.2 ⟨hx, by omega⟩, Or.inr (Or.inr h)⟩
  · intro n han hnM
    simp only [Finset.mem_filter, Finset.mem_Icc]
    constructor
    · rintro ⟨-, h | h | h⟩
      · omega
      · omega
      · exact h
    · intro h; exact ⟨⟨by omega, by omega⟩, Or.inr (Or.inr h)⟩

/-- **Single-grid insufficiency.**  The forced omissions of one modulus `d ≥ 2` (all interior
multiples of `d`) are realised by a gap-two word: a single grid never overloads the gap-two
capacity. -/
theorem single_grid_realizable {a M d : ℕ} (ha : 0 < a) (haM : a ≤ M) (hd : 2 ≤ d) :
    ∃ W : Word, W.a = a ∧ W.M = M ∧ ∀ n, a < n → n < M → (n ∈ W.A ↔ ¬ d ∣ n) :=
  isolated_omissions_realizable ha haM (fun n => d ∣ n) fun n h1 h2 => by
    have := (Nat.dvd_add_right h1).1 h2
    have := Nat.le_of_dvd one_pos this
    omega

/-- **Multi-grid insufficiency (even moduli).**  For any finite family `D` of even moduli, the
union of their forced omissions is realised by a gap-two word: multi-grid overload does not
automatically overload the unchanged global gap-two capacity. -/
theorem even_multigrid_realizable {a M : ℕ} (ha : 0 < a) (haM : a ≤ M) (D : Finset ℕ)
    (hD : ∀ d ∈ D, 2 ∣ d) :
    ∃ W : Word, W.a = a ∧ W.M = M ∧
      ∀ n, a < n → n < M → (n ∈ W.A ↔ ¬ ∃ d ∈ D, d ∣ n) :=
  isolated_omissions_realizable ha haM (fun n => ∃ d ∈ D, d ∣ n) fun n ⟨d, hd, h1⟩ ⟨d', hd', h2⟩ => by
    have e1 : 2 ∣ n := dvd_trans (hD d hd) h1
    have e2 : 2 ∣ n + 1 := dvd_trans (hD d' hd') h2
    omega

/-! ## Closure-first failures (regression facts) -/

/-- **Individual exterior obligations do not combine.**  Each prime `p ∈ {2,3}` has a
witness `n ∈ [2,3]` with `p ∤ n`, but no `n ∈ [2,3]` is coprime to both. -/
theorem exterior_obligations_do_not_combine :
    (∀ p ∈ ({2, 3} : Finset ℕ), ∃ n ∈ Finset.Icc 2 3, ¬ p ∣ n) ∧
      ¬ ∃ n ∈ Finset.Icc 2 3, ∀ p ∈ ({2, 3} : Finset ℕ), ¬ p ∣ n := by
  decide

/-- **Proximity plus density does not give contact.**  The even numbers of `[0,20]` have
density `> 1/2` and every window point is within distance `1` of one of them, yet the target
`7` is not hit. -/
theorem proximity_density_no_contact :
    let S := (Finset.range 21).filter (fun n => 2 ∣ n)
    (∀ x ∈ Finset.range 21, ∃ s ∈ S, x ≤ s + 1 ∧ s ≤ x + 1) ∧ 21 ≤ 2 * S.card ∧ 7 ∉ S := by
  decide

/-! ## Retired owner -/

/-- **Retired owner.**  `CrossScaleSynchronization287 M0` is *equivalent* to tail exclusion
(audited `crossScale_iff_tail`); it is overstrong and is not a conceptual reduction. -/
theorem crossScale_retired_equiv_tail (M0 : ℕ) :
    CrossScaleSynchronization287 M0 ↔ ∀ W : ExactWord, 1 < W.a → M0 ≤ W.M → False :=
  crossScale_iff_tail M0

end Erdos287.PostV87V90R

import RequestProject.Erdos287.PostV87V90R.ModelCompatibility

/-!
# Erdős #287 — post-V87 → V90R: bounded-cofactor row rigidity

**ERDŐS #287 REMAINS OPEN.  Everything here is unconditional.**

For `H ≥ 1` put `L_H = lcm(1, …, H)` and `B_H = ∑_{j=1}^H L_H / j` (a positive integer,
`BH_pos`).

`selRow_empty_of_bounded_cofactors`: in an exact word, if `p` is prime, `p > B_H`, and every
selected multiple of `p` is `p·j` with `1 ≤ j ≤ H`, then **no** selected denominator is divisible
by `p`.  The load-bearing arithmetic: with `J` the set of selected cofactors, the exact identity
`∑ 1/n = 1` multiplied by `p · L_H · ∏_{p ∤ n ∈ A} n` shows `p ∣ X := ∑_{j ∈ J} L_H/j`, while
`0 ≤ X ≤ B_H < p`; so `X = 0`, forcing `J = ∅`.

*Audit note.*  The prose hypothesis `p² > M` is **not needed** once the cofactor hypothesis is
stated; it is dropped.  The cofactor hypothesis itself follows from `M < p (H + 1)`
(`cofactor_bound_of_lt`, used in `selRow_empty_of_lt`).

`adjacent_empty_rows_contradiction`: two adjacent window positions `n, n+1` lying in empty
`p`- and `q`-rows contradict gap-two.  Packaged as `ContactWitness W` with
`ContactWitness.false`.
-/

open scoped BigOperators

namespace Erdos287.PostV87V90R

open Erdos287 Erdos287.PostV71V87

/-- `L_H = lcm(1, …, H)`. -/
def LH (H : ℕ) : ℕ := (Finset.Icc 1 H).lcm id

/-- `B_H = ∑_{j=1}^H L_H / j`. -/
def BH (H : ℕ) : ℕ := ∑ j ∈ Finset.Icc 1 H, LH H / j

theorem dvd_LH {H j : ℕ} (hj : j ∈ Finset.Icc 1 H) : j ∣ LH H := Finset.dvd_lcm hj

theorem LH_pos (H : ℕ) : 0 < LH H := by
  unfold LH
  rcases Nat.eq_zero_or_pos ((Finset.Icc 1 H).lcm id) with h | h
  · rw [Finset.lcm_eq_zero_iff] at h
    simp at h
  · exact h

/-- `B_H` is a positive integer for `H ≥ 1`. -/
theorem BH_pos {H : ℕ} (hH : 1 ≤ H) : 0 < BH H := by
  unfold BH
  have h1 : (1 : ℕ) ∈ Finset.Icc 1 H := Finset.mem_Icc.2 ⟨le_rfl, hH⟩
  have := Finset.single_le_sum (f := fun j => LH H / j) (fun _ _ => Nat.zero_le _) h1
  simp only [Nat.div_one] at this
  exact lt_of_lt_of_le (LH_pos H) this

theorem one_le_LH_div {H j : ℕ} (hj : j ∈ Finset.Icc 1 H) : 1 ≤ LH H / j := by
  have hj1 := (Finset.mem_Icc.1 hj).1
  exact (Nat.one_le_div_iff (by omega)).2 (Nat.le_of_dvd (LH_pos H) (dvd_LH hj))

/-- Bounded cofactors follow from `M < p (H + 1)`. -/
theorem cofactor_bound_of_lt (W : Word) {p H : ℕ} (hM : W.M < p * (H + 1)) :
    ∀ n ∈ W.A, p ∣ n → ∃ j, 1 ≤ j ∧ j ≤ H ∧ n = p * j := by
  intro n hn hpn
  obtain ⟨j, rfl⟩ := hpn
  have hpos := W.pos_of_mem hn
  have hle := (W.mem_Icc hn).2
  refine ⟨j, ?_, ?_, rfl⟩
  · rcases Nat.eq_zero_or_pos j with h | h
    · rw [h] at hpos; simp at hpos
    · exact h
  · by_contra hc
    push_neg at hc
    have : p * (H + 1) ≤ p * j := Nat.mul_le_mul_left _ hc
    omega

/-- **Bounded-cofactor row rigidity.**  In an exact word, if `p` is prime, `p > B_H`, and every
selected multiple of `p` has the form `p·j` with `1 ≤ j ≤ H`, then the selected `p`-row is
empty. -/
theorem selRow_empty_of_bounded_cofactors (W : ExactWord) {p H : ℕ} (hp : p.Prime)
    (hpB : BH H < p) (hcof : ∀ n ∈ W.A, p ∣ n → ∃ j, 1 ≤ j ∧ j ≤ H ∧ n = p * j) :
    ∀ n ∈ W.A, ¬ p ∣ n := by
  classical
  set A1 := W.A.filter (fun n => ¬ p ∣ n) with hA1
  set A2 := W.A.filter (fun n => p ∣ n) with hA2
  set J := A2.image (fun n => n / p) with hJ
  have hp0 : 0 < p := hp.pos
  have hpQ : (p : ℚ) ≠ 0 := by exact_mod_cast hp.ne_zero
  -- cofactors lie in `[1, H]`
  have hJsub : J ⊆ Finset.Icc 1 H := by
    intro j hj
    obtain ⟨n, hn, rfl⟩ := Finset.mem_image.1 hj
    obtain ⟨hnA, hpn⟩ := Finset.mem_filter.1 hn
    obtain ⟨k, hk1, hkH, rfl⟩ := hcof n hnA hpn
    rw [Nat.mul_div_cancel_left _ hp0]
    exact Finset.mem_Icc.2 ⟨hk1, hkH⟩
  have hinj : Set.InjOn (fun n => n / p) A2 := by
    intro x hx y hy hxy
    have hx' := (Finset.mem_filter.1 hx).2
    have hy' := (Finset.mem_filter.1 hy).2
    simp only at hxy
    rw [← Nat.div_mul_cancel hx', ← Nat.div_mul_cancel hy', hxy]
  -- split the exact mass
  have hsplit : ∑ n ∈ A1, (1 : ℚ) / n + ∑ n ∈ A2, (1 : ℚ) / n = 1 := by
    rw [hA1, hA2, add_comm, Finset.sum_filter_add_sum_filter_not]; exact W.mass
  have hA2J : ∑ n ∈ A2, (1 : ℚ) / n = (1 / p) * ∑ j ∈ J, (1 : ℚ) / j := by
    rw [hJ, Finset.sum_image hinj, Finset.mul_sum]
    refine Finset.sum_congr rfl fun n hn => ?_
    have hpn := (Finset.mem_filter.1 hn).2
    have hn0 : (n : ℚ) ≠ 0 := by exact_mod_cast (W.pos_of_mem (Finset.mem_filter.1 hn).1).ne'
    have : (n : ℚ) = p * ((n / p : ℕ) : ℚ) := by
      rw [Nat.cast_div hpn hpQ]; field_simp
    have hq0 : ((n / p : ℕ) : ℚ) ≠ 0 := by
      intro h; rw [h, mul_zero] at this; exact hn0 this
    rw [this]; field_simp
  -- integer quantities
  set R := ∏ n ∈ A1, n with hR
  set L := LH H with hL
  set N1 := ∑ n ∈ A1, R / n with hN1
  set X := ∑ j ∈ J, L / j with hX
  have hRS : (R : ℚ) * ∑ n ∈ A1, (1 : ℚ) / n = N1 := by
    rw [hN1, Nat.cast_sum, Finset.mul_sum]
    refine Finset.sum_congr rfl fun n hn => ?_
    have hdvd : n ∣ R := Finset.dvd_prod_of_mem _ hn
    have hn0 : (n : ℚ) ≠ 0 := by exact_mod_cast (W.pos_of_mem (Finset.mem_filter.1 hn).1).ne'
    rw [Nat.cast_div hdvd hn0]; ring
  have hLS : (L : ℚ) * ∑ j ∈ J, (1 : ℚ) / j = X := by
    rw [hX, Nat.cast_sum, Finset.mul_sum]
    refine Finset.sum_congr rfl fun j hj => ?_
    have hjI := hJsub hj
    have hdvd : j ∣ L := dvd_LH hjI
    have hj0 : (j : ℚ) ≠ 0 := by exact_mod_cast (by have := (Finset.mem_Icc.1 hjI).1; omega)
    rw [Nat.cast_div hdvd hj0]; ring
  -- `p R L = p L N1 + R X`
  have hidQ : ((p * R * L : ℕ) : ℚ) = ((p * L * N1 + R * X : ℕ) : ℚ) := by
    push_cast
    rw [← hRS, ← hLS]
    have := congrArg (fun z => (p : ℚ) * R * L * z) hsplit
    simp only [mul_one] at this
    rw [← this, hA2J]
    field_simp
  have hid : p * R * L = p * L * N1 + R * X := by exact_mod_cast hidQ
  have hpRX : p ∣ R * X := by
    have h1 : p ∣ p * R * L := by rw [mul_assoc]; exact dvd_mul_right _ _
    rw [hid] at h1
    exact (Nat.dvd_add_right (by rw [mul_assoc]; exact dvd_mul_right _ _)).1 h1
  have hpR : ¬ p ∣ R := by
    intro h
    obtain ⟨n, hn, hpn⟩ := (Prime.dvd_finset_prod_iff hp.prime _).1 h
    exact (Finset.mem_filter.1 hn).2 hpn
  have hpX : p ∣ X := (Nat.Prime.dvd_mul hp).1 hpRX |>.resolve_left hpR
  have hXle : X ≤ BH H := Finset.sum_le_sum_of_subset_of_nonneg hJsub (fun _ _ _ => Nat.zero_le _)
  have hX0 : X = 0 := by
    by_contra hne
    have := Nat.le_of_dvd (Nat.pos_of_ne_zero hne) hpX
    omega
  intro n hn hpn
  have hjJ : n / p ∈ J := Finset.mem_image.2 ⟨n, Finset.mem_filter.2 ⟨hn, hpn⟩, rfl⟩
  have h1 : 1 ≤ L / (n / p) := one_le_LH_div (hJsub hjJ)
  have : L / (n / p) ≤ X := Finset.single_le_sum (f := fun j => L / j)
    (fun _ _ => Nat.zero_le _) hjJ
  omega

/-- Selected-row form of row rigidity: `selRow p = ∅`. -/
theorem selRow_eq_empty (W : ExactWord) {p H : ℕ} (hp : p.Prime) (hpB : BH H < p)
    (hcof : ∀ n ∈ W.A, p ∣ n → ∃ j, 1 ≤ j ∧ j ≤ H ∧ n = p * j) :
    W.selRow p = ∅ := by
  ext n
  simp only [Word.selRow, Finset.mem_filter, Finset.notMem_empty, iff_false, not_and]
  exact selRow_empty_of_bounded_cofactors W hp hpB hcof n

/-- Row rigidity with the cofactor bound derived from `M < p (H + 1)`. -/
theorem selRow_empty_of_lt (W : ExactWord) {p H : ℕ} (hp : p.Prime) (hpB : BH H < p)
    (hM : W.M < p * (H + 1)) : ∀ n ∈ W.A, ¬ p ∣ n :=
  selRow_empty_of_bounded_cofactors W hp hpB (cofactor_bound_of_lt W.toWord hM)

/-- **Adjacent empty rows contradict gap-two.**  If `n, n+1 ∈ [a, M]`, `p ∣ n`, `q ∣ n+1`, and
both rows are rigid (prime, above `B_H`, bounded cofactors), the exact word cannot exist. -/
theorem adjacent_empty_rows_contradiction (W : ExactWord) {p q H H' n : ℕ}
    (hp : p.Prime) (hq : q.Prime) (hpB : BH H < p) (hqB : BH H' < q)
    (hcofp : ∀ x ∈ W.A, p ∣ x → ∃ j, 1 ≤ j ∧ j ≤ H ∧ x = p * j)
    (hcofq : ∀ x ∈ W.A, q ∣ x → ∃ j, 1 ≤ j ∧ j ≤ H' ∧ x = q * j)
    (hpn : p ∣ n) (hqn : q ∣ n + 1) (hn : W.a ≤ n) (hn1 : n + 1 ≤ W.M) : False :=
  omitted_neighbours W.toWord hn hn1
    (fun h => selRow_empty_of_bounded_cofactors W hp hpB hcofp n h hpn)
    (fun h => selRow_empty_of_bounded_cofactors W hq hqB hcofq (n + 1) h hqn)

/-- A **contact witness** for an exact word: two rigid prime rows meeting adjacent window
positions.  All fields are concrete numerical facts. -/
structure ContactWitness (W : ExactWord) where
  p : ℕ
  q : ℕ
  H : ℕ
  n : ℕ
  hp : p.Prime
  hq : q.Prime
  hpB : BH H < p
  hqB : BH H < q
  hpM : W.M < p * (H + 1)
  hqM : W.M < q * (H + 1)
  hpn : p ∣ n
  hqn : q ∣ n + 1
  hn : W.a ≤ n
  hn1 : n + 1 ≤ W.M

/-- **No exact word admits a contact witness.** -/
theorem ContactWitness.false {W : ExactWord} (c : ContactWitness W) : False :=
  adjacent_empty_rows_contradiction W c.hp c.hq c.hpB c.hqB
    (cofactor_bound_of_lt W.toWord c.hpM) (cofactor_bound_of_lt W.toWord c.hqM)
    c.hpn c.hqn c.hn c.hn1

end Erdos287.PostV87V90R

@@END_FILE@@

import RequestProject.Erdos287.PostV87V90R.OccupancyContact

/-!
# Erdős #287 — post-V87 → V90R: the width-`> 3` theorem W3 (CONDITIONAL)

**ERDŐS #287 REMAINS OPEN.  W3 is proved here only from an explicit, never-constructed
analytic provider.**

## Factoring

1. **Finite compiler** — `AffineContactCompiler (4m+1) m K` (data with proved fields).
2. **Analytic moment provider** — `WindowMomentData C H a M`: for the *window* `[a, M]` only
   (no reference to any hypothetical counterexample), a finite weighted parameter set with
   * first moment `𝔼P ≥ μ > 0`,
   * pair moment `𝔼Q ≤ C μ²/(2r)`,
   * pair constant `C < r/m` (`= 4 + 1/m` for `r = 4m+1`: the classical `4 + η` constant
     with `η < 1/m`, see `pairConstant_iff`),
   * first-moment size `μ > m r/(r - mC)`,
   * window control (source window, row bound, big prime) on the support.
3. **Moment-to-occupancy consumer** — `occupancy_of_normalized_moments` (unconditional).
4. **Occupancy-to-contact consumer** — `occupancy_contact_false` (unconditional).

`WidthThreeMomentProvider s` bundles `m` with `3 + 1/m < s` (`width`), the compiler, `H`, an
**explicit onset** and window-level moment data for every *wide window*
(`WideWindow s onset a M`: `1 < a`, `onset ≤ M`, `s a ≤ M`, `e(a-1) < M ≤ e²(a+1)`).

*Semantic audit.*  The moment field is quantified over windows `(a, M)`, which provably exist
for every `3 < s ≤ 7` and every onset (`wideWindow_exists`); it is a genuine prime-distribution
statement.  Quantifying it over hypothetical exact words instead would make it trivially
inhabitable from tail exclusion (`RegressionSuite.wordQuantified_provider_trivial`).

## Results

* `W3_of_provider` : `WidthThreeMomentProvider s → W3Statement s` (**conditional**);
* `W3_counterexample_form` — the same in the language of `Erdos287Counterexample`, with
  `M / min A ≥ s`;
* `W3_family_of_providers` — a uniform provider family for `3 < s ≤ 7` gives `W3Statement s`
  for *every* `s > 3` (monotonicity, `W3Statement.mono`).

No inhabitant of `WidthThreeMomentProvider` is constructed anywhere: **W3 is CONDITIONAL**.
-/

open scoped BigOperators
open Classical

namespace Erdos287.PostV87V90R

open Erdos287 Erdos287.PostV71V87

section Window

variable {r m K : ℕ} [NeZero r]

/-- **Window-level analytic moment data** for a compiler on the window `[a, M]`.  Every field
is a concrete numerical inequality; nothing refers to a hypothetical counterexample. -/
structure WindowMomentData (C : AffineContactCompiler r m K) (H a M : ℕ) where
  /-- Finite weighted parameter set. -/
  F : FiniteWeights
  /-- First-moment lower bound. -/
  μ : ℝ
  /-- Normalised pair constant. -/
  Cpair : ℝ
  hμ : 0 < μ
  firstMoment : μ ≤ F.E (fun t => (Pcount (blockCount C) t : ℝ))
  pairMoment : F.E (fun t => (Qcount (blockCount C) t : ℝ)) ≤ Cpair * μ ^ 2 / (2 * r)
  pairConstant : Cpair < r / m
  firstMomentLarge : (m : ℝ) * r / (r - m * Cpair) < μ
  scaleControl : ∀ t ∈ F.T, 0 < F.w t → WindowControl C a M H t

/-- Window moment data at the window of an exact word is contradictory. -/
theorem WindowMomentData.false {C : AffineContactCompiler r m K} {H : ℕ} {W : ExactWord}
    (D : WindowMomentData C H W.a W.M) (hm : 1 ≤ m) (hr : 2 * m ≤ r) : False :=
  moment_contact_false W C hm hr D.F D.hμ D.firstMoment D.pairMoment D.pairConstant
    D.firstMomentLarge D.scaleControl

end Window

/-- Admissible wide windows. -/
def WideWindow (s : ℝ) (onset a M : ℕ) : Prop :=
  1 < a ∧ onset ≤ M ∧ s * a ≤ M ∧ Real.exp 1 * ((a : ℝ) - 1) < M ∧
    (M : ℝ) ≤ Real.exp 1 ^ 2 * ((a : ℝ) + 1)

/-- **Explicit analytic provider for W3 at width `s`** (never constructed here). -/
structure WidthThreeMomentProvider (s : ℝ) where
  hs : 3 < s
  hs7 : s ≤ 7
  m : ℕ
  hm : 1 ≤ m
  /-- Graph width `((4m+1) - m)/m = 3 + 1/m < s`. -/
  width : (((4 * m + 1 : ℕ) : ℝ) - m) / m < s
  K : ℕ
  compiler : AffineContactCompiler (4 * m + 1) m K
  H : ℕ
  /-- Explicit, uniform onset. -/
  onset : ℕ
  moments : ∀ a M : ℕ, WideWindow s onset a M → WindowMomentData compiler H a M

/-- The block number `r = 4m + 1` of a W3 provider. -/
def WidthThreeMomentProvider.blocks {s : ℝ} (P : WidthThreeMomentProvider s) : ℕ := 4 * P.m + 1

/-- For `r = 4m+1` the pair-constant condition `C < r/m` is `C < 4 + 1/m`. -/
theorem pairConstant_iff {m : ℕ} (hm : 1 ≤ m) (C : ℝ) :
    C < ((4 * m + 1 : ℕ) : ℝ) / m ↔ C < 4 + 1 / m := by
  have : (m : ℝ) ≠ 0 := by exact_mod_cast (by omega : m ≠ 0)
  have e : ((4 * m + 1 : ℕ) : ℝ) / m = 4 + 1 / m := by push_cast; field_simp
  rw [e]

/-- The W3 conclusion at width `s`: beyond some `M_s`, no exact word has `M ≥ s a`. -/
def W3Statement (s : ℝ) : Prop :=
  ∃ Ms : ℕ, ∀ W : ExactWord, 1 < W.a → Ms ≤ W.M → s * W.a ≤ W.M → False

theorem W3Statement.mono {s s' : ℝ} (h : W3Statement s) (hss : s ≤ s') : W3Statement s' := by
  obtain ⟨Ms, hMs⟩ := h
  refine ⟨Ms, fun W ha hM hs => hMs W ha hM ?_⟩
  have : (0 : ℝ) ≤ W.a := by positivity
  nlinarith

/-- **W3 (CONDITIONAL).**  `WidthThreeMomentProvider s → W3Statement s`, with `M_s` the
provider's explicit onset. -/
theorem W3_of_provider {s : ℝ} (P : WidthThreeMomentProvider s) :
    ∀ W : ExactWord, 1 < W.a → P.onset ≤ W.M → s * W.a ≤ W.M → False := by
  intro W ha hM hs
  exact (P.moments W.a W.M ⟨ha, hM, hs, ExactWord.exp_lower W ha, ExactWord.exp_upper W ha⟩).false
    P.hm (by omega)

theorem W3Statement_of_provider {s : ℝ} (P : WidthThreeMomentProvider s) : W3Statement s :=
  ⟨P.onset, W3_of_provider P⟩

/-- **W3 in counterexample language (CONDITIONAL).**  For every Erdős #287 counterexample `A`
with `max A ≥ M_s`, the width satisfies `max A / min A < s`. -/
theorem W3_counterexample_form {s : ℝ} (P : WidthThreeMomentProvider s) :
    ∃ Ms : ℕ, ∀ A : Finset ℕ, ∀ h : Erdos287Counterexample A, Ms ≤ A.max' h.nonempty →
      s ≤ (A.max' h.nonempty : ℝ) / A.min' h.nonempty → False := by
  refine ⟨P.onset, fun A h hM hs => ?_⟩
  have ha := ofCounterexample_one_lt_a h
  have hapos : (0 : ℝ) < (ofCounterexample h).a := by positivity
  refine W3_of_provider P (ofCounterexample h) ha hM ?_
  rw [ofCounterexample_a] at hapos ⊢
  rw [ofCounterexample_M]
  rwa [le_div_iff₀ hapos] at hs

/-- **W3 family (CONDITIONAL).**  A uniform provider family on `3 < s ≤ 7` yields W3 at every
width `s > 3`. -/
theorem W3_family_of_providers
    (Pfam : ∀ s : ℝ, 3 < s → s ≤ 7 → WidthThreeMomentProvider s) :
    ∀ s : ℝ, 3 < s → W3Statement s := by
  intro s hs
  rcases le_total s 7 with h7 | h7
  · exact W3Statement_of_provider (Pfam s hs h7)
  · exact (W3Statement_of_provider (Pfam 7 (by norm_num) le_rfl)).mono h7

/-- `e² > 7`. -/
theorem seven_lt_exp_sq : (7 : ℝ) < Real.exp 1 ^ 2 := by
  have := Real.exp_one_gt_d9
  nlinarith

/-- **Non-vacuity of the provider's moment field:** wide windows exist for every
`3 < s ≤ 7` and every onset. -/
theorem wideWindow_exists {s : ℝ} (hs : 3 < s) (hs7 : s ≤ 7) (onset : ℕ) :
    ∃ a M : ℕ, WideWindow s onset a M := by
  set a := onset + 2 with ha
  refine ⟨a, ⌈s * a⌉₊, by omega, ?_, Nat.le_ceil _, ?_, ?_⟩
  · have h1 : (onset : ℝ) ≤ s * a := by
      have : (onset : ℝ) ≤ a := by rw [ha]; push_cast; linarith
      have : (0 : ℝ) ≤ a := by positivity
      nlinarith
    exact_mod_cast le_trans h1 (Nat.le_ceil _)
  · have he := Real.exp_one_lt_d9
    have h1 : (a : ℝ) ≥ 2 := by rw [ha]; push_cast; linarith
    have : Real.exp 1 * ((a : ℝ) - 1) < s * a := by nlinarith [Real.exp_pos 1]
    exact lt_of_lt_of_le this (Nat.le_ceil _)
  · have hc := Nat.ceil_lt_add_one (show (0 : ℝ) ≤ s * a by positivity)
    have h7 := seven_lt_exp_sq
    have h1 : (a : ℝ) ≥ 2 := by rw [ha]; push_cast; linarith
    have : s * a + 1 ≤ Real.exp 1 ^ 2 * ((a : ℝ) + 1) := by nlinarith
    linarith

end Erdos287.PostV87V90R

@@BEGIN_FILE bytes=6307 sha256=707c7bde100786ea5edcd0014fee171ccc4dda2524c024324136f6c61dd005ef path=LEAN_PROJECT/RequestProject/Erdos287/PostV87V90R/audit.sh@@
#!/usr/bin/env bash
# Erdős #287 post-V87 → V90R subtree: source / build / provider / axiom audit.
# Run from anywhere:  bash RequestProject/Erdos287/PostV87V90R/audit.sh
# Every check fails loudly (non-zero exit).
set -u
cd "$(dirname "$0")/../../.."
SUB=RequestProject/Erdos287/PostV87V90R
FILES="$SUB/*.lean RequestProject/Erdos287/PostV87V90R.lean"
fail=0
bad() { echo "FAIL: $*"; fail=1; }
strip() { perl -0pe 's{/-.*?-/}{}gs; s{--[^\n]*}{}g' "$1"; }

echo "== 1. forbidden tokens in code (comments/docstrings stripped)"
probe_code=$(printf 'theorem t : True := by\n  sorry\n' | perl -0pe 's{/-.*?-/}{}gs; s{--[^\n]*}{}g')
probe_cmt=$(printf '/- sorry -/\ntheorem t : True := trivial -- sorry\n' | perl -0pe 's{/-.*?-/}{}gs; s{--[^\n]*}{}g')
echo "$probe_code" | grep -Pq '\bsorry\b' || bad "scanner self-test: planted sorry not detected"
echo "$probe_cmt" | grep -Pq '\bsorry\b' && bad "scanner self-test: comment not stripped"
for f in $FILES; do
  code=$(strip "$f")
  for pat in '\bsorry\b' '\badmit\b' '^\s*axiom\b' '\bunsafe\b' '\bnative_decide\b' \
             '\bbv_decide\b' 'implemented_by' '\bopaque\b' '\bextern\b' 'ofReduceBool' \
             'Inhabited' 'False\.elim' '\bIsEmpty\b' 'Nonempty\s*\(\s*(WidthThreeMomentProvider|E287_11_4_Provider|NarrowWidthClosureProvider)'; do
    case "$f:$pat" in *AxiomAudit.lean:*IsEmpty*|*AxiomAudit.lean:*False*) continue;; esac
    if echo "$code" | grep -Pq "$pat"; then bad "$f matches $pat"; fi
  done
done

echo "== 2. obsolete 11/6 constant absent from all code except the regression fixture"
for f in $FILES; do
  case "$f" in *RegressionSuite.lean) continue;; esac
  if strip "$f" | grep -Pq '11\s*/\s*6'; then bad "$f uses the obsolete constant 11/6"; fi
done

echo "== 3. no provider is constructed in code (no anonymous-constructor / where-instance of a provider)"
for f in $FILES; do
  code=$(strip "$f")
  for p in WidthThreeMomentProvider E287_11_4_Provider NarrowWidthClosureProvider WindowMomentData AffineContactCompiler; do
    # a construction has the provider as its *result type*: `def x ... : <Provider> args :=`/`where`
    # (binder occurrences such as `(P : <Provider> s)` are excluded because `[^():\n]*` stops at `)`)
    re="^\\s*(noncomputable\\s+)?(def|instance|example|abbrev|theorem)\\b[^\\n]*:\\s*$p\\b[^():\\n]*(:=|where)"
    hits=$(echo "$code" | grep -P "$re" | grep -v "def E287_11_4 {s : ℝ} (P : E287_11_4_Provider s) : NarrowWidthClosureProvider s" || true)
    if [ -n "$hits" ]; then echo "$hits"; bad "$f constructs $p"; fi
  done
done

echo "== 4. historical files unchanged"
BASE=$(git rev-list --max-parents=0 HEAD | tail -1)
if ! git diff --quiet "$BASE" -- RequestProject/Erdos287/PostV64V71 RequestProject/Erdos287/PostV64V71.lean \
     RequestProject/Erdos287/PostV71V87 RequestProject/Erdos287/PostV71V87.lean ARISTOTLE_SUMMARY.md; then
  bad "historical files modified"
fi
changed=$(git diff --name-only "$BASE" -- . | grep -v "^$SUB/" \
  | grep -v "^RequestProject/Erdos287/PostV87V90R.lean$" \
  | grep -v "^ERDOS287_POSTV87_V90R_REPORT.md$" || true)
if [ -n "$changed" ]; then bad "files changed outside the new subtree: $changed"; fi

echo "== 5. narrow build (runs #assert_std_axioms_v90, #assert_(un)conditional, #audit_providers_v90)"
if ! lake build RequestProject.Erdos287.PostV87V90R > /tmp/pv90_build.log 2>&1; then
  tail -30 /tmp/pv90_build.log; bad "narrow build failed"
fi
grep -q "provider audit passed" /tmp/pv90_build.log || \
  grep -q "Replayed RequestProject.Erdos287.PostV87V90R.AxiomAudit" /tmp/pv90_build.log || \
  grep -q "Built RequestProject.Erdos287.PostV87V90R" /tmp/pv90_build.log || bad "audit module not built"

echo "== 6. negative controls (each must FAIL to elaborate)"
mk() { cat > "/tmp/pv90_neg$1.lean"; }
mk 1 <<'X'
import RequestProject.Erdos287.PostV87V90R.AxiomAudit
theorem bad_sorry : 1 = 2 := by sorry
#assert_std_axioms_v90 bad_sorry
X
mk 2 <<'X'
import RequestProject.Erdos287.PostV87V90R.AxiomAudit
theorem bad_native : 10 < 20 := by native_decide
#assert_std_axioms_v90 bad_native
X
mk 3 <<'X'
import RequestProject.Erdos287.PostV87V90R.AxiomAudit
namespace Erdos287.PostV87V90R
def fakeNarrow (h : False) : NarrowWidthClosureProvider 4 := h.elim
end Erdos287.PostV87V90R
#audit_providers_v90
X
mk 4 <<'X'
import RequestProject.Erdos287.PostV87V90R.AxiomAudit
namespace Erdos287.PostV87V90R
def fakeNarrow2 [IsEmpty Erdos287.PostV71V87.ExactWord] : NarrowWidthClosureProvider 4 :=
  ⟨by norm_num, 0, fun W _ => IsEmpty.false W⟩
end Erdos287.PostV87V90R
#audit_providers_v90
X
mk 5 <<'X'
import RequestProject.Erdos287.PostV87V90R.AxiomAudit
namespace Erdos287.PostV87V90R
def emptyCompiler : AffineContactCompiler 11 3 0 where
  slope := fun _ i => i.elim0
  slope_pos := fun _ i => i.elim0
  edge_ne := fun _ _ i => i.elim0
  edge_gcd := fun _ _ i => i.elim0
  ratio := 0
  scale_ratio := fun _ i => i.elim0
end Erdos287.PostV87V90R
#audit_providers_v90
X
mk 6 <<'X'
import RequestProject.Erdos287.PostV87V90R.AxiomAudit
namespace Erdos287.PostV87V90R
theorem overstated (W : Erdos287.PostV71V87.ExactWord) (P : WidthThreeMomentProvider 4) :
    1 < W.a → P.onset ≤ W.M → (4 : ℝ) * W.a ≤ W.M → False := W3_of_provider P W
end Erdos287.PostV87V90R
#assert_unconditional Erdos287.PostV87V90R.overstated
X
mk 7 <<'X'
import RequestProject.Erdos287.PostV87V90R.AxiomAudit
namespace Erdos287.PostV87V90R
theorem bad_trivial_provider : Nonempty (WidthThreeMomentProvider 4) := by
  exact ⟨by trivial⟩
end Erdos287.PostV87V90R
X
# expected rejection reason for each control (so a control cannot "pass" by an unrelated error)
expect=( "" "non-standard axiom sorryAx" "non-standard axiom Lean.ofReduceBool" \
  "provider constructed" "provider constructed" "provider constructed" \
  "labelled unconditional" "error" )
for n in 1 2 3 4 5 6 7; do
  if lake env lean /tmp/pv90_neg$n.lean > /tmp/pv90_neg$n.log 2>&1; then
    bad "negative control $n unexpectedly elaborated"
  elif ! grep -q "${expect[$n]}" /tmp/pv90_neg$n.log; then
    cat /tmp/pv90_neg$n.log | head -5; bad "negative control $n rejected for an unexpected reason"
  else
    echo "  negative control $n rejected: $(grep -m1 -E 'error' /tmp/pv90_neg$n.log | cut -c1-160)"
  fi
done

if [ $fail -ne 0 ]; then echo "AUDIT FAILED"; exit 1; fi
echo "AUDIT PASSED"

@@END_FILE@@

import RequestProject.Erdos287.ResearchBankV13.HarmonicTwoHole

/-!
# Erdős #287 — Research Bank V13 §21: adjacent prime-layer certificates (two families)

INTERNAL #287 RESEARCH PROGRAMME ONLY.  **Erdős #287 is `OPEN` here and is not claimed.**

**Family A** (`familyA_interval`): `p = 2q + 1`, `p, q` prime, `q > 137`.  For every endpoint
`p − 1 ≤ M ≤ ⌊(685/252) p⌋`:
* `p` is forbidden (prime layer, `r = p`, `J = 2`, `A 2 = 3 < p`, `M < 3p`);
* `p − 1 = 2q` is forbidden (prime layer, `r = q`, `J = 5`, `A 5 = 137 < q`, `M < 6q`);
so the two-hole theorem excludes the whole interval.

**Family B** (`familyB_interval`): `p = 4q + 1`, `p, q` prime, `q > 7381`.  Same conclusion using
`J = 10` for `q` (`A 10 = 7381 < q`, `M < 11q`) and `J = 2` for `p`.

`familyB_outside_goodPrimeHalf`: for `q > 3`, Family B is genuinely outside the earlier
"good-prime half" class: `(p−1)/2 = 2q` is composite and `(p+1)/2 = 2q+1` is divisible by `3`
and `> 3`.
-/

namespace Erdos287
namespace ResearchBankV13
namespace AdjacentPrimeLayer

open FiniteRepresentationModel PrimeLayer HarmonicTwoHole

/-- **Family A.** -/
theorem familyA_interval {p q : ℕ} (hp : p.Prime) (hq : q.Prime) (hpq : p = 2 * q + 1)
    (hq137 : 137 < q) :
    ∀ M, p - 1 ≤ M → M ≤ etaFloor p → NoCounterexampleAt M := by
  have hp1 : p - 1 + 1 = p := by omega
  intro M h1 h2
  refine interval_exclusion_of_adjacent_holes (h := p - 1) (lo := p - 1) (hi := etaFloor p)
    le_rfl (by rw [hp1]) ?_ M h1 h2
  intro A hA hlo hhi
  have hhi' : 252 * A.max' hA.nonempty ≤ 685 * p := by unfold etaFloor at hhi; omega
  refine ⟨?_, ?_⟩
  · -- `p − 1 = 2q` is forbidden via the `q`-layer with `J = 5`
    intro hmem
    have hM : A.max' hA.nonempty < (5 + 1) * q := by omega
    exact primeLayer_exclusion hA hq hM (by rw [A_5]; omega) _ hmem
      ⟨2, by omega⟩
  · -- `p` is forbidden via the `p`-layer with `J = 2`
    intro hmem
    have hM : A.max' hA.nonempty < (2 + 1) * p := by omega
    rw [hp1] at hmem
    exact primeLayer_exclusion hA hp hM (by rw [A_2]; omega) _ hmem dvd_rfl

/-- **Family B.** -/
theorem familyB_interval {p q : ℕ} (hp : p.Prime) (hq : q.Prime) (hpq : p = 4 * q + 1)
    (hq7381 : 7381 < q) :
    ∀ M, p - 1 ≤ M → M ≤ etaFloor p → NoCounterexampleAt M := by
  have hp1 : p - 1 + 1 = p := by omega
  intro M h1 h2
  refine interval_exclusion_of_adjacent_holes (h := p - 1) (lo := p - 1) (hi := etaFloor p)
    le_rfl (by rw [hp1]) ?_ M h1 h2
  intro A hA hlo hhi
  have hhi' : 252 * A.max' hA.nonempty ≤ 685 * p := by unfold etaFloor at hhi; omega
  refine ⟨?_, ?_⟩
  · intro hmem
    have hM : A.max' hA.nonempty < (10 + 1) * q := by omega
    exact primeLayer_exclusion hA hq hM (by rw [A_10]; omega) _ hmem ⟨4, by omega⟩
  · intro hmem
    have hM : A.max' hA.nonempty < (2 + 1) * p := by omega
    rw [hp1] at hmem
    exact primeLayer_exclusion hA hp hM (by rw [A_2]; omega) _ hmem dvd_rfl

/-- **Family B is outside the good-prime-half class** (for `q > 3`). -/
theorem familyB_outside_goodPrimeHalf {p q : ℕ} (hp : p.Prime) (hq : q.Prime)
    (hpq : p = 4 * q + 1) (hq3 : 3 < q) :
    (p - 1) / 2 = 2 * q ∧ ¬ (2 * q).Prime ∧ (p + 1) / 2 = 2 * q + 1 ∧ 3 ∣ 2 * q + 1 ∧
      3 < 2 * q + 1 := by
  have hcomp : ¬ (2 * q).Prime := by
    rw [Nat.prime_mul_iff]; omega
  have hq3' : ¬ 3 ∣ q := by
    intro h
    have := (Nat.prime_dvd_prime_iff_eq Nat.prime_three hq).1 h
    omega
  have hp3 : ¬ 3 ∣ p := by
    intro h
    have := (Nat.prime_dvd_prime_iff_eq Nat.prime_three hp).1 h
    omega
  refine ⟨by omega, hcomp, by omega, ?_, by omega⟩
  have hmod : q % 3 = 1 ∨ q % 3 = 2 := by omega
  rcases hmod with h | h
  · omega
  · exact absurd (by omega : 3 ∣ p) hp3

/-! ## Small kernel-checked instances of the family hypotheses -/

/-- `q = 173`, `p = 347` is a Family-A pair (primality by `norm_num`). -/
theorem familyA_instance : ∀ M, 346 ≤ M → M ≤ etaFloor 347 → NoCounterexampleAt M :=
  familyA_interval (p := 347) (q := 173) (by norm_num) (by norm_num) rfl (by norm_num)

theorem etaFloor_347 : etaFloor 347 = 943 := by decide

end AdjacentPrimeLayer
end ResearchBankV13
end Erdos287
