import RequestProject.Erdos287.ResearchBankV27.DecoratedMaynardSetup

/-!
# Erdős #287 — Research Bank V27 §5.9: the ONE minimal DI / spectral provider

INTERNAL #287 RESEARCH PROGRAMME ONLY.  **Erdős #287 is `OPEN` here and is not claimed.**

`DISpectralProvider` is the single public Deshouillers–Iwaniec / Maynard spectral input used
AFTER the grouped coefficient has been constructed.  It is an EXTERNAL PROVIDER (never
constructed).  Its contract exposes exactly:

* the modulus variables `Q, R, S, N, d` and the scale `x`;
* the smooth Kloostermann-type kernel `Kl(b; z)` on regrouped outer variables `b` and grouped
  frequencies `z`;
* the coefficient vector `c(z)`, required to be supported on the off-diagonal range `offDiag`;
* the coefficient `L²` norm `‖c‖₂ = (Σ_z |c(z)|²)^{1/2}`;
* the loss `ε_DI`;
* the output bound `|Σ_b Σ_z c(z) Kl(b; z)| ≤ x^{ε_DI} Ξ ‖c‖₂`, together with its Maynard
  normalisation `mass · Ξ · √Rep ≤ N_q² T (Δ₂ + Δ₃)^{1/2}`.

Admissibility (`MaynardAdmissible`) is the literal range condition of §5.2 with `ε_DI = η/4`.
The provider replaces the former monolithic V16 source-class provider; nothing else analytic
about the clean sum is assumed.
-/

namespace Erdos287
namespace ResearchBankV27
namespace DISpectral

open DecoratedMaynardSetup

/-- The data of one Kloosterman-type bilinear form (modulus variables, kernel, range, loss,
normalisation parameters). -/
structure KloostermanData where
  B : Type
  Z : Type
  [fB : Fintype B]
  [fZ : Fintype Z]
  [dZ : DecidableEq Z]
  Kl : B → Z → ℂ
  offDiag : Finset Z
  Q : ℝ
  R : ℝ
  S : ℝ
  N : ℝ
  d : ℝ
  x : ℝ
  epsDI : ℝ
  Xi : ℝ
  mass : ℝ
  Rep : ℝ
  Nq : ℝ
  T : ℝ
  Delta2 : ℝ
  Delta3 : ℝ

attribute [instance] KloostermanData.fB KloostermanData.fZ KloostermanData.dZ

/-- The bilinear form `Σ_b Σ_z c(z) Kl(b; z)`. -/
noncomputable def bilinear (K : KloostermanData) (c : K.Z → ℂ) : ℂ :=
  ∑ b, ∑ z, c z * K.Kl b z

/-- The coefficient `L²` norm. -/
noncomputable def l2 {Z : Type} [Fintype Z] (c : Z → ℂ) : ℝ := Real.sqrt (∑ z, ‖c z‖ ^ 2)

/-- The conclusion of the DI / spectral estimate for one form. -/
def DIConclusion (K : KloostermanData) : Prop :=
  0 ≤ K.Xi ∧
    (∀ c : K.Z → ℂ, (∀ z, z ∉ K.offDiag → c z = 0) →
      ‖bilinear K c‖ ≤ K.x ^ K.epsDI * K.Xi * l2 c) ∧
    K.mass * K.Xi * Real.sqrt K.Rep ≤ K.Nq ^ 2 * K.T * Real.sqrt (K.Delta2 + K.Delta3)

/-- Maynard admissibility: literal range conditions of §5.2 and `ε_DI = η/4`. -/
def MaynardAdmissible (η : ℝ) (K : KloostermanData) : Prop :=
  1 < K.x ∧ K.epsDI = η / 4 ∧ RangeConditions K.N K.R K.S K.Q K.x η ∧
    K.Delta2 = Delta2 K.N K.R K.S K.Q K.x ∧ K.Delta3 = Delta3 K.N K.R K.S K.Q K.x

/-- **The ONE minimal DI / spectral provider** (EXTERNAL PROVIDER; never constructed).
`DIClass` is the class of bilinear forms covered by the public Deshouillers–Iwaniec /
Maynard spectral estimate (forms whose kernel is the smooth Kloosterman-type sum of the decorated lemma, with its
true normalisation parameters); membership of each realized form is certified by the clean
realization.  Without such a class restriction the statement is FALSE
(`unrestricted_provider_false`). -/
structure DISpectralProvider (η : ℝ) (DIClass : KloostermanData → Prop) : Prop where
  spectral : ∀ K : KloostermanData, DIClass K → MaynardAdmissible η K → DIConclusion K

/-- A degenerate admissible form violating the DI conclusion: `Kl ≡ 1` on one point, `Ξ = 0`. -/
noncomputable def degenerateForm (η : ℝ) : KloostermanData where
  B := Unit
  Z := Unit
  Kl := fun _ _ => 1
  offDiag := Finset.univ
  Q := 0
  R := 0
  S := 0
  N := 0
  d := 0
  x := 2
  epsDI := η / 4
  Xi := 0
  mass := 0
  Rep := 0
  Nq := 0
  T := 0
  Delta2 := 0
  Delta3 := 0

theorem degenerateForm_admissible (η : ℝ) : MaynardAdmissible η (degenerateForm η) := by
  refine ⟨by norm_num [degenerateForm], rfl, ⟨?_, ?_, ?_⟩, ?_, ?_⟩ <;>
    simp [degenerateForm, Delta1, Delta2, Delta3, Real.rpow_nonneg]

theorem degenerateForm_not_DI (η : ℝ) : ¬ DIConclusion (degenerateForm η) := by
  rintro ⟨-, hb, -⟩
  have := hb (fun _ => 1) (fun z hz => absurd (Finset.mem_univ z) hz)
  simp [bilinear, degenerateForm] at this
  linarith

/-- **The DI conclusion is not automatic** (FINITE REGRESSION): some admissible form violates it. -/
theorem DI_not_automatic : ¬ ∀ K : KloostermanData, DIConclusion K :=
  fun h => degenerateForm_not_DI 0 (h _)

/-- **The unrestricted provider is false** (FINITE REGRESSION): the class restriction is
load-bearing. -/
theorem unrestricted_provider_false (η : ℝ) : ¬ DISpectralProvider η (fun _ => True) :=
  fun h => degenerateForm_not_DI η (h.spectral _ trivial (degenerateForm_admissible η))

/-- Admissible forms satisfy the range bounds on `Δ₂, Δ₃` (LEAN BANK bookkeeping). -/
theorem admissible_delta_bounds {η : ℝ} {K : KloostermanData} (h : MaynardAdmissible η K) :
    K.Delta2 ≤ K.x ^ (-14 * η) ∧ K.Delta3 ≤ K.x ^ (-14 * η) := by
  obtain ⟨-, -, ⟨-, h2, h3⟩, e2, e3⟩ := h
  exact ⟨e2 ▸ h2, e3 ▸ h3⟩

end DISpectral
end ResearchBankV27
end Erdos287

@@END_FILE@@
@@BEGIN_FILE bytes=17979 sha256=738be5f62df06aad344815652c63baed334ebfe23c7f6143c048469a68cbf304 path=LEAN_PROJECT/RequestProject/Erdos287/ResearchBankV27/DecoratedLemma.lean@@
import RequestProject.Erdos287.ResearchBankV27.RepresentationMoment
import RequestProject.Erdos287.ResearchBankV27.DISpectralProvider

/-!
# Erdős #287 — Research Bank V27 §5.10: the master decorated bound

INTERNAL #287 RESEARCH PROGRAMME ONLY.  **Erdős #287 is `OPEN` here and is not claimed.**

A `DecoratedData` bundles one decorated sum: outer set `O`, inner set `I`, outer coefficient `A`
with Cauchy weights `w` (total `mass`), kernel `K(o; i)`, grouping `grp`, and the Kloosterman
form `KD` of the regrouped outer variables, with the exact regrouping hypothesis `hgrp`.

**EXTERNAL PROVIDER.**
* `RepresentationMomentProvider` — the divisor-type representation bounds
  `Σ_{z off-diag} A_z² ≤ Rep` and the diagonal (`ht = ks`) contribution
  `mass · Σ_{z diag} A_z Σ_b |Kl(b;z)| ≤ x^ε N_q² T Δ₁`.

**LEAN CONDITIONAL** (on `DIConclusion`, i.e. on `DISpectralProvider`, and on
`RepresentationMomentProvider`):
* **`decorated_energy_bound`** — for EVERY one-bounded inner decoration `Ψ`:
  `mass · V(Ψ) ≤ x^ε N_q² T Δ₁ + x^{ε_DI} N_q² T (Δ₂+Δ₃)^{1/2}`;
* **`decorated_master_bound`** — `|W(A,Ψ)| ≤ N_q √T [x^{ε/2} √Δ₁ + x^{ε_DI/2} (Δ₂+Δ₃)^{1/4}]`.

**LEAN BANK** (exponent arithmetic, `T ≤ x^{η/4+ε}`, `ε_DI = η/4`, `0 ≤ ε ≤ η`):
* `first_part_saving` — `√T · x^{ε/2} √Δ₁ ≤ x^{ε − 27η/8}`;
* `second_part_saving` — `√T · x^{η/8} (Δ₂+Δ₃)^{1/4} ≤ 2^{1/4} x^{ε/2 − 13η/4}`;
* `energy_instantiation` — `T (x^ε Δ₁ + x^{η/4} (Δ₂+Δ₃)^{1/2}) ≤ 3 x^{−2η}`;
* **`decorated_conservative`** (LEAN CONDITIONAL) — `mass · V(Ψ) ≤ 3 N_q² x^{−2η}` and
  `|W(A,Ψ)| ≤ √3 N_q x^{−η}`.
-/

namespace Erdos287
namespace ResearchBankV27
namespace DecoratedLemma

open Finset CommonCauchy GroupedCoefficient RepresentationMoment DISpectral

/-- One decorated sum together with its Kloosterman form. -/
structure DecoratedData where
  O : Type
  I : Type
  [fO : Fintype O]
  [fI : Fintype I]
  KD : KloostermanData
  A : O → ℂ
  w : O → ℝ
  hA : ∀ o, ‖A o‖ ^ 2 ≤ w o
  hmass : ∑ o, w o = KD.mass
  K : O → I → ℂ
  grp : I → I → KD.Z
  hgrp : ∀ i i', ∑ o, K o i * starRingEnd ℂ (K o i') = ∑ b, KD.Kl b (grp i i')
  Delta1 : ℝ
  eps : ℝ

attribute [instance] DecoratedData.fO DecoratedData.fI

/-- **Representation-moment / diagonal provider** (EXTERNAL PROVIDER; never constructed). -/
structure RepresentationMomentProvider (D : DecoratedData) : Prop where
  rep : ∑ z ∈ D.KD.offDiag, repCount D.grp z ^ 2 ≤ D.KD.Rep
  diag : D.KD.mass * ∑ z ∈ univ.filter (fun z => z ∉ D.KD.offDiag),
      repCount D.grp z * ∑ b, ‖D.KD.Kl b z‖ ≤
    D.KD.x ^ D.eps * D.KD.Nq ^ 2 * D.KD.T * D.Delta1

theorem sqrt_add_le_sqrt_add {a b : ℝ} (ha : 0 ≤ a) (hb : 0 ≤ b) :
    Real.sqrt (a + b) ≤ Real.sqrt a + Real.sqrt b := by
  rw [Real.sqrt_le_left (by positivity)]
  nlinarith [Real.sq_sqrt ha, Real.sq_sqrt hb, Real.sqrt_nonneg a, Real.sqrt_nonneg b,
    mul_nonneg (Real.sqrt_nonneg a) (Real.sqrt_nonneg b)]

theorem sqrt_rpow_half {x : ℝ} (hx : 0 ≤ x) (e : ℝ) : Real.sqrt (x ^ e) = x ^ (e / 2) := by
  rw [Real.sqrt_eq_rpow, ← Real.rpow_mul hx]; ring_nf

theorem mass_nonneg (D : DecoratedData) : 0 ≤ D.KD.mass := by
  rw [← D.hmass]
  exact Finset.sum_nonneg fun o _ => (sq_nonneg _).trans (D.hA o)

/-- **Decorated energy bound** (LEAN CONDITIONAL). -/
theorem decorated_energy_bound (D : DecoratedData) (hx : 0 ≤ D.KD.x) (hDI : DIConclusion D.KD)
    (hRep : RepresentationMomentProvider D) (Ψ : D.I → ℂ) (hΨ : ∀ i, ‖Ψ i‖ ≤ 1) :
    D.KD.mass * energy D.K Ψ ≤
      D.KD.x ^ D.eps * D.KD.Nq ^ 2 * D.KD.T * D.Delta1 +
        D.KD.x ^ D.KD.epsDI * (D.KD.Nq ^ 2 * D.KD.T * Real.sqrt (D.KD.Delta2 + D.KD.Delta3)) := by
  classical
  obtain ⟨hXi, hbil, hcal⟩ := hDI
  set c_off : D.KD.Z → ℂ := fun z => if z ∈ D.KD.offDiag then bPsi D.grp Ψ z else 0
  set c_dg : D.KD.Z → ℂ := fun z => if z ∈ D.KD.offDiag then 0 else bPsi D.grp Ψ z
  have hsplit : ∑ b, ∑ z, bPsi D.grp Ψ z * D.KD.Kl b z =
      bilinear D.KD c_off + ∑ b, ∑ z, c_dg z * D.KD.Kl b z := by
    unfold bilinear
    rw [← Finset.sum_add_distrib]
    refine Finset.sum_congr rfl fun b _ => ?_
    rw [← Finset.sum_add_distrib]
    refine Finset.sum_congr rfl fun z _ => ?_
    simp only [c_off, c_dg]; split_ifs <;> ring
  have hE : energy D.K Ψ ≤ ‖∑ b, ∑ z, bPsi D.grp Ψ z * D.KD.Kl b z‖ := by
    have := grouped_expansion D.K D.grp D.KD.Kl D.hgrp Ψ
    rw [← this, Complex.norm_real]
    exact le_abs_self _
  -- off-diagonal: DI
  have hl2 : l2 c_off ≤ Real.sqrt D.KD.Rep := by
    unfold l2
    refine Real.sqrt_le_sqrt ?_
    calc ∑ z, ‖c_off z‖ ^ 2 = ∑ z ∈ D.KD.offDiag, ‖bPsi D.grp Ψ z‖ ^ 2 := by
          rw [← Finset.sum_filter_add_sum_filter_not univ (fun z => z ∈ D.KD.offDiag)]
          rw [Finset.sum_eq_zero (s := univ.filter fun z => z ∉ D.KD.offDiag)
            (fun z hz => by simp [c_off, (Finset.mem_filter.1 hz).2]), add_zero]
          rw [Finset.filter_mem_eq_inter, Finset.univ_inter]
          exact Finset.sum_congr rfl fun z hz => by simp [c_off, hz]
      _ ≤ ∑ z ∈ D.KD.offDiag, repCount D.grp z ^ 2 := bPsi_L2_le D.grp Ψ hΨ _
      _ ≤ D.KD.Rep := hRep.rep
  have hoff : ‖bilinear D.KD c_off‖ ≤ D.KD.x ^ D.KD.epsDI * D.KD.Xi * Real.sqrt D.KD.Rep := by
    refine (hbil c_off fun z hz => by simp [c_off, hz]).trans ?_
    exact mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left hl2 (mul_nonneg (Real.rpow_nonneg hx _) hXi)
  -- diagonal
  have hdiag : ‖∑ b, ∑ z, c_dg z * D.KD.Kl b z‖ ≤
      ∑ z ∈ univ.filter (fun z => z ∉ D.KD.offDiag), repCount D.grp z * ∑ b, ‖D.KD.Kl b z‖ := by
    calc ‖∑ b, ∑ z, c_dg z * D.KD.Kl b z‖ ≤ ∑ b, ∑ z, ‖c_dg z‖ * ‖D.KD.Kl b z‖ :=
          (norm_sum_le _ _).trans (Finset.sum_le_sum fun b _ =>
            (norm_sum_le _ _).trans (le_of_eq (Finset.sum_congr rfl fun z _ => norm_mul _ _)))
      _ = ∑ z, ‖c_dg z‖ * ∑ b, ‖D.KD.Kl b z‖ := by
          rw [Finset.sum_comm]; exact Finset.sum_congr rfl fun z _ => by rw [Finset.mul_sum]
      _ = ∑ z ∈ univ.filter (fun z => z ∉ D.KD.offDiag), ‖bPsi D.grp Ψ z‖ * ∑ b, ‖D.KD.Kl b z‖ := by
          rw [Finset.sum_filter]
          exact Finset.sum_congr rfl fun z _ => by simp only [c_dg]; split_ifs <;> simp
      _ ≤ _ := Finset.sum_le_sum fun z _ =>
          mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right (bPsi_norm_le D.grp Ψ hΨ z)
            (Finset.sum_nonneg fun _ _ => norm_nonneg _)
  have hm := mass_nonneg D
  calc D.KD.mass * energy D.K Ψ
      ≤ D.KD.mass * (∑ z ∈ univ.filter (fun z => z ∉ D.KD.offDiag),
          repCount D.grp z * ∑ b, ‖D.KD.Kl b z‖ +
          D.KD.x ^ D.KD.epsDI * D.KD.Xi * Real.sqrt D.KD.Rep) := by
        refine mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left (hE.trans ?_) hm
        rw [hsplit]
        exact (norm_add_le _ _).trans (by linarith)
    _ = D.KD.mass * ∑ z ∈ univ.filter (fun z => z ∉ D.KD.offDiag),
          repCount D.grp z * ∑ b, ‖D.KD.Kl b z‖ +
        D.KD.x ^ D.KD.epsDI * (D.KD.mass * D.KD.Xi * Real.sqrt D.KD.Rep) := by ring
    _ ≤ _ := add_le_add hRep.diag (mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left hcal (Real.rpow_nonneg hx _))

/-- **Master decorated bound** (LEAN CONDITIONAL). -/
theorem decorated_master_bound (D : DecoratedData) (hx : 0 ≤ D.KD.x) (hDI : DIConclusion D.KD)
    (hRep : RepresentationMomentProvider D) (Ψ : D.I → ℂ) (hΨ : ∀ i, ‖Ψ i‖ ≤ 1)
    (hNq : 0 ≤ D.KD.Nq) (hT : 0 ≤ D.KD.T) (hΔ1 : 0 ≤ D.Delta1) :
    ‖decoratedSum D.A D.K Ψ‖ ≤ D.KD.Nq * Real.sqrt D.KD.T *
      (D.KD.x ^ (D.eps / 2) * Real.sqrt D.Delta1 +
        D.KD.x ^ (D.KD.epsDI / 2) * Real.sqrt (Real.sqrt (D.KD.Delta2 + D.KD.Delta3))) := by
  have hW := decorated_cauchy D.A D.w D.hA D.K Ψ
  rw [D.hmass] at hW
  have hE := decorated_energy_bound D hx hDI hRep Ψ hΨ
  have hsq : ‖decoratedSum D.A D.K Ψ‖ ≤ Real.sqrt
      (D.KD.x ^ D.eps * D.KD.Nq ^ 2 * D.KD.T * D.Delta1 +
        D.KD.x ^ D.KD.epsDI * (D.KD.Nq ^ 2 * D.KD.T * Real.sqrt (D.KD.Delta2 + D.KD.Delta3))) :=
    Real.le_sqrt_of_sq_le (hW.trans hE)
  have hp1 : 0 ≤ D.KD.x ^ D.eps * D.KD.Nq ^ 2 * D.KD.T * D.Delta1 :=
    mul_nonneg (mul_nonneg (mul_nonneg (Real.rpow_nonneg hx _) (sq_nonneg _)) hT) hΔ1
  have hp2 : 0 ≤ D.KD.x ^ D.KD.epsDI * (D.KD.Nq ^ 2 * D.KD.T * Real.sqrt (D.KD.Delta2 + D.KD.Delta3)) :=
    mul_nonneg (Real.rpow_nonneg hx _) (mul_nonneg (mul_nonneg (sq_nonneg _) hT) (Real.sqrt_nonneg _))
  refine hsq.trans ((sqrt_add_le_sqrt_add hp1 hp2).trans (le_of_eq ?_))
  have e1 : Real.sqrt (D.KD.x ^ D.eps * D.KD.Nq ^ 2 * D.KD.T * D.Delta1) =
      D.KD.Nq * Real.sqrt D.KD.T * (D.KD.x ^ (D.eps / 2) * Real.sqrt D.Delta1) := by
    rw [show D.KD.x ^ D.eps * D.KD.Nq ^ 2 * D.KD.T * D.Delta1 =
      D.KD.Nq ^ 2 * (D.KD.T * (D.KD.x ^ D.eps * D.Delta1)) by ring,
      Real.sqrt_mul (sq_nonneg _), Real.sqrt_sq hNq, Real.sqrt_mul hT,
      Real.sqrt_mul (Real.rpow_nonneg hx _), sqrt_rpow_half hx]
    ring
  have e2 : Real.sqrt (D.KD.x ^ D.KD.epsDI *
      (D.KD.Nq ^ 2 * D.KD.T * Real.sqrt (D.KD.Delta2 + D.KD.Delta3))) =
      D.KD.Nq * Real.sqrt D.KD.T *
        (D.KD.x ^ (D.KD.epsDI / 2) * Real.sqrt (Real.sqrt (D.KD.Delta2 + D.KD.Delta3))) := by
    rw [show D.KD.x ^ D.KD.epsDI * (D.KD.Nq ^ 2 * D.KD.T * Real.sqrt (D.KD.Delta2 + D.KD.Delta3))
      = D.KD.Nq ^ 2 * (D.KD.T * (D.KD.x ^ D.KD.epsDI *
        Real.sqrt (D.KD.Delta2 + D.KD.Delta3))) by ring,
      Real.sqrt_mul (sq_nonneg _), Real.sqrt_sq hNq, Real.sqrt_mul hT,
      Real.sqrt_mul (Real.rpow_nonneg hx _), sqrt_rpow_half hx]
    ring
  rw [e1, e2]; ring

section Exponent

variable {x η ε T Δ1 Δ2 Δ3 : ℝ}

theorem rpow_mono_exp (hx : 1 ≤ x) {a b : ℝ} (h : a ≤ b) : x ^ a ≤ x ^ b :=
  Real.rpow_le_rpow_of_exponent_le hx h

/-- **First part** `√T · x^{ε/2} √Δ₁ ≤ x^{ε − 27η/8}` (LEAN BANK). -/
theorem first_part_saving (hx : 1 ≤ x) (hT : T ≤ x ^ (η / 4 + ε))
    (hd1 : Δ1 ≤ x ^ (-7 * η)) :
    Real.sqrt T * (x ^ (ε / 2) * Real.sqrt Δ1) ≤ x ^ (ε - 27 * η / 8) := by
  have hx0 : 0 < x := by linarith
  have h1 : Real.sqrt T ≤ x ^ ((η / 4 + ε) / 2) := by
    rw [Real.sqrt_le_left (Real.rpow_nonneg hx0.le _), ← Real.rpow_natCast, ← Real.rpow_mul hx0.le]
    convert hT using 2; push_cast; ring
  have h2 : Real.sqrt Δ1 ≤ x ^ (-7 * η / 2) := by
    rw [Real.sqrt_le_left (Real.rpow_nonneg hx0.le _), ← Real.rpow_natCast, ← Real.rpow_mul hx0.le]
    convert hd1 using 2; push_cast; ring
  calc Real.sqrt T * (x ^ (ε / 2) * Real.sqrt Δ1)
      ≤ x ^ ((η / 4 + ε) / 2) * (x ^ (ε / 2) * x ^ (-7 * η / 2)) :=
        mul_le_mul h1 (mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left h2 (Real.rpow_nonneg hx0.le _))
          (mul_nonneg (Real.rpow_nonneg hx0.le _) (Real.sqrt_nonneg _)) (Real.rpow_nonneg hx0.le _)
    _ = x ^ (ε - 27 * η / 8) := by
        rw [← Real.rpow_add hx0, ← Real.rpow_add hx0]; congr 1; ring

/-- **Second part** `√T · x^{η/8} (Δ₂+Δ₃)^{1/4} ≤ 2^{1/4} x^{ε/2 − 13η/4}` (LEAN BANK). -/
theorem second_part_saving (hx : 1 ≤ x) (hT : T ≤ x ^ (η / 4 + ε))
    (hd2 : Δ2 ≤ x ^ (-14 * η)) (hd3 : Δ3 ≤ x ^ (-14 * η)) :
    Real.sqrt T * (x ^ (η / 4 / 2) * Real.sqrt (Real.sqrt (Δ2 + Δ3))) ≤
      Real.sqrt (Real.sqrt 2) * x ^ (ε / 2 - 13 * η / 4) := by
  have hx0 : 0 < x := by linarith
  have h1 : Real.sqrt T ≤ x ^ ((η / 4 + ε) / 2) := by
    rw [Real.sqrt_le_left (Real.rpow_nonneg hx0.le _), ← Real.rpow_natCast, ← Real.rpow_mul hx0.le]
    convert hT using 2; push_cast; ring
  have hsum : Δ2 + Δ3 ≤ 2 * x ^ (-14 * η) := by linarith
  have h2 : Real.sqrt (Real.sqrt (Δ2 + Δ3)) ≤ Real.sqrt (Real.sqrt 2) * x ^ (-7 * η / 2) := by
    have : Real.sqrt (Real.sqrt (2 * x ^ (-14 * η))) = Real.sqrt (Real.sqrt 2) * x ^ (-7 * η / 2) := by
      rw [Real.sqrt_mul (by norm_num), Real.sqrt_mul (Real.sqrt_nonneg _),
        Real.sqrt_eq_rpow (x ^ (-14 * η)), ← Real.rpow_mul hx0.le, Real.sqrt_eq_rpow (x ^ _),
        ← Real.rpow_mul hx0.le]
      congr 2; ring
    rw [← this]
    exact Real.sqrt_le_sqrt (Real.sqrt_le_sqrt hsum)
  calc Real.sqrt T * (x ^ (η / 4 / 2) * Real.sqrt (Real.sqrt (Δ2 + Δ3)))
      ≤ x ^ ((η / 4 + ε) / 2) * (x ^ (η / 4 / 2) * (Real.sqrt (Real.sqrt 2) * x ^ (-7 * η / 2))) :=
        mul_le_mul h1 (mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left h2 (Real.rpow_nonneg hx0.le _))
          (mul_nonneg (Real.rpow_nonneg hx0.le _) (Real.sqrt_nonneg _)) (Real.rpow_nonneg hx0.le _)
    _ = Real.sqrt (Real.sqrt 2) * (x ^ ((η / 4 + ε) / 2) * x ^ (η / 4 / 2) * x ^ (-7 * η / 2)) := by
        ring
    _ = Real.sqrt (Real.sqrt 2) * x ^ (ε / 2 - 13 * η / 4) := by
        rw [← Real.rpow_add hx0, ← Real.rpow_add hx0]; congr 2; ring

/-- **Energy-level instantiation** (LEAN BANK):
`T (x^ε Δ₁ + x^{η/4} (Δ₂+Δ₃)^{1/2}) ≤ 3 x^{−2η}` for `ε ≤ η`. -/
theorem energy_instantiation (hx : 1 ≤ x) (hη : 0 < η) (hε : ε ≤ η)
    (hT : T ≤ x ^ (η / 4 + ε)) (hΔ1 : 0 ≤ Δ1) (hd1 : Δ1 ≤ x ^ (-7 * η))
    (hd2 : Δ2 ≤ x ^ (-14 * η)) (hd3 : Δ3 ≤ x ^ (-14 * η)) :
    T * (x ^ ε * Δ1 + x ^ (η / 4) * Real.sqrt (Δ2 + Δ3)) ≤ 3 * x ^ (-2 * η) := by
  have hx0 : 0 < x := by linarith
  have hp : ∀ a : ℝ, 0 ≤ x ^ a := fun a => Real.rpow_nonneg hx0.le a
  have hA : T * (x ^ ε * Δ1) ≤ x ^ (-2 * η) := by
    calc T * (x ^ ε * Δ1) ≤ x ^ (η / 4 + ε) * (x ^ ε * x ^ (-7 * η)) :=
          mul_le_mul hT (mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left hd1 (hp _)) (mul_nonneg (hp _) hΔ1) (hp _)
      _ = x ^ (η / 4 + ε + (ε + -7 * η)) := by rw [← Real.rpow_add hx0, ← Real.rpow_add hx0]
      _ ≤ x ^ (-2 * η) := rpow_mono_exp hx (by linarith)
  have hs : Real.sqrt (Δ2 + Δ3) ≤ Real.sqrt 2 * x ^ (-7 * η) := by
    have : Real.sqrt (2 * x ^ (-14 * η)) = Real.sqrt 2 * x ^ (-7 * η) := by
      rw [Real.sqrt_mul (by norm_num), Real.sqrt_eq_rpow (x ^ _), ← Real.rpow_mul hx0.le]
      congr 2; ring
    rw [← this]; exact Real.sqrt_le_sqrt (by linarith)
  have hB : T * (x ^ (η / 4) * Real.sqrt (Δ2 + Δ3)) ≤ Real.sqrt 2 * x ^ (-2 * η) := by
    calc T * (x ^ (η / 4) * Real.sqrt (Δ2 + Δ3))
        ≤ x ^ (η / 4 + ε) * (x ^ (η / 4) * (Real.sqrt 2 * x ^ (-7 * η))) :=
          mul_le_mul hT (mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left hs (hp _))
            (mul_nonneg (hp _) (Real.sqrt_nonneg _)) (hp _)
      _ = Real.sqrt 2 * (x ^ (η / 4 + ε) * (x ^ (η / 4) * x ^ (-7 * η))) := by ring
      _ = Real.sqrt 2 * x ^ (η / 4 + ε + (η / 4 + -7 * η)) := by
          rw [← Real.rpow_add hx0, ← Real.rpow_add hx0]
      _ ≤ Real.sqrt 2 * x ^ (-2 * η) :=
          mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left (rpow_mono_exp hx (by linarith)) (Real.sqrt_nonneg _)
  have h2 : Real.sqrt 2 ≤ 2 := by
    rw [Real.sqrt_le_left (by norm_num)]; norm_num
  have := hp (-2 * η)
  nlinarith

end Exponent

/-- **Conservative decorated theorem** (LEAN CONDITIONAL on `DIConclusion` and
`RepresentationMomentProvider`): under the exponent ledger `T ≤ x^{η/4+ε}`, `ε_DI = η/4`,
`Δ₁ ≤ x^{−7η}`, `Δ₂, Δ₃ ≤ x^{−14η}`, `ε ≤ η`:
`mass · V(Ψ) ≤ 3 N_q² x^{−2η}` for every one-bounded inner `Ψ`. -/
theorem decorated_conservative (D : DecoratedData) {η : ℝ} (hx : 1 ≤ D.KD.x) (hη : 0 < η)
    (hDI : DIConclusion D.KD) (hRep : RepresentationMomentProvider D)
    (hε : D.eps ≤ η) (hepsDI : D.KD.epsDI = η / 4)
    (hT : D.KD.T ≤ D.KD.x ^ (η / 4 + D.eps)) (hΔ1 : 0 ≤ D.Delta1)
    (hd1 : D.Delta1 ≤ D.KD.x ^ (-7 * η))
    (hd2 : D.KD.Delta2 ≤ D.KD.x ^ (-14 * η))
    (hd3 : D.KD.Delta3 ≤ D.KD.x ^ (-14 * η)) (Ψ : D.I → ℂ) (hΨ : ∀ i, ‖Ψ i‖ ≤ 1) :
    D.KD.mass * energy D.K Ψ ≤ 3 * D.KD.Nq ^ 2 * D.KD.x ^ (-2 * η) := by
  have h := decorated_energy_bound D (by linarith) hDI hRep Ψ hΨ
  have hi := energy_instantiation hx hη hε hT hΔ1 hd1 hd2 hd3
  rw [hepsDI] at h
  have : D.KD.x ^ D.eps * D.KD.Nq ^ 2 * D.KD.T * D.Delta1 +
      D.KD.x ^ (η / 4) * (D.KD.Nq ^ 2 * D.KD.T * Real.sqrt (D.KD.Delta2 + D.KD.Delta3)) =
      D.KD.Nq ^ 2 * (D.KD.T * (D.KD.x ^ D.eps * D.Delta1 +
        D.KD.x ^ (η / 4) * Real.sqrt (D.KD.Delta2 + D.KD.Delta3))) := by ring
  rw [this] at h
  calc D.KD.mass * energy D.K Ψ ≤ _ := h
    _ ≤ D.KD.Nq ^ 2 * (3 * D.KD.x ^ (-2 * η)) := mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left hi (sq_nonneg _)
    _ = _ := by ring

/-- **Conservative decorated linear bound** (LEAN CONDITIONAL):
`|W(A,Ψ)| ≤ √3 · N_q · x^{−η}`, i.e. `N²/Q · x^{−η+o(1)}` in the normalisation `N_q = N²/Q`. -/
theorem decorated_conservative_linear (D : DecoratedData) {η : ℝ} (hx : 1 ≤ D.KD.x) (hη : 0 < η)
    (hDI : DIConclusion D.KD) (hRep : RepresentationMomentProvider D)
    (hε : D.eps ≤ η) (hepsDI : D.KD.epsDI = η / 4)
    (hT : D.KD.T ≤ D.KD.x ^ (η / 4 + D.eps)) (hΔ1 : 0 ≤ D.Delta1)
    (hd1 : D.Delta1 ≤ D.KD.x ^ (-7 * η))
    (hd2 : D.KD.Delta2 ≤ D.KD.x ^ (-14 * η))
    (hd3 : D.KD.Delta3 ≤ D.KD.x ^ (-14 * η)) (hNq : 0 ≤ D.KD.Nq)
    (Ψ : D.I → ℂ) (hΨ : ∀ i, ‖Ψ i‖ ≤ 1) :
    ‖decoratedSum D.A D.K Ψ‖ ≤ Real.sqrt 3 * D.KD.Nq * D.KD.x ^ (-η) := by
  have hW := decorated_cauchy D.A D.w D.hA D.K Ψ
  rw [D.hmass] at hW
  have hc := decorated_conservative D hx hη hDI hRep hε hepsDI hT hΔ1 hd1 hd2 hd3 Ψ hΨ
  have hx0 : 0 < D.KD.x := by linarith
  have hpos : 0 ≤ Real.sqrt 3 * D.KD.Nq * D.KD.x ^ (-η) :=
    mul_nonneg (mul_nonneg (Real.sqrt_nonneg _) hNq) (Real.rpow_nonneg hx0.le _)
  refine (pow_le_pow_iff_left₀ (norm_nonneg _) hpos (by norm_num : (2 : ℕ) ≠ 0)).1 ?_
  calc ‖decoratedSum D.A D.K Ψ‖ ^ 2 ≤ 3 * D.KD.Nq ^ 2 * D.KD.x ^ (-2 * η) := hW.trans hc
    _ = (Real.sqrt 3 * D.KD.Nq * D.KD.x ^ (-η)) ^ 2 := by
      rw [mul_pow, mul_pow, Real.sq_sqrt (by norm_num), ← Real.rpow_mul_natCast hx0.le]
      push_cast; ring_nf

end DecoratedLemma
end ResearchBankV27
end Erdos287

import Mathlib

/-!
# Erdős #287 — Research Bank V27 §5.1–5.2: the decorated Maynard setup

INTERNAL #287 RESEARCH PROGRAMME ONLY.  **Erdős #287 is `OPEN` here and is not claimed.**

## §5.1  Exact clean domain

`q = D q₀ ~ Q`, `B = q d`, `U ~ Q d`, `r_i = u_i v_i` with `u_i ~ R`, `v_i ~ S`, and the EXACT
assignment `R = R₃`, `S = R₂`.  The clean conditions are the fields of `CleanDomain`.

## §5.2  Range quantities

    Δ₁ = N² R² S / x,   Δ₂ = N² R³ S⁴ Q / x²,   Δ₃ = N R² S⁵ Q / x².

Required: `Δ₁ ≤ x^{−7η}`, `Δ₂ ≤ x^{−14η}`, `Δ₃ ≤ x^{−14η}` (`RangeConditions`).

**LEAN BANK.**
* `clean_substitution` — `n₁ ≡ n₂ (mod qd)` gives the exact substitution `n₁ − n₂ = f d q`;
* `delta1_rpow`, `delta2_rpow`, `delta3_rpow` — with `N = x^n`, `R = x^r`, `S = x^s`, `Q = x^κ`:
  `Δ₁ = x^{2n+2r+s−1}`, `Δ₂ = x^{2n+3r+4s+κ−2}`, `Δ₃ = x^{n+2r+5s+κ−2}`;
* `rangeConditions_iff_exponents` — for `x > 1` the three range conditions are EQUIVALENT to the
  three linear exponent inequalities (the arithmetic implication of the exponent ledger).

The analytic interpretation of the ranges remains conditional (it enters only through the
providers of `DISpectralProvider.lean`).
-/

namespace Erdos287
namespace ResearchBankV27
namespace DecoratedMaynardSetup

/-- The exact size assignment `R = R₃`, `S = R₂`. -/
structure SizeAssignment where
  R2 : ℝ
  R3 : ℝ
  R : ℝ
  S : ℝ
  hR : R = R3
  hS : S = R2

/-- The canonical assignment built from `(R₂, R₃)`. -/
def SizeAssignment.ofR (R2 R3 : ℝ) : SizeAssignment := ⟨R2, R3, R3, R2, rfl, rfl⟩

/-- **The clean domain** (all conditions recorded exactly). -/
structure CleanDomain (N C0 logx : ℝ) where
  D : ℕ
  q0 : ℕ
  d : ℕ
  u1 : ℕ
  u2 : ℕ
  v1 : ℕ
  v2 : ℕ
  n1 : ℤ
  n2 : ℤ
  r1 : ℕ := u1 * v1
  r2 : ℕ := u2 * v2
  hr1 : r1 = u1 * v1
  hr2 : r2 = u2 * v2
  cop_r : Nat.Coprime r1 r2
  cop_qd_r2 : Nat.Coprime (D * q0 * d) r2
  cop_n : IsCoprime n1 n2
  cop_n1 : IsCoprime n1 ((D * q0 * d * r1 : ℕ) : ℤ)
  cop_n2 : IsCoprime n2 ((D * q0 * d * r2 : ℕ) : ℤ)
  cong : n1 ≡ n2 [ZMOD ((D * q0 * d : ℕ) : ℤ)]
  sep : N / logx ^ C0 ≤ |((n1 - n2 : ℤ) : ℝ)|
  cop_D : Nat.Coprime D (q0 * d * r1 * r2)

/-- The modulus `q = D q₀`. -/
def CleanDomain.q {N C0 logx : ℝ} (c : CleanDomain N C0 logx) : ℕ := c.D * c.q0

/-- **Exact substitution** `n₁ − n₂ = f d q` (LEAN BANK). -/
theorem clean_substitution {N C0 logx : ℝ} (c : CleanDomain N C0 logx) :
    ∃ f : ℤ, c.n1 - c.n2 = f * c.d * c.q := by
  obtain ⟨f, hf⟩ := (Int.ModEq.dvd c.cong.symm)
  refine ⟨f, ?_⟩
  unfold CleanDomain.q
  push_cast at hf ⊢
  linarith [hf]

/-- `Δ₁ = N² R² S / x`. -/
noncomputable def Delta1 (N R S x : ℝ) : ℝ := N ^ 2 * R ^ 2 * S / x

/-- `Δ₂ = N² R³ S⁴ Q / x²`. -/
noncomputable def Delta2 (N R S Q x : ℝ) : ℝ := N ^ 2 * R ^ 3 * S ^ 4 * Q / x ^ 2

/-- `Δ₃ = N R² S⁵ Q / x²`. -/
noncomputable def Delta3 (N R S Q x : ℝ) : ℝ := N * R ^ 2 * S ^ 5 * Q / x ^ 2

/-- The required range conditions. -/
def RangeConditions (N R S Q x η : ℝ) : Prop :=
  Delta1 N R S x ≤ x ^ (-7 * η) ∧ Delta2 N R S Q x ≤ x ^ (-14 * η) ∧
    Delta3 N R S Q x ≤ x ^ (-14 * η)

section Exponents

variable {x : ℝ} (hx : 0 < x) (n r s κ : ℝ)
include hx

theorem rpow_pow_nat (a : ℝ) (k : ℕ) : (x ^ a) ^ k = x ^ (a * k) := by
  rw [← Real.rpow_natCast, ← Real.rpow_mul hx.le]

theorem delta1_rpow : Delta1 (x ^ n) (x ^ r) (x ^ s) x = x ^ (2 * n + 2 * r + s - 1) := by
  unfold Delta1
  rw [rpow_pow_nat hx, rpow_pow_nat hx, ← Real.rpow_add hx, ← Real.rpow_add hx,
    div_eq_mul_inv, ← Real.rpow_neg_one, ← Real.rpow_add hx]
  congr 1; push_cast; ring

theorem delta2_rpow :
    Delta2 (x ^ n) (x ^ r) (x ^ s) (x ^ κ) x = x ^ (2 * n + 3 * r + 4 * s + κ - 2) := by
  unfold Delta2
  rw [rpow_pow_nat hx, rpow_pow_nat hx, rpow_pow_nat hx, ← Real.rpow_add hx,
    ← Real.rpow_add hx, ← Real.rpow_add hx, div_eq_mul_inv, ← Real.rpow_natCast x 2,
    ← Real.rpow_neg hx.le, ← Real.rpow_add hx]
  congr 1; push_cast; ring

theorem delta3_rpow :
    Delta3 (x ^ n) (x ^ r) (x ^ s) (x ^ κ) x = x ^ (n + 2 * r + 5 * s + κ - 2) := by
  unfold Delta3
  rw [rpow_pow_nat hx, rpow_pow_nat hx, ← Real.rpow_add hx, ← Real.rpow_add hx,
    ← Real.rpow_add hx, div_eq_mul_inv, ← Real.rpow_natCast x 2, ← Real.rpow_neg hx.le,
    ← Real.rpow_add hx]
  congr 1; push_cast; ring

end Exponents

/-- **Range conditions ⟺ exponent inequalities** (LEAN BANK), for `x > 1`. -/
theorem rangeConditions_iff_exponents {x : ℝ} (hx : 1 < x) (n r s κ η : ℝ) :
    RangeConditions (x ^ n) (x ^ r) (x ^ s) (x ^ κ) x η ↔
      (2 * n + 2 * r + s - 1 ≤ -7 * η ∧ 2 * n + 3 * r + 4 * s + κ - 2 ≤ -14 * η ∧
        n + 2 * r + 5 * s + κ - 2 ≤ -14 * η) := by
  have hx0 : 0 < x := by linarith
  unfold RangeConditions
  rw [delta1_rpow hx0, delta2_rpow hx0, delta3_rpow hx0, Real.rpow_le_rpow_left_iff hx,
    Real.rpow_le_rpow_left_iff hx, Real.rpow_le_rpow_left_iff hx]

end DecoratedMaynardSetup
end ResearchBankV27
end Erdos287

@@END_FILE@@

import RequestProject.Erdos287.ResearchBankV27.CommonCauchy

/-!
# Erdős #287 — Research Bank V27 §6.1–6.2: finite-label energy grouping

INTERNAL #287 RESEARCH PROGRAMME ONLY.  **Erdős #287 is `OPEN` here and is not claimed.**

Inner coefficients may carry a label `κ(o) ∈ J` depending on the OUTER variable only:
`X_κ(o) = Σ_i Ψ_{κ(o)}(i) K(o; i)`.  Each `Ψ_j` is an arbitrary inner coefficient (it is a
function of the inner variable only, hence cannot see the final Kloosterman variables).

**LEAN BANK.**
* `label_energy_le` — `Σ_o |X_{κ(o)}(o)|² ≤ Σ_j Σ_o |X_j(o)|²` (positivity / range enlargement;
  NO orthogonality is assumed — the `Ψ_j` are completely arbitrary);
* `labelled_cauchy` — `|W_κ|² ≤ mass · Σ_j V(Ψ_j)`;
* `labelled_sqrt_cost` — if every single label satisfies `mass · V(Ψ_j) ≤ B²`, then
  `|W_κ| ≤ √L · B`: the labels cost `√L` on the linear sum (`L` at energy level only).

**FINITE REGRESSION.**
* `label_energy_not_le_max` — the labelled energy can exceed `max_j V(Ψ_j)`: the factor `L` at
  energy level is genuinely needed (so the linear cost is `√L`, not `1`).
-/

namespace Erdos287
namespace ResearchBankV27
namespace FiniteLabelEnergy

open Finset CommonCauchy

variable {O I J : Type*} [Fintype O] [Fintype I] [Fintype J]

/-- The labelled inner sum `X_{κ(o)}(o)`. -/
noncomputable def labelInner (K : O → I → ℂ) (Ψ : J → I → ℂ) (κ : O → J) (o : O) : ℂ :=
  innerSum K (Ψ (κ o)) o

/-- The labelled energy `Σ_o |X_{κ(o)}(o)|²`. -/
noncomputable def labelEnergy (K : O → I → ℂ) (Ψ : J → I → ℂ) (κ : O → J) : ℝ :=
  ∑ o, ‖labelInner K Ψ κ o‖ ^ 2

/-- The labelled decorated sum `W_κ = Σ_o A(o) X_{κ(o)}(o)`. -/
noncomputable def labelSum (A : O → ℂ) (K : O → I → ℂ) (Ψ : J → I → ℂ) (κ : O → J) : ℂ :=
  ∑ o, A o * labelInner K Ψ κ o

/-- **Energy label grouping** (LEAN BANK; positivity only, no orthogonality). -/
theorem label_energy_le (K : O → I → ℂ) (Ψ : J → I → ℂ) (κ : O → J) :
    labelEnergy K Ψ κ ≤ ∑ j, energy K (Ψ j) := by
  unfold labelEnergy energy
  rw [Finset.sum_comm]
  refine Finset.sum_le_sum fun o _ => ?_
  exact Finset.single_le_sum (f := fun j => ‖innerSum K (Ψ j) o‖ ^ 2)
    (fun j _ => sq_nonneg _) (Finset.mem_univ (κ o))

/-- **Labelled Cauchy** (LEAN BANK): `|W_κ|² ≤ mass · Σ_j V(Ψ_j)`. -/
theorem labelled_cauchy (A : O → ℂ) (w : O → ℝ) (hA : ∀ o, ‖A o‖ ^ 2 ≤ w o) (K : O → I → ℂ)
    (Ψ : J → I → ℂ) (κ : O → J) :
    ‖labelSum A K Ψ κ‖ ^ 2 ≤ (∑ o, w o) * ∑ j, energy K (Ψ j) := by
  have h := common_cauchy univ A (labelInner K Ψ κ) w fun o _ => hA o
  have hw : 0 ≤ ∑ o, w o := Finset.sum_nonneg fun o _ => (sq_nonneg _).trans (hA o)
  exact h.trans (mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left (label_energy_le K Ψ κ) hw)

/-- **`√L` label cost** (LEAN BANK): single-label decorated estimates `mass · V(Ψ_j) ≤ B²`
give `|W_κ| ≤ √L · B` with `L = #J`. -/
theorem labelled_sqrt_cost (A : O → ℂ) (w : O → ℝ) (hA : ∀ o, ‖A o‖ ^ 2 ≤ w o)
    (K : O → I → ℂ) (Ψ : J → I → ℂ) (κ : O → J) {B : ℝ} (hB : 0 ≤ B)
    (hsingle : ∀ j, (∑ o, w o) * energy K (Ψ j) ≤ B ^ 2) :
    ‖labelSum A K Ψ κ‖ ≤ Real.sqrt (Fintype.card J) * B := by
  have h := labelled_cauchy A w hA K Ψ κ
  have hsum : (∑ o, w o) * ∑ j, energy K (Ψ j) ≤ (Fintype.card J : ℝ) * B ^ 2 := by
    rw [Finset.mul_sum]
    calc ∑ j, (∑ o, w o) * energy K (Ψ j) ≤ ∑ _j : J, B ^ 2 := Finset.sum_le_sum fun j _ => hsingle j
      _ = _ := by simp
  have hpos : 0 ≤ Real.sqrt (Fintype.card J) * B := mul_nonneg (Real.sqrt_nonneg _) hB
  refine (pow_le_pow_iff_left₀ (norm_nonneg _) hpos (by norm_num : (2 : ℕ) ≠ 0)).1 ?_
  rw [mul_pow, Real.sq_sqrt (Nat.cast_nonneg _)]
  exact h.trans hsum

/-- **Regression** (FINITE REGRESSION): labelled energy may exceed every single-label energy,
so the energy-level factor `L` cannot be dropped. -/
theorem label_energy_not_le_max :
    ∃ (K : Fin 2 → Fin 2 → ℂ) (Ψ : Fin 2 → Fin 2 → ℂ) (κ : Fin 2 → Fin 2),
      (∀ j i, ‖Ψ j i‖ ≤ 1) ∧ (∀ j, energy K (Ψ j) = 1) ∧ labelEnergy K Ψ κ = 2 := by
  refine ⟨fun o i => if o = i then 1 else 0, fun j i => if j = i then 1 else 0, id,
    fun j i => by dsimp only; split_ifs <;> simp, fun j => ?_, ?_⟩
  · fin_cases j <;> simp [energy, innerSum, Fin.sum_univ_two]
  · simp [labelEnergy, labelInner, innerSum]

end FiniteLabelEnergy
end ResearchBankV27
end Erdos287

import Mathlib

/-!
# Erdős #287 — Research Bank V27 §8: exact `1/d` and the global conductor sum

INTERNAL #287 RESEARCH PROGRAMME ONLY.  **Erdős #287 is `OPEN` here and is not claimed.**

**LEAN BANK.**
* `denominator_split` / `exact_one_over_d` — the actual denominator `q d u₁ v₁ u₂ v₂` equals
  `d · (q u₁ v₁ u₂ v₂)`, so the decorated sum carries the exact outside factor `1/d`;
* `fixed_lifted_scale_factor` — at FIXED lifted scale `Q = D Q₀` the common `1/Q` factors out;
* `global_aggregation` — (root-mass contract) + (per-state bound `√D · B`) + (divisor-sum bound)
  give `Σ_D Σ_b |Γ(D,b)| |P(D,b)| ≤ x^{3σ/2+ε} B`;
* `clean_energy_saving` — `η − 3σ/2 = 347/418000 > 0` for `η = 1/1100`, `σ = 1/19000`;
* `clean_discrepancy_saving` — after the final Cauchy: `(η − 3σ/2)/2 = 347/836000 > 0`.

**FINITE REGRESSION.**
* `fixing_Q0_alone_invalid` — with `Q₀` fixed but `D` varying, the lifted scales differ and no
  single denominator `D·Q₀` factors out of the sum.

**EXTERNAL PROVIDER** (never constructed):
* `DivisorSumProvider` — `Σ_{D ≤ x^σ} τ(D)^C √D ≤ x^{3σ/2 + ε}`.
-/

namespace Erdos287
namespace ResearchBankV27
namespace GlobalConductorSum

open Finset

/-- **Denominator split** (LEAN BANK). -/
theorem denominator_split (q d u1 v1 u2 v2 : ℚ) :
    q * d * u1 * v1 * u2 * v2 = d * (q * u1 * v1 * u2 * v2) := by ring

/-- **Exact outside factor `1/d`** (LEAN BANK). -/
theorem exact_one_over_d (X q d u1 v1 u2 v2 : ℚ) :
    X / (q * d * u1 * v1 * u2 * v2) = (1 / d) * (X / (q * u1 * v1 * u2 * v2)) := by
  rw [denominator_split, div_mul_div_comm, one_mul]

/-- **Fixed lifted scale** (LEAN BANK): with `Q = D Q₀` fixed, `1/Q` factors out. -/
theorem fixed_lifted_scale_factor {β : Type*} (s : Finset β) (X : β → ℚ) (D Q0 : ℚ) :
    ∑ b ∈ s, X b / (D * Q0) = (1 / (D * Q0)) * ∑ b ∈ s, X b := by
  rw [Finset.mul_sum]; exact Finset.sum_congr rfl fun b _ => by ring

/-- **Regression** (FINITE REGRESSION): fixing `Q₀ = 1` while `D ∈ {1, 2}` varies, the sum
`Σ_D 1/(D Q₀) = 3/2` is not `2/(D Q₀)` for any single lifted scale `D Q₀`. -/
theorem fixing_Q0_alone_invalid :
    ¬ ∃ D ∈ ({1, 2} : Finset ℚ), ∑ D' ∈ ({1, 2} : Finset ℚ), 1 / (D' * 1) = 2 / (D * 1) := by
  rintro ⟨D, hD, h⟩
  rw [Finset.sum_pair (by norm_num)] at h
  simp only [Finset.mem_insert, Finset.mem_singleton] at hD
  rcases hD with rfl | rfl <;> norm_num at h

/-- **Divisor-sum provider** (EXTERNAL PROVIDER; never constructed). -/
structure DivisorSumProvider (Ds : Finset ℕ) (C : ℕ) (x σ ε : ℝ) : Prop where
  bound : ∑ D ∈ Ds, ((Nat.divisors D).card : ℝ) ^ C * Real.sqrt D ≤ x ^ (3 * σ / 2 + ε)

/-- **Global aggregation** (LEAN CONDITIONAL on `DivisorSumProvider`; the root-mass contract and
the per-state bound are explicit hypotheses). -/
theorem global_aggregation {β : Type*} (Ds : Finset ℕ) (bs : ℕ → Finset β) (Γ P : ℕ → β → ℂ)
    (C : ℕ) {x σ ε B : ℝ} (hB : 0 ≤ B)
    (hroot : ∀ D ∈ Ds, ∑ b ∈ bs D, ‖Γ D b‖ ≤ ((Nat.divisors D).card : ℝ) ^ C)
    (hstate : ∀ D ∈ Ds, ∀ b ∈ bs D, ‖P D b‖ ≤ Real.sqrt D * B)
    (hdiv : DivisorSumProvider Ds C x σ ε) :
    ∑ D ∈ Ds, ∑ b ∈ bs D, ‖Γ D b‖ * ‖P D b‖ ≤ x ^ (3 * σ / 2 + ε) * B := by
  calc ∑ D ∈ Ds, ∑ b ∈ bs D, ‖Γ D b‖ * ‖P D b‖
      ≤ ∑ D ∈ Ds, (∑ b ∈ bs D, ‖Γ D b‖) * (Real.sqrt D * B) := by
        refine Finset.sum_le_sum fun D hD => ?_
        rw [Finset.sum_mul]
        exact Finset.sum_le_sum fun b hb =>
          mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left (hstate D hD b hb) (norm_nonneg _)
    _ ≤ ∑ D ∈ Ds, ((Nat.divisors D).card : ℝ) ^ C * (Real.sqrt D * B) :=
        Finset.sum_le_sum fun D hD =>
          mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right (hroot D hD) (mul_nonneg (Real.sqrt_nonneg _) hB)
    _ = (∑ D ∈ Ds, ((Nat.divisors D).card : ℝ) ^ C * Real.sqrt D) * B := by
        rw [Finset.sum_mul]; exact Finset.sum_congr rfl fun D _ => by ring
    _ ≤ x ^ (3 * σ / 2 + ε) * B := mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right hdiv.bound hB

/-- The fixed exponents. -/
def eta : ℚ := 1 / 1100
def sigma : ℚ := 1 / 19000

/-- **Clean energy saving** (LEAN BANK). -/
theorem clean_energy_saving : eta - 3 * sigma / 2 = 347 / 418000 ∧ (0 : ℚ) < 347 / 418000 := by
  unfold eta sigma; norm_num

/-- **Clean discrepancy saving** (LEAN BANK). -/
theorem clean_discrepancy_saving :
    (eta - 3 * sigma / 2) / 2 = 347 / 836000 ∧ (0 : ℚ) < 347 / 836000 := by
  unfold eta sigma; norm_num

/-- Real-valued form of the global saving (LEAN BANK): with `B = N_q x^{−η}` and `ε` small,
`x^{3σ/2+ε} · x^{−η} = x^{−(347/418000) + ε}`. -/
theorem global_saving_rpow {x ε : ℝ} (hx : 0 < x) :
    x ^ (3 * ((1 : ℝ) / 19000) / 2 + ε) * x ^ (-((1 : ℝ) / 1100)) = x ^ (-(347 / 418000) + ε) := by
  rw [← Real.rpow_add hx]; congr 1; ring

end GlobalConductorSum
end ResearchBankV27
end Erdos287

@@BEGIN_FILE bytes=4750 sha256=32f5c91e461a1107d28763f7d221a7f98798a65ec6b565fbedf2a6123dd94dd9 path=LEAN_PROJECT/RequestProject/Erdos287/ResearchBankV27/GroupedCoefficient.lean@@
import RequestProject.Erdos287.ResearchBankV27.CommonCauchy

/-!
# Erdős #287 — Research Bank V27 §5.6: the grouped coefficient

INTERNAL #287 RESEARCH PROGRAMME ONLY.  **Erdős #287 is `OPEN` here and is not claimed.**

After the common Cauchy step the energy `V(Ψ) = Σ_o |Σ_i Ψ(i) K(o;i)|²` is opened.  The
regrouped outer (Kloosterman) variables are `β = n₂ u₁`, `γ = n₁ u₂ v₂`; the pair of inner
variables `((s,h),(t,k))` enters only through the grouped frequency

    ℓ = h t − k s,   z = s t,   y = a f (h t − k s).

**LEAN BANK.**
* `bPsi` — `b_Ψ(z) = Σ_{grp(i,i') = z} Ψ(i) conj Ψ(i')`: its type has NO outer argument;
* **`grouped_expansion`** — if the outer correlation `Σ_o K(o;i) conj K(o;i')` depends on the
  inner pair only through `grp(i,i')` (i.e. equals `Σ_b Kl(b; grp(i,i'))` over the regrouped
  outer variables `b = (β,γ)`), then EXACTLY
  `V(Ψ) = Σ_b Σ_z b_Ψ(z) Kl(b; z)`;  the grouped coefficient `b_Ψ(z)` is the same for every
  `b = (β, γ)`;
* `grpConcrete`, `bPsiConcrete` — the literal grouping `(s,h),(t,k) ↦ (st, af(ht − ks))` and
  `b_Ψ(z,y) = Σ_{st = z, af(ht−ks) = y} Ψ(s,h) conj Ψ(t,k)`;
* `concrete_grouping_ell` — `y = a f ℓ` with `ℓ = ht − ks`.
-/

namespace Erdos287
namespace ResearchBankV27
namespace GroupedCoefficient

open Finset CommonCauchy

variable {O I Z B : Type*} [Fintype O] [Fintype I] [Fintype B] [DecidableEq Z]

/-- **The grouped coefficient** `b_Ψ(z)` (no outer argument). -/
noncomputable def bPsi (grp : I → I → Z) (Ψ : I → ℂ) (z : Z) : ℂ :=
  ∑ p ∈ (univ : Finset (I × I)).filter (fun p => grp p.1 p.2 = z), Ψ p.1 * starRingEnd ℂ (Ψ p.2)

theorem energy_eq_sum_pairs (K : O → I → ℂ) (Ψ : I → ℂ) :
    ((energy K Ψ : ℝ) : ℂ) = ∑ p : I × I, Ψ p.1 * starRingEnd ℂ (Ψ p.2) *
      ∑ o, K o p.1 * starRingEnd ℂ (K o p.2) := by
  unfold energy innerSum
  push_cast
  have : ∀ o, ((‖∑ i, Ψ i * K o i‖ : ℝ) : ℂ) ^ 2 =
      (∑ i, Ψ i * K o i) * starRingEnd ℂ (∑ i, Ψ i * K o i) := by
    intro o
    rw [Complex.mul_conj, Complex.normSq_eq_norm_sq]; push_cast; ring
  simp_rw [this, map_sum, map_mul, Finset.sum_mul_sum]
  rw [Finset.sum_comm, Fintype.sum_prod_type]
  refine Finset.sum_congr rfl fun i _ => ?_
  rw [Finset.sum_comm]
  refine Finset.sum_congr rfl fun i' _ => ?_
  rw [Finset.mul_sum]
  refine Finset.sum_congr rfl fun o _ => by ring

/-- **Grouped expansion** (LEAN BANK). -/
theorem grouped_expansion (K : O → I → ℂ) (grp : I → I → Z) (Kl : B → Z → ℂ)
    (hgrp : ∀ i i', ∑ o, K o i * starRingEnd ℂ (K o i') = ∑ b, Kl b (grp i i')) (Ψ : I → ℂ)
    [Fintype Z] :
    ((energy K Ψ : ℝ) : ℂ) = ∑ b, ∑ z, bPsi grp Ψ z * Kl b z := by
  rw [energy_eq_sum_pairs]
  simp_rw [hgrp]
  unfold bPsi
  have h1 : ∀ b, ∑ z, (∑ p ∈ (univ : Finset (I × I)).filter (fun p => grp p.1 p.2 = z),
      Ψ p.1 * starRingEnd ℂ (Ψ p.2)) * Kl b z =
      ∑ p : I × I, Ψ p.1 * starRingEnd ℂ (Ψ p.2) * Kl b (grp p.1 p.2) := by
    intro b
    simp_rw [Finset.sum_mul]
    have : ∀ z, ∑ p ∈ (univ : Finset (I × I)).filter (fun p => grp p.1 p.2 = z),
        Ψ p.1 * starRingEnd ℂ (Ψ p.2) * Kl b z =
        ∑ p ∈ (univ : Finset (I × I)).filter (fun p => grp p.1 p.2 = z),
        Ψ p.1 * starRingEnd ℂ (Ψ p.2) * Kl b (grp p.1 p.2) := fun z =>
      Finset.sum_congr rfl fun p hp => by rw [(Finset.mem_filter.1 hp).2]
    simp_rw [this]
    exact Finset.sum_fiberwise univ (fun p : I × I => grp p.1 p.2) _
  simp_rw [h1]
  rw [Finset.sum_comm]
  exact Finset.sum_congr rfl fun p _ => by rw [Finset.mul_sum]

/-- The regrouped outer variable `β = n₂ u₁`. -/
def betaVar (n2 u1 : ℤ) : ℤ := n2 * u1

/-- The regrouped outer variable `γ = n₁ u₂ v₂`. -/
def gammaVar (n1 u2 v2 : ℤ) : ℤ := n1 * u2 * v2

/-- The literal grouping `((s,h),(t,k)) ↦ (z, y) = (s t, a f (h t − k s))`. -/
def grpConcrete (a f : ℤ) (sh tk : ℤ × ℤ) : ℤ × ℤ :=
  (sh.1 * tk.1, a * f * (sh.2 * tk.1 - tk.2 * sh.1))

/-- The grouped frequency `ℓ = h t − k s`. -/
def ellVar (sh tk : ℤ × ℤ) : ℤ := sh.2 * tk.1 - tk.2 * sh.1

theorem concrete_grouping_ell (a f : ℤ) (sh tk : ℤ × ℤ) :
    grpConcrete a f sh tk = (sh.1 * tk.1, a * f * ellVar sh tk) := rfl

/-- The literal grouped coefficient on a finite box `Ibox` of inner variables `(s,h)`:
`b_Ψ(z,y) = Σ_{st = z, af(ht − ks) = y} Ψ(s,h) conj Ψ(t,k)`. -/
noncomputable def bPsiConcrete (Ibox : Finset (ℤ × ℤ)) (a f : ℤ) (Ψ : ℤ × ℤ → ℂ) (zy : ℤ × ℤ) :
    ℂ :=
  bPsi (I := Ibox) (fun i i' => grpConcrete a f i.1 i'.1) (fun i => Ψ i.1) zy

end GroupedCoefficient
end ResearchBankV27
end Erdos287

import RequestProject.Erdos287.ResearchBankV25.Ledger

# Erdős #287 — Research Bank V27: ledger

Status classes are those of `ResearchBankV25.Ledger.StatusClass`.

namespace Erdos287

inductive V27Item

def status : V27Item → StatusClass

  | decoratedExponentSavings => leanBank

    status crtColourOrbit = leanBank ∧ status diSpectralProvider = externalProvider ∧
    status characterFreeColourCost = leanConditional ∧
    status smoothCutoffRecovery = leanConditional ∧

@@BEGIN_FILE bytes=4390 sha256=2b76ae1d3ee6192f00dfdb92b11a55f8cb395adac62daab421073247ed08d078 path=LEAN_PROJECT/RequestProject/Erdos287/ResearchBankV27/OuterInnerSeparation.lean@@
import Mathlib

/-!
# Erdős #287 — Research Bank V27 §5.3–5.4: outer / inner separation and the product cutoff

INTERNAL #287 RESEARCH PROGRAMME ONLY.  **Erdős #287 is `OPEN` here and is not claimed.**

After `n₁ − n₂ = f d q` the OUTER variables are `o = (f, n₁, n₂, u₁, u₂, v₂)` and the INNER
variables are `(v₁, h)`.  Admissible decorations are `A(o)` (`|A| ≤ 1`) and `Ψ(v₁, h)`
(`|Ψ| ≤ 1`).

**LEAN BANK.**
* `InnerCoeff` — the type of inner decorations: functions of `(v₁, h)` ONLY;
* `decoration_firewall` — a decoration that depends on a final Kloosterman variable is NOT an
  inner decoration: there is `Φ(i, b)` with `Φ(i, b) ≠ Ψ(i)` for every candidate `Ψ`;
* `joint_dependence_allowed` — `Ψ` may depend JOINTLY on `(v₁, h)` (non-product example);
* **`product_cutoff_separation`** — exact discrete separation on a finite `v₁`-box:
  `1_{u₁ v₁ ≤ T₁} = Σ_{j ∈ V} 1_{u₁ j ≤ T₁} · 1_{v₁ = j}`;  the new phase `1_{v₁ = j}` is an
  INNER `v₁`-coefficient, the factor `1_{u₁ j ≤ T₁}` is OUTER;  `L¹` cost `#V`;
* `separated_inner_coeff_bounded` — `Ψ(v₁,h) · 1_{v₁ = j}` is again a one-bounded inner
  decoration.

**EXTERNAL PROVIDER.**
* `ProductCutoffFourierProvider` — the smooth (Fourier/Mellin) separation with `L¹` cost
  `≤ log^C x` (only needed if the `#V` cost of the exact discrete separation is too large).
-/

namespace Erdos287
namespace ResearchBankV27
namespace OuterInnerSeparation

/-- Inner decorations: functions of the inner variables `(v₁, h)` only. -/
abbrev InnerCoeff := ℤ × ℤ → ℂ

/-- One-boundedness of an inner decoration. -/
def OneBoundedInner (Ψ : InnerCoeff) : Prop := ∀ i, ‖Ψ i‖ ≤ 1

/-- **Typing firewall** (LEAN BANK): a decoration depending on a final Kloosterman variable
`b` cannot be written as an inner decoration. -/
theorem decoration_firewall :
    ∃ Φ : (ℤ × ℤ) × Bool → ℂ, ∀ Ψ : InnerCoeff, ∃ i b, Φ (i, b) ≠ Ψ i := by
  refine ⟨fun p => if p.2 then 1 else 0, fun Ψ => ?_⟩
  by_cases h : Ψ (0, 0) = 1
  · exact ⟨(0, 0), false, by simp [h]⟩
  · exact ⟨(0, 0), true, by simp; exact fun h' => h h'.symm⟩

/-- **Joint dependence on `(v₁, h)` is allowed** (LEAN BANK): `Ψ(v₁,h) = 1_{v₁ = h}` is a
one-bounded inner decoration that is not a product `a(v₁) b(h)`. -/
theorem joint_dependence_allowed :
    OneBoundedInner (fun i => if i.1 = i.2 then 1 else 0) ∧
      ¬ ∃ a b : ℤ → ℂ, ∀ v h, (if v = h then (1 : ℂ) else 0) = a v * b h := by
  refine ⟨fun i => by beta_reduce; split_ifs <;> simp, ?_⟩
  rintro ⟨a, b, hab⟩
  have h00 := hab 0 0
  have h11 := hab 1 1
  have h01 := hab 0 1
  have h10 := hab 1 0
  simp at h00 h11 h01 h10
  rcases h01 with h | h
  · rw [h, zero_mul] at h00; exact one_ne_zero h00
  · rw [h, mul_zero] at h11; exact one_ne_zero h11

/-- **Exact discrete separation of the product cutoff** (LEAN BANK). -/
theorem product_cutoff_separation (V : Finset ℤ) (u1 v1 T1 : ℤ) (hv : v1 ∈ V) :
    (if u1 * v1 ≤ T1 then (1 : ℂ) else 0) =
      ∑ j ∈ V, (if u1 * j ≤ T1 then (1 : ℂ) else 0) * (if v1 = j then 1 else 0) := by
  rw [Finset.sum_eq_single v1]
  · simp
  · intro j _ hj; rw [if_neg (Ne.symm hj), mul_zero]
  · intro h; exact absurd hv h

/-- The separated inner coefficient `Ψ_j(v₁,h) = Ψ(v₁,h) 1_{v₁ = j}` (inner only). -/
def separatedInner (Ψ : InnerCoeff) (j : ℤ) : InnerCoeff := fun i => Ψ i * if i.1 = j then 1 else 0

theorem separated_inner_coeff_bounded {Ψ : InnerCoeff} (hΨ : OneBoundedInner Ψ) (j : ℤ) :
    OneBoundedInner (separatedInner Ψ j) := by
  intro i; unfold separatedInner
  split_ifs
  · simpa using hΨ i
  · simp

/-- **Smooth product-cutoff separation** (EXTERNAL PROVIDER; never constructed): the cutoff is a
combination `Σ_t c_t a_t(u₁) b_t(v₁)` of one-bounded outer/inner factors with `Σ |c_t| ≤ L1`. -/
structure ProductCutoffFourierProvider (U V : Finset ℤ) (T1 L1 : ℝ) : Prop where
  sep : ∃ (ι : Type) (_ : Fintype ι) (c : ι → ℂ) (a b : ι → ℤ → ℂ),
    (∀ t u, ‖a t u‖ ≤ 1) ∧ (∀ t v, ‖b t v‖ ≤ 1) ∧ (∑ t, ‖c t‖ ≤ L1) ∧
    ∀ u ∈ U, ∀ v ∈ V, (if ((u * v : ℤ) : ℝ) ≤ T1 then (1 : ℂ) else 0) = ∑ t, c t * a t u * b t v

end OuterInnerSeparation
end ResearchBankV27
end Erdos287

import RequestProject.Erdos287.ResearchBankV27.GroupedCoefficient

/-!
# Erdős #287 — Research Bank V27 §5.7–5.8: diagonal count and representation moment

INTERNAL #287 RESEARCH PROGRAMME ONLY.  **Erdős #287 is `OPEN` here and is not claimed.**

`A_z = #{(i,i') : grp(i,i') = z}` is the representation count with coefficient `1`.

**LEAN BANK.**
* `bPsi_norm_le` — `|b_Ψ(z)| ≤ A_z` for one-bounded `Ψ`;
* `bPsi_L2_le` — `Σ_z |b_Ψ(z)|² ≤ Σ_z A_z²`;
* `same_rep_relation` — two representations with the same `(z, y)` and the same `(s, t)` satisfy
  `(h − h') t = (k − k') s` (when `a f ≠ 0`);
* `antidiagonal_card` — `#{(k,s) : k s = n} = τ(n)`;
* **`diagonal_count_le`** — for a box of positive `(h,t)` and ANY finite boxes of `k`, `s`:
  `#{(h,t,k,s) : h t = k s} ≤ Σ_{(h,t)} τ(h t)`.  This is the precise arithmetic content of the
  diagonal `ht = ks`; the analytic divisor-moment estimate of `Σ τ(ht)` is NOT claimed here (it
  is the `RepresentationMomentProvider`, `DecoratedLemma.lean`).
-/

namespace Erdos287
namespace ResearchBankV27
namespace RepresentationMoment

open Finset GroupedCoefficient

variable {I Z : Type*} [Fintype I] [DecidableEq Z]

/-- The representation count `A_z` (coefficient `1`). -/
noncomputable def repCount (grp : I → I → Z) (z : Z) : ℝ :=
  (((univ : Finset (I × I)).filter (fun p => grp p.1 p.2 = z)).card : ℝ)

theorem repCount_nonneg (grp : I → I → Z) (z : Z) : 0 ≤ repCount grp z := Nat.cast_nonneg _

/-- **`|b_Ψ(z)| ≤ A_z`** (LEAN BANK). -/
theorem bPsi_norm_le (grp : I → I → Z) (Ψ : I → ℂ) (hΨ : ∀ i, ‖Ψ i‖ ≤ 1) (z : Z) :
    ‖bPsi grp Ψ z‖ ≤ repCount grp z := by
  unfold bPsi repCount
  refine (norm_sum_le _ _).trans ?_
  calc ∑ p ∈ (univ : Finset (I × I)).filter (fun p => grp p.1 p.2 = z),
        ‖Ψ p.1 * starRingEnd ℂ (Ψ p.2)‖
      ≤ ∑ p ∈ (univ : Finset (I × I)).filter (fun p => grp p.1 p.2 = z), (1 : ℝ) :=
        Finset.sum_le_sum fun p _ => by
          rw [norm_mul, Complex.norm_conj]
          exact mul_le_one₀ (hΨ _) (norm_nonneg _) (hΨ _)
    _ = _ := by simp

/-- **`Σ_z |b_Ψ(z)|² ≤ Σ_z A_z²`** (LEAN BANK). -/
theorem bPsi_L2_le (grp : I → I → Z) (Ψ : I → ℂ) (hΨ : ∀ i, ‖Ψ i‖ ≤ 1) (T : Finset Z) :
    ∑ z ∈ T, ‖bPsi grp Ψ z‖ ^ 2 ≤ ∑ z ∈ T, repCount grp z ^ 2 :=
  Finset.sum_le_sum fun z _ =>
    pow_le_pow_left₀ (norm_nonneg _) (bPsi_norm_le grp Ψ hΨ z) 2

/-- **Same `(z, y)`, same `(s, t)` ⟹ `(h − h') t = (k − k') s`** (LEAN BANK). -/
theorem same_rep_relation {a f s t h k h' k' : ℤ} (haf : a * f ≠ 0)
    (heq : GroupedCoefficient.grpConcrete a f (s, h) (t, k) =
      GroupedCoefficient.grpConcrete a f (s, h') (t, k')) :
    (h - h') * t = (k - k') * s := by
  unfold GroupedCoefficient.grpConcrete at heq
  simp only [Prod.mk.injEq] at heq
  have := mul_left_cancel₀ haf heq.2
  linarith

theorem antidiagonal_card (n : ℕ) : n.divisorsAntidiagonal.card = n.divisors.card := by
  rw [← Nat.map_div_right_divisors, Finset.card_map]

/-- **Diagonal representation count** (LEAN BANK). -/
theorem diagonal_count_le (D : Finset (ℕ × ℕ)) (hD : ∀ p ∈ D, 0 < p.1 ∧ 0 < p.2)
    (Kb Sb : Finset ℕ) :
    ∑ p ∈ D, ((Kb ×ˢ Sb).filter (fun q => q.1 * q.2 = p.1 * p.2)).card ≤
      ∑ p ∈ D, (p.1 * p.2).divisors.card := by
  refine Finset.sum_le_sum fun p hp => ?_
  have hn : p.1 * p.2 ≠ 0 := Nat.mul_ne_zero (hD p hp).1.ne' (hD p hp).2.ne'
  rw [← antidiagonal_card]
  refine Finset.card_le_card fun q hq => ?_
  rw [Finset.mem_filter] at hq
  exact Nat.mem_divisorsAntidiagonal.2 ⟨hq.2, hn⟩

end RepresentationMoment
end ResearchBankV27
end Erdos287

import Mathlib

/-!
# Erdős #287 — Research Bank V27 §7: smooth frequency recovery

INTERNAL #287 RESEARCH PROGRAMME ONLY.  **Erdős #287 is `OPEN` here and is not claimed.**

**LEAN BANK** (exact algebra, all inverse-existence hypotheses explicit):
* `reciprocity_dvd` — if `a ā ≡ 1 (mod b)`, `b b̄ ≡ 1 (mod a)` and `(a, b) = 1`, then
  `ab ∣ a ā + b b̄ − 1`;
* `reciprocity_frac` — hence `c ā / b + c b̄ / a − c / (ab) ∈ ℤ` for every integer `c`; with
  `c = a₀ f`, `a = n₁ r₂`, `b = n₂ r₁`, this is the reciprocity step
  `m_{a₀}/L ≡ a₀ f \overline{n₂ r₁}/(n₁ r₂) + a₀/(L n₁) (mod 1)` once the (explicit) relation
  between `m_{a₀}`, `L` and the inverses is substituted (`reciprocity_instance`).
* `fixed_J_exists` / `frequency_tail_absorbed` — a FIXED `J` (chosen before `x → ∞`) makes the
  Schwartz tail beyond `H_cap` absorb any fixed polynomial outer count `x^P` and still save `x^{-A}`.
* `colour_partial_summation` — Abel summation in which the colour coefficients stay INSIDE the
  partial sums and only the smooth physical weight is differenced.
* `real_correction_exponent_facts` — the supplied real-correction exponent `−1079/1900` is
  negative, beats `−1/2` and beats `−η` for `η = 1/1100` (rational arithmetic).

**EXTERNAL PROVIDER** (never constructed):
* `SchwartzFrequencyProvider` — `Σ_{0<|h|≤H} |h| |ψ̂(h/t)| ≤ C_ψ t²`;
* `FrequencyCapProvider` — for a fixed `J > 2`, the tail `Σ_{H_cap<|h|≤H} |ψ̂(hM/L)| ≤
  C_{ψ,J} (L/M) x^{−(J−1)η/4}`, with `H_cap = C Q d R² S² / M · x^{η/4}` (no exponential decay
  is claimed for compactly supported smooth weights);
* `SmoothRecoveryProvider` — the variation bound `Σ_n |b_{n+1} − b_n| ≤ V` for the physical
  smooth cutoff.

The derivation of the literal exponent `1079/1900` from the analytic real-correction estimate is
NOT reconstructed here: it is recorded as the supplied value, and only its rational arithmetic is
kernel-checked.
-/

namespace Erdos287
namespace ResearchBankV27
namespace SmoothFrequencyRecovery

open Finset

/-- **Reciprocity divisibility** (LEAN BANK). -/
theorem reciprocity_dvd {a b abar bbar : ℤ} (hab : IsCoprime a b) (ha : b ∣ a * abar - 1)
    (hb : a ∣ b * bbar - 1) : a * b ∣ a * abar + b * bbar - 1 := by
  have h1 : a ∣ a * abar + b * bbar - 1 := by
    have : a * abar + b * bbar - 1 = a * abar + (b * bbar - 1) := by ring
    rw [this]; exact dvd_add (dvd_mul_right _ _) hb
  have h2 : b ∣ a * abar + b * bbar - 1 := by
    have : a * abar + b * bbar - 1 = (a * abar - 1) + b * bbar := by ring
    rw [this]; exact dvd_add ha (dvd_mul_right _ _)
  exact hab.mul_dvd h1 h2

/-- **Fractional reciprocity** (LEAN BANK): `c ā/b + c b̄/a − c/(ab) ∈ ℤ`. -/
theorem reciprocity_frac {a b abar bbar : ℤ} (hab : IsCoprime a b) (ha0 : a ≠ 0) (hb0 : b ≠ 0)
    (ha : b ∣ a * abar - 1) (hb : a ∣ b * bbar - 1) (c : ℤ) :
    ∃ k : ℤ, (c * abar : ℚ) / b + (c * bbar : ℚ) / a - (c : ℚ) / (a * b) = k := by
  obtain ⟨k, hk⟩ := reciprocity_dvd hab ha hb
  refine ⟨c * k, ?_⟩
  have hk' : ((a : ℚ) * abar + b * bbar - 1) = a * b * k := by exact_mod_cast hk
  have ha' : (a : ℚ) ≠ 0 := by exact_mod_cast ha0
  have hb' : (b : ℚ) ≠ 0 := by exact_mod_cast hb0
  field_simp
  push_cast
  linear_combination (c : ℚ) * hk'

/-- **Reciprocity instance** (LEAN BANK): if `m/L = c ā/b + e` for a rational `e` (the explicit
substitution of the inverse `ā = \overline{n₂ r₁}` etc.), then modulo `1`,
`m/L ≡ −c b̄/a + c/(ab) + e`. -/
theorem reciprocity_instance {a b abar bbar : ℤ} (hab : IsCoprime a b) (ha0 : a ≠ 0)
    (hb0 : b ≠ 0) (ha : b ∣ a * abar - 1) (hb : a ∣ b * bbar - 1) (c : ℤ) {m L e : ℚ}
    (hm : m / L = (c * abar : ℚ) / b + e) :
    ∃ k : ℤ, m / L = -((c * bbar : ℚ) / a) + (c : ℚ) / (a * b) + e + k := by
  obtain ⟨k, hk⟩ := reciprocity_frac hab ha0 hb0 ha hb c
  exact ⟨k, by rw [hm]; linarith⟩

/-- **Schwartz frequency provider** (EXTERNAL PROVIDER; never constructed). -/
structure SchwartzFrequencyProvider (psiHat : ℝ → ℝ) (C : ℝ) : Prop where
  bound : ∀ (t : ℝ), 1 ≤ t → ∀ H : ℕ,
    ∑ h ∈ Finset.Icc (1 : ℤ) H, (|(h : ℝ)| * |psiHat (h / t)| + |(h : ℝ)| * |psiHat (-h / t)|) ≤
      C * t ^ 2

/-- The real-correction error bound supplied by the Schwartz provider (LEAN CONDITIONAL):
the correction `Σ_h |h| |ψ̂(h/t)| · amp` is at most `C t² · amp`. -/
theorem real_correction_conditional {psiHat : ℝ → ℝ} {C : ℝ}
    (hS : SchwartzFrequencyProvider psiHat C) {t amp : ℝ} (ht : 1 ≤ t) (hamp : 0 ≤ amp) (H : ℕ) :
    (∑ h ∈ Finset.Icc (1 : ℤ) H,
        (|(h : ℝ)| * |psiHat (h / t)| + |(h : ℝ)| * |psiHat (-h / t)|)) * amp ≤
      C * t ^ 2 * amp :=
  mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right (hS.bound t ht H) hamp

/-- The supplied real-correction exponent. -/
def realCorrectionExponent : ℚ := -1079 / 1900

/-- Rational facts about the supplied real-correction exponent (LEAN BANK). -/
theorem real_correction_exponent_facts :
    realCorrectionExponent < 0 ∧ realCorrectionExponent < -1 / 2 ∧
      realCorrectionExponent < -(1 / 1100) ∧ realCorrectionExponent = -1 / 2 - 129 / 1900 := by
  unfold realCorrectionExponent; norm_num

/-- The frequency cap `H_cap = C Q d R² S² / M · x^{η/4}`. -/
noncomputable def Hcap (C Q d R S M x η : ℝ) : ℝ := C * Q * d * R ^ 2 * S ^ 2 / M * x ^ (η / 4)

/-- **Frequency-cap (Schwartz tail) provider** (EXTERNAL PROVIDER; never constructed). For a FIXED
`J > 2`, the tail beyond `H_cap` is `≤ C_{ψ,J} (L/M) x^{−(J−1)η/4}`. -/
structure FrequencyCapProvider (psiHat : ℝ → ℝ) (J : ℕ) (CJ C Q d R S M L x η : ℝ) : Prop where
  J_gt : 2 < J
  tail : ∀ H : ℕ,
    ∑ h ∈ (Finset.Icc (1 : ℤ) H).filter (fun h : ℤ => Hcap C Q d R S M x η < (h : ℝ)),
        (|psiHat (h * M / L)| + |psiHat (-h * M / L)|) ≤
      CJ * (L / M) * x ^ (-((J : ℝ) - 1) * η / 4)

/-- **A fixed `J` exists** (LEAN BANK): for any fixed polynomial outer exponent `P ≥ 0` and saving
`A ≥ 0`, there is a natural `J > 2`, independent of `x`, with `(J−1)η/4 ≥ P + A`. -/
theorem fixed_J_exists {η : ℝ} (hη : 0 < η) (P A : ℝ) :
    ∃ J : ℕ, 2 < J ∧ P + A ≤ ((J : ℝ) - 1) * η / 4 := by
  obtain ⟨n, hn⟩ := exists_nat_gt (4 * (P + A) / η)
  refine ⟨n + 3, by omega, ?_⟩
  have : 4 * (P + A) / η * η = 4 * (P + A) := div_mul_cancel₀ _ hη.ne'
  push_cast
  nlinarith

/-- **Tail absorption** (LEAN BANK): an outer count `≤ x^P` times the tail `x^{−(J−1)η/4}` is at
most `x^{−A}` once `(J−1)η/4 ≥ P + A`. -/
theorem frequency_tail_absorbed {x P A η : ℝ} {J : ℕ} (hx : 1 ≤ x)
    (hJ : P + A ≤ ((J : ℝ) - 1) * η / 4) :
    x ^ P * x ^ (-((J : ℝ) - 1) * η / 4) ≤ x ^ (-A) := by
  rw [← Real.rpow_add (by linarith)]
  exact Real.rpow_le_rpow_of_exponent_le hx (by linarith)

/-- **Frequency cap, conditional** (LEAN CONDITIONAL on `FrequencyCapProvider`): an outer count
`≤ x^P` times the Schwartz tail beyond `H_cap` is `≤ C_{ψ,J} (L/M) x^{−A}` for the fixed `J`. -/
theorem frequency_cap_conditional {psiHat : ℝ → ℝ} {J : ℕ} {CJ C Q d R S M L x η P A cnt : ℝ}
    (hF : FrequencyCapProvider psiHat J CJ C Q d R S M L x η) (hx : 1 ≤ x)
    (hJ : P + A ≤ ((J : ℝ) - 1) * η / 4) (hcnt : cnt ≤ x ^ P)
    (hCLM : 0 ≤ CJ * (L / M)) (H : ℕ) :
    cnt * ∑ h ∈ (Finset.Icc (1 : ℤ) H).filter (fun h : ℤ => Hcap C Q d R S M x η < (h : ℝ)),
        (|psiHat (h * M / L)| + |psiHat (-h * M / L)|) ≤ CJ * (L / M) * x ^ (-A) := by
  have hx0 : 0 < x := by linarith
  calc _ ≤ x ^ P * (CJ * (L / M) * x ^ (-((J : ℝ) - 1) * η / 4)) :=
        mul_le_mul hcnt (hF.tail H)
          (Finset.sum_nonneg fun _ _ => by positivity) (Real.rpow_nonneg hx0.le _)
    _ = CJ * (L / M) * (x ^ P * x ^ (-((J : ℝ) - 1) * η / 4)) := by ring
    _ ≤ CJ * (L / M) * x ^ (-A) :=
        mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left (frequency_tail_absorbed hx hJ) hCLM

/-- **Smooth-recovery (variation) provider** (EXTERNAL PROVIDER; never constructed). -/
structure SmoothRecoveryProvider (b : ℕ → ℝ) (n : ℕ) (V : ℝ) : Prop where
  variation : ∑ i ∈ range (n - 1), |b (i + 1) - b i| ≤ V

/-- **Colour partial summation** (LEAN BANK): the colour coefficients `a` stay inside partial
sums `A_i = Σ_{k≤i} a_k`; only the smooth weight `b` is differenced. -/
theorem colour_partial_summation (a : ℕ → ℂ) (b : ℕ → ℝ) (n : ℕ) :
    ∑ i ∈ range n, (b i : ℂ) * a i =
      (b (n - 1) : ℂ) * ∑ i ∈ range n, a i -
        ∑ i ∈ range (n - 1), ((b (i + 1) : ℂ) - b i) * ∑ k ∈ range (i + 1), a k := by
  have := Finset.sum_range_by_parts (fun i => (b i : ℂ)) a n
  simpa [smul_eq_mul] using this

/-- **Conditional smooth recovery** (LEAN CONDITIONAL on `SmoothRecoveryProvider`): if every colour
partial sum is bounded by `Amax`, then `|Σ b_i a_i| ≤ Amax (|b_{n−1}| + V)`. -/
theorem smooth_recovery_conditional (a : ℕ → ℂ) (b : ℕ → ℝ) (n : ℕ) {V Amax : ℝ}
    (hV : SmoothRecoveryProvider b n V) (hA : ∀ i, ‖∑ k ∈ range (i + 1), a k‖ ≤ Amax)
    (hAn : ‖∑ k ∈ range n, a k‖ ≤ Amax) (hA0 : 0 ≤ Amax) :
    ‖∑ i ∈ range n, (b i : ℂ) * a i‖ ≤ Amax * (|b (n - 1)| + V) := by
  rw [colour_partial_summation]
  refine (norm_sub_le _ _).trans ?_
  have h1 : ‖(b (n - 1) : ℂ) * ∑ i ∈ range n, a i‖ ≤ |b (n - 1)| * Amax := by
    rw [norm_mul, Complex.norm_real, Real.norm_eq_abs]
    exact mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left hAn (abs_nonneg _)
  have h2 : ‖∑ i ∈ range (n - 1), ((b (i + 1) : ℂ) - b i) * ∑ k ∈ range (i + 1), a k‖ ≤
      (∑ i ∈ range (n - 1), |b (i + 1) - b i|) * Amax := by
    rw [Finset.sum_mul]
    refine (norm_sum_le _ _).trans (Finset.sum_le_sum fun i _ => ?_)
    rw [norm_mul, ← Complex.ofReal_sub, Complex.norm_real, Real.norm_eq_abs]
    exact mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left (hA i) (abs_nonneg _)
  have h3 := mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right hV.variation hA0
  nlinarith

end SmoothFrequencyRecovery
end ResearchBankV27
end Erdos287
