import Mathlib.Tactic

/-!
# Erdős #287 — Research Bank V9 §3A: prescribed-shape gcd-clique, elementary core

INTERNAL #287 RESEARCH PROGRAMME ONLY.  **Erdős #287 is `OPEN` here and is not claimed.**

Kernel-proved:

* `gcd_eq_diff_iff` — `gcd(x, y) = |y − x|` iff `(y − x) ∣ x`;
* `clique_translate_iff` — the translates `C + b_i` form a gcd-clique
  (`gcd(C+b_i, C+b_j) = |b_i − b_j|`) iff `(b_j − b_i) ∣ C + b_i` for all `b_i < b_j`;
* `crt_exists` — the **general (non-coprime) Chinese remainder theorem** for a finite
  pairwise-compatible system, with its converse `compatible_of_solution`;
* `gcdClique_of_compatible` — pairwise compatibility of the clique congruence system gives a
  common translation `C` (arbitrarily large) realising the gcd-clique;
* fixtures: `{0,1,2,4}` with `C = 8` is a clique; `{0,1,2,3}` admits **no** translation
  (`shape_matters`), so the prescribed shape genuinely constrains the offsets.

`PrescribedShapeGCDClique` (offsets in prescribed scaled boxes) is stated as a proposition.
The box-placement counting/union-bound argument is **not** formalized in this bank, so this
proposition is **not** inhabited here.  `PrimeValuesOnClique` (Maynard-type prime supply on the
clique) is a **separate external interface**, also never inhabited; the two are kept apart.
-/

namespace Erdos287
namespace ResearchBankV9
namespace GcdClique

/-! ## 1.  The gcd identity -/

/-- `gcd(x, y) = |y − x|` iff `(y − x) ∣ x`. -/
theorem gcd_eq_diff_iff (x y : ℤ) : Int.gcd x y = (y - x).natAbs ↔ (y - x) ∣ x := by
  rw [← Int.gcd_sub_self_right, Int.gcd_eq_natAbs, Nat.gcd_eq_right_iff_dvd,
    Int.natAbs_dvd_natAbs]

/-- A list of integers is a gcd-clique: `gcd(x, y) = |y − x|` for all `x < y`. -/
def IsGcdClique (S : List ℤ) : Prop :=
  ∀ x ∈ S, ∀ y ∈ S, x < y → Int.gcd x y = (y - x).natAbs

/-- **Translation form.** -/
theorem clique_translate_iff (bs : List ℤ) (C : ℤ) :
    IsGcdClique (bs.map (C + ·)) ↔ ∀ bi ∈ bs, ∀ bj ∈ bs, bi < bj → (bj - bi) ∣ C + bi := by
  unfold IsGcdClique
  simp only [List.mem_map, forall_exists_index, and_imp]
  constructor
  · intro h bi hbi bj hbj hlt
    have := h _ bi hbi rfl _ bj hbj rfl (by linarith)
    rw [gcd_eq_diff_iff] at this
    simpa using this
  · rintro h _ bi hbi rfl _ bj hbj rfl hlt
    rw [gcd_eq_diff_iff]
    simpa using h bi hbi bj hbj (by linarith)

/-! ## 2.  The general Chinese remainder theorem -/

/-- `gcd(n, lcm(A, B)) ∣ lcm(gcd(n, A), gcd(n, B))`. -/
theorem gcd_lcm_dvd_lcm_gcd {n A B : ℕ} (hn : n ≠ 0) (hA : A ≠ 0) (hB : B ≠ 0) :
    Nat.gcd n (Nat.lcm A B) ∣ Nat.lcm (Nat.gcd n A) (Nat.gcd n B) := by
  have hg1 : Nat.gcd n A ≠ 0 := Nat.gcd_ne_zero_left hn
  have hg2 : Nat.gcd n B ≠ 0 := Nat.gcd_ne_zero_left hn
  rw [← Nat.factorization_le_iff_dvd (Nat.gcd_ne_zero_left hn) (Nat.lcm_ne_zero hg1 hg2),
    Nat.factorization_gcd hn (Nat.lcm_ne_zero hA hB), Nat.factorization_lcm hA hB,
    Nat.factorization_lcm hg1 hg2, Nat.factorization_gcd hn hA, Nat.factorization_gcd hn hB]
  intro p
  simp only [Finsupp.inf_apply, Finsupp.sup_apply]
  omega

/-- The lcm of the moduli of a congruence list. -/
def lcmList : List (ℤ × ℕ) → ℕ
  | [] => 1
  | q :: t => Nat.lcm q.2 (lcmList t)

theorem lcmList_ne_zero : ∀ l : List (ℤ × ℕ), (∀ q ∈ l, q.2 ≠ 0) → lcmList l ≠ 0
  | [], _ => by simp [lcmList]
  | q :: t, h => by
    simp only [lcmList]
    exact Nat.lcm_ne_zero (h q (by simp)) (lcmList_ne_zero t fun r hr => h r (by simp [hr]))

theorem dvd_lcmList : ∀ l : List (ℤ × ℕ), ∀ q ∈ l, q.2 ∣ lcmList l
  | [], q, hq => by simp at hq
  | r :: t, q, hq => by
    simp only [lcmList]
    rcases List.mem_cons.1 hq with rfl | hq
    · exact Nat.dvd_lcm_left _ _
    · exact (dvd_lcmList t q hq).trans (Nat.dvd_lcm_right _ _)

theorem gcd_lcmList_dvd {n : ℕ} (hn : n ≠ 0) (z : ℤ) :
    ∀ l : List (ℤ × ℕ), (∀ q ∈ l, q.2 ≠ 0) → (∀ q ∈ l, ((Nat.gcd n q.2 : ℕ) : ℤ) ∣ z) →
      ((Nat.gcd n (lcmList l) : ℕ) : ℤ) ∣ z
  | [], _, _ => by simp [lcmList]
  | q :: t, hne, h => by
    simp only [lcmList]
    have hq : q.2 ≠ 0 := hne q (by simp)
    have ht := lcmList_ne_zero t fun r hr => hne r (by simp [hr])
    have h1 : ((Nat.gcd n q.2 : ℕ) : ℤ) ∣ z := h q (by simp)
    have h2 := gcd_lcmList_dvd hn z t (fun r hr => hne r (by simp [hr]))
      (fun r hr => h r (by simp [hr]))
    rw [Int.natCast_dvd] at h1 h2 ⊢
    exact (gcd_lcm_dvd_lcm_gcd hn hq ht).trans (Nat.lcm_dvd h1 h2)

/-- Two-congruence CRT with the gcd compatibility condition. -/
theorem two_crt (a b : ℤ) (n L : ℕ) (h : ((Nat.gcd n L : ℕ) : ℤ) ∣ a - b) :
    ∃ y : ℤ, (n : ℤ) ∣ y - a ∧ (L : ℤ) ∣ y - b := by
  obtain ⟨k, hk⟩ := h
  have hg := Int.gcd_eq_gcd_ab (n : ℤ) (L : ℤ)
  rw [Int.gcd_natCast_natCast] at hg
  refine ⟨a - n * Int.gcdA n L * k, ⟨-(Int.gcdA n L * k), by ring⟩, ⟨Int.gcdB n L * k, ?_⟩⟩
  have : a - b = (n * Int.gcdA n L + L * Int.gcdB n L) * k := by rw [← hg]; exact hk
  linear_combination this

/-- **General CRT.**  A finite pairwise-compatible system `x ≡ a_i (mod n_i)` (`n_i ≠ 0`,
`gcd(n_i, n_j) ∣ a_i − a_j`) has a solution. -/
theorem crt_exists : ∀ l : List (ℤ × ℕ), (∀ q ∈ l, q.2 ≠ 0) →
    (∀ q ∈ l, ∀ r ∈ l, ((Nat.gcd q.2 r.2 : ℕ) : ℤ) ∣ q.1 - r.1) →
      ∃ x : ℤ, ∀ q ∈ l, (q.2 : ℤ) ∣ x - q.1
  | [], _, _ => ⟨0, by simp⟩
  | q :: t, hne, hc => by
    obtain ⟨x₀, hx₀⟩ := crt_exists t (fun r hr => hne r (by simp [hr]))
      (fun r hr s hs => hc r (by simp [hr]) s (by simp [hs]))
    have hq : q.2 ≠ 0 := hne q (by simp)
    have hcomp : ((Nat.gcd q.2 (lcmList t) : ℕ) : ℤ) ∣ q.1 - x₀ := by
      apply gcd_lcmList_dvd hq _ t (fun r hr => hne r (by simp [hr]))
      intro r hr
      have e1 : ((Nat.gcd q.2 r.2 : ℕ) : ℤ) ∣ q.1 - r.1 := hc q (by simp) r (by simp [hr])
      have e2 : ((Nat.gcd q.2 r.2 : ℕ) : ℤ) ∣ x₀ - r.1 :=
        (Int.natCast_dvd_natCast.2 (Nat.gcd_dvd_right _ _)).trans (hx₀ r hr)
      have := dvd_sub e1 e2
      rwa [show q.1 - r.1 - (x₀ - r.1) = q.1 - x₀ by ring] at this
    obtain ⟨y, hy1, hy2⟩ := two_crt q.1 x₀ q.2 (lcmList t) hcomp
    refine ⟨y, ?_⟩
    intro r hr
    rcases List.mem_cons.1 hr with rfl | hr
    · exact hy1
    · have h1 : (r.2 : ℤ) ∣ y - x₀ :=
        (Int.natCast_dvd_natCast.2 (dvd_lcmList t r hr)).trans hy2
      have := dvd_add h1 (hx₀ r hr)
      rwa [show y - x₀ + (x₀ - r.1) = y - r.1 by ring] at this

/-- The converse: a solvable system is pairwise compatible. -/
theorem compatible_of_solution (l : List (ℤ × ℕ)) (x : ℤ) (hx : ∀ q ∈ l, (q.2 : ℤ) ∣ x - q.1) :
    ∀ q ∈ l, ∀ r ∈ l, ((Nat.gcd q.2 r.2 : ℕ) : ℤ) ∣ q.1 - r.1 := by
  intro q hq r hr
  have h1 : ((Nat.gcd q.2 r.2 : ℕ) : ℤ) ∣ x - q.1 :=
    (Int.natCast_dvd_natCast.2 (Nat.gcd_dvd_left _ _)).trans (hx q hq)
  have h2 : ((Nat.gcd q.2 r.2 : ℕ) : ℤ) ∣ x - r.1 :=
    (Int.natCast_dvd_natCast.2 (Nat.gcd_dvd_right _ _)).trans (hx r hr)
  have := dvd_sub h2 h1
  rwa [show x - r.1 - (x - q.1) = q.1 - r.1 by ring] at this

/-- Solutions can be shifted by the lcm, hence taken arbitrarily large. -/
theorem crt_exists_ge (l : List (ℤ × ℕ)) (hne : ∀ q ∈ l, q.2 ≠ 0)
    (hc : ∀ q ∈ l, ∀ r ∈ l, ((Nat.gcd q.2 r.2 : ℕ) : ℤ) ∣ q.1 - r.1) (C₀ : ℤ) :
    ∃ x : ℤ, C₀ ≤ x ∧ ∀ q ∈ l, (q.2 : ℤ) ∣ x - q.1 := by
  obtain ⟨x, hx⟩ := crt_exists l hne hc
  have hL : (1 : ℤ) ≤ lcmList l := by
    have := lcmList_ne_zero l hne; exact_mod_cast Nat.one_le_iff_ne_zero.2 this
  refine ⟨x + lcmList l * |C₀ - x|, ?_, ?_⟩
  · have h0 : 0 ≤ |C₀ - x| := abs_nonneg _
    have : |C₀ - x| ≤ lcmList l * |C₀ - x| := le_mul_of_one_le_left h0 hL
    have := le_abs_self (C₀ - x)
    linarith
  · intro q hq
    have h1 : (q.2 : ℤ) ∣ lcmList l * |C₀ - x| :=
      (Int.natCast_dvd_natCast.2 (dvd_lcmList l q hq)).mul_right _
    have := dvd_add (hx q hq) h1
    rwa [show x - q.1 + lcmList l * |C₀ - x| = x + lcmList l * |C₀ - x| - q.1 by ring] at this

/-! ## 3.  The clique congruence system -/

/-- All ordered pairs of a list. -/
def pairs (bs : List ℤ) : List (ℤ × ℤ) := bs.flatMap fun x => bs.map fun y => (x, y)

theorem mem_pairs {bs : List ℤ} {p : ℤ × ℤ} : p ∈ pairs bs ↔ p.1 ∈ bs ∧ p.2 ∈ bs := by
  obtain ⟨a, b⟩ := p
  simp [pairs, List.mem_flatMap, List.mem_map]

/-- The clique congruence system of the offsets `bs`: `C ≡ −b_i (mod b_j − b_i)` for `b_i < b_j`. -/
def cliqueSystem (bs : List ℤ) : List (ℤ × ℕ) :=
  ((pairs bs).filter fun p => p.1 < p.2).map fun p => (-p.1, (p.2 - p.1).natAbs)

theorem cliqueSystem_ne_zero (bs : List ℤ) : ∀ q ∈ cliqueSystem bs, q.2 ≠ 0 := by
  intro q hq
  simp only [cliqueSystem, List.mem_map, List.mem_filter, mem_pairs,
    decide_eq_true_eq] at hq
  obtain ⟨p, ⟨-, hlt⟩, rfl⟩ := hq
  simp only [ne_eq, Int.natAbs_eq_zero]
  omega

/-- **Pairwise compatibility gives a (large) common translation realising the gcd-clique.** -/
theorem gcdClique_of_compatible (bs : List ℤ)
    (hc : ∀ q ∈ cliqueSystem bs, ∀ r ∈ cliqueSystem bs,
      ((Nat.gcd q.2 r.2 : ℕ) : ℤ) ∣ q.1 - r.1) (C₀ : ℤ) :
    ∃ C : ℤ, C₀ ≤ C ∧ IsGcdClique (bs.map (C + ·)) := by
  obtain ⟨C, hC0, hC⟩ := crt_exists_ge _ (cliqueSystem_ne_zero bs) hc C₀
  refine ⟨C, hC0, (clique_translate_iff bs C).2 ?_⟩
  intro bi hbi bj hbj hlt
  have := hC (-bi, (bj - bi).natAbs) (by
    simp only [cliqueSystem, List.mem_map, List.mem_filter, mem_pairs, decide_eq_true_eq]
    exact ⟨(bi, bj), ⟨⟨hbi, hbj⟩, hlt⟩, rfl⟩)
  simp only [Int.natCast_natAbs, sub_neg_eq_add] at this
  exact (abs_dvd _ _).1 this

/-- Conversely, a clique translation makes the system compatible. -/
theorem compatible_of_clique (bs : List ℤ) (C : ℤ) (h : IsGcdClique (bs.map (C + ·))) :
    ∀ q ∈ cliqueSystem bs, ∀ r ∈ cliqueSystem bs, ((Nat.gcd q.2 r.2 : ℕ) : ℤ) ∣ q.1 - r.1 := by
  apply compatible_of_solution _ C
  intro q hq
  simp only [cliqueSystem, List.mem_map, List.mem_filter, mem_pairs,
    decide_eq_true_eq] at hq
  obtain ⟨p, ⟨⟨h1, h2⟩, hlt⟩, rfl⟩ := hq
  have := (clique_translate_iff bs C).1 h p.1 h1 p.2 h2 hlt
  simp only [Int.natCast_natAbs, sub_neg_eq_add]
  exact (abs_dvd _ _).2 this

/-! ## 4.  Fixtures -/

/-- `{8, 9, 10, 12}` (offsets `{0,1,2,4}`, `C = 8`) is a gcd-clique. -/
theorem clique_0124 : IsGcdClique ([0, 1, 2, 4].map ((8 : ℤ) + ·)) := by
  rw [clique_translate_iff]
  decide

/-- **The shape matters**: the offsets `{0,1,2,3}` admit no translation. -/
theorem shape_matters : ∀ C : ℤ, ¬ IsGcdClique ([0, 1, 2, 3].map (C + ·)) := by
  intro C h
  rw [clique_translate_iff] at h
  have h1 := h 0 (by simp) 2 (by simp) (by norm_num)
  have h2 := h 1 (by simp) 3 (by simp) (by norm_num)
  omega

/-! ## 5.  The two propositions kept apart -/

/-- **Prescribed-shape gcd-clique (box form).**  For pairwise disjoint rational intervals
`(lo_i, hi_i)` and every scale threshold, there are a scale `X` and offsets `b_i ∈ (lo_i X, hi_i X)`
admitting a gcd-clique translation.  **Not inhabited in this bank** (the counting/union-bound
placement argument is not formalized). -/
def PrescribedShapeGCDClique : Prop :=
  ∀ (lo hi : List ℚ), lo.length = hi.length → (∀ i < lo.length, lo[i]! < hi[i]!) →
    (∀ i < lo.length, ∀ j < lo.length, i < j → hi[i]! ≤ lo[j]!) →
      ∀ X₀ : ℕ, ∃ X ≥ X₀, ∃ bs : List ℤ, bs.length = lo.length ∧
        (∀ i < bs.length, lo[i]! * X < bs[i]! ∧ (bs[i]! : ℚ) < hi[i]! * X) ∧
        ∃ C : ℤ, IsGcdClique (bs.map (C + ·))

/-- **External interface (Maynard-type prime supply on a clique) — never inhabited.**  For a
gcd-clique shape `as` there are infinitely many `t` with all affine forms `a t + 1` prime. -/
def PrimeValuesOnClique (as : List ℕ) : Prop :=
  ∀ t₀ : ℕ, ∃ t ≥ t₀, ∀ a ∈ as, (a * t + 1).Prime

end GcdClique
end ResearchBankV9
end Erdos287

@@END_FILE@@
@@BEGIN_FILE bytes=4948 sha256=0c934ea4ec38a8b3c08a22f0f3b4ee0c531697dde805248f448a4159db1891e8 path=LEAN_PROJECT/RequestProject/Erdos287/ResearchBankV9/GraphLocalization.lean@@
import RequestProject.Erdos287.Blocker
import RequestProject.Erdos287.ProblemStatement
import RequestProject.Erdos287.ResearchBankV9.AffineContact

/-!
# Erdős #287 — Research Bank V9 §3F: graph localization ⟹ no #287 representation

INTERNAL #287 RESEARCH PROGRAMME ONLY.  **Erdős #287 is `OPEN` here and is not claimed.**

The deterministic implication

  useful graph edge + both endpoint affine forms prime + bounded-cofactor rigidity
  + physical contact `z, z+1 ∈ [cM, M]` + `c > 1/e`
  ⟹ no #287 counterexample with maximum `M`,

kernel-proved with its four ingredients kept separate:

1. **exact adjacent-contact arithmetic** — `AffineContact.contact_locations`;
2. **bounded-cofactor row rigidity** — the project's `ExcludedPP` (window exclusion
   `p > C(⌊M/p⌋)`, from `primePower_window_exclusion`);
3. **no-`00` / gap `≤ 2`** — `Gap2CE.excludedPP_blockerPair` (from `holes_isolated`);
4. **harmonic-tail estimate** — `Gap2CE.exp_lower` (`e(N − 1) < M`), used in
   `contact_above_N`: `z ≥ cM` with `c > 1/e` forces `z ≥ N`.

Any asymptotic prime supply producing such edges is external and is not used here.
-/

namespace Erdos287
namespace ResearchBankV9
namespace GraphLocalization

open AffineContact

/-- **Harmonic-tail localization.**  In a gap-`≤ 2` counterexample, any `z ≥ cM` with `c > 1/e`
lies above the minimum `N`. -/
theorem contact_above_N (ce : Gap2CE) {c : ℝ} (hc : 1 / Real.exp 1 < c) {z : ℕ}
    (hz : c * ce.M ≤ z) : ce.N ≤ z := by
  have hlow := ce.exp_lower
  have he := Real.exp_pos 1
  have hM : (0 : ℝ) ≤ ce.M := by positivity
  have h1 : ((ce.N : ℝ) - 1) < ce.M / Real.exp 1 := by
    rw [lt_div_iff₀ he]; linarith
  have h2 : (ce.M : ℝ) / Real.exp 1 ≤ c * ce.M := by
    rw [div_eq_mul_inv, mul_comm]
    have : (Real.exp 1)⁻¹ ≤ c := by rw [← one_div]; exact hc.le
    exact mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right this hM
  have : (ce.N : ℝ) < z + 1 := by linarith
  exact_mod_cast Nat.lt_succ_iff.1 (by exact_mod_cast this)

/-- **Contact contradiction (abstract form).**  Two excluded prime powers dividing a physical
contact `z, z+1` with `cM ≤ z`, `z + 1 ≤ M`, `c > 1/e` refute every gap-`≤ 2` counterexample
with maximum `M`. -/
theorem contact_contradiction (ce : Gap2CE) {c : ℝ} (hc : 1 / Real.exp 1 < c) {z q₁ q₂ : ℕ}
    (hz : c * ce.M ≤ z) (hz1 : z + 1 ≤ ce.M) (hq₁ : ExcludedPP ce.M q₁)
    (hq₂ : ExcludedPP ce.M q₂) (hd₁ : q₁ ∣ z) (hd₂ : q₂ ∣ z + 1) : False :=
  ce.excludedPP_blockerPair (contact_above_N ce hc hz) hz1 hq₁ hq₂ hd₁ hd₂

/-- Bounded-cofactor rigidity of a prime `P` at scale `M`: `C(⌊M/P⌋) < P`. -/
def Rigid (M P : ℕ) : Prop := P.Prime ∧ C (M / P) < (P : ℤ)

theorem Rigid.excluded {M P : ℕ} (h : Rigid M P) : ExcludedPP M P :=
  ⟨P, 1, h.1, le_rfl, (pow_one P).symm, by simpa using h.2⟩

/-- The data of a useful graph edge localized at scale `M` with constant `c`. -/
structure UsefulEdgeData (M : ℕ) (c : ℝ) where
  /-- Smaller slope. -/
  ai : ℕ
  /-- Larger slope. -/
  aj : ℕ
  /-- The common parameter. -/
  t : ℕ
  /-- Ordered slopes. -/
  hij : ai < aj
  /-- gcd-clique edge condition `gcd(a_i, a_j) = a_j − a_i`. -/
  hg : Nat.gcd ai aj = aj - ai
  /-- `F_i(t)` is prime with bounded-cofactor rigidity. -/
  rigid_i : Rigid M (F ai t)
  /-- `F_j(t)` is prime with bounded-cofactor rigidity. -/
  rigid_j : Rigid M (F aj t)
  /-- Physical contact lower localization `cM ≤ z`. -/
  lower : c * M ≤ ((ai / (aj - ai)) * F aj t : ℕ)
  /-- Physical contact upper localization `z + 1 ≤ M`. -/
  upper : (ai / (aj - ai)) * F aj t + 1 ≤ M

/-- **Graph localization ⟹ contradiction** for gap-`≤ 2` counterexamples. -/
theorem no_gap2CE_of_usefulEdge (ce : Gap2CE) {c : ℝ} (hc : 1 / Real.exp 1 < c)
    (d : UsefulEdgeData ce.M c) : False := by
  obtain ⟨hz1, -, -⟩ := contact_locations d.hij d.hg d.t
  refine contact_contradiction ce hc d.lower d.upper d.rigid_j.excluded d.rigid_i.excluded
    (dvd_mul_left _ _) ?_
  rw [hz1]; exact dvd_mul_left _ _

/-- **No #287 representation with maximum `M`** (exact problem predicate). -/
theorem no_erdos287Counterexample_of_usefulEdge {A : Finset ℕ} (h : Erdos287Counterexample A)
    {c : ℝ} (hc : 1 / Real.exp 1 < c) (d : UsefulEdgeData (A.max' h.nonempty) c) : False :=
  no_gap2CE_of_usefulEdge h.toGap2CE hc d

/-- Conditional form: if every scale `M ≥ M₀` carries a useful localized edge, no counterexample
has maximum `≥ M₀`.  (The supply of edges is a hypothesis, never inhabited here.) -/
theorem no_counterexample_above_of_edge_supply {c : ℝ} (hc : 1 / Real.exp 1 < c) {M₀ : ℕ}
    (hsupply : ∀ M ≥ M₀, Nonempty (UsefulEdgeData M c)) {A : Finset ℕ}
    (h : Erdos287Counterexample A) (hM : M₀ ≤ A.max' h.nonempty) : False :=
  no_erdos287Counterexample_of_usefulEdge h hc (hsupply _ hM).some

end GraphLocalization
end ResearchBankV9
end Erdos287

import RequestProject.Erdos287.ResearchBankV8.Ledger

/-!
# Erdős #287 — Research Bank V9: epoch-aware status ledger and closure firewall

INTERNAL #287 RESEARCH PROGRAMME ONLY.  **Erdős #287 is `OPEN` here and is not claimed.**

Extends the V8 ledger (which itself freezes V7) with the direct-exclusion / graph / ASRA /
splice rows.  Machine-checked:

* `v9_no_closed` — no row of the complete V9 ledger is `CLOSED`;
* `v9_erdos287_open` — Erdős #287 is listed only as `OPEN`;
* `asra_epochs` — the historical "ASRA = full written candidate" row is `SUPERSEDED`
  (certification rollback) in the historical epoch, while the current `full ASRA` row is `OPEN`,
  and the two open ASRA interfaces are `OPEN`;
* `splice_blocked` — the effective finite splice is `BLOCKED`, eventual exclusion `CONDITIONAL`;
* `no_ledger_path_closes_erdos287` — along the recorded closure DAG, propagation from the
  `PROVED` rows (a node becomes derivable when all premises of one of its edges are derivable)
  reaches a fixpoint that does **not** contain Erdős #287, for every number of steps.
-/

namespace Erdos287
namespace ResearchBankV9
namespace Ledger

open Erdos287.ResearchBankV8.Ledger

/-- The new V9 rows. -/
def v9New : List RowV8 :=
  [ ⟨"gcd-clique CRT core (gcd identity, general CRT, compatibility ⟺ clique)", .directExclusion,
      .proved, .kernelProof⟩
  , ⟨"prescribed-shape gcd clique: box placement (union-bound argument)", .directExclusion,
      .open, .researchRecord⟩
  , ⟨"Maynard prime supply on the clique (PrimeValuesOnClique)", .directExclusion, .conditional,
      .externalInterface⟩
  , ⟨"affine contact identity and adjacent physical locations", .directExclusion, .proved,
      .kernelProof⟩
  , ⟨"circular annulus graph: α(G(n,r)) = r+1 and χ_f = n/(r+1)", .directExclusion, .proved,
      .kernelProof⟩
  , ⟨"graph-selective occupancy", .directExclusion, .proved, .kernelProof⟩
  , ⟨"145/39 graph gate (G(145,38): α=39, χ_f=145/39; 26/7 < 145/39)", .directExclusion,
      .proved, .kernelProof⟩
  , ⟨"7/13 − 78/145 = 1/1885", .directExclusion, .proved, .kernelProof⟩
  , ⟨"localization constant 39/106 > 1/e (106/39 < e)", .directExclusion, .proved,
      .kernelProof⟩
  , ⟨"graph localization ⟹ no #287 representation (given edge data)", .directExclusion, .proved,
      .kernelProof⟩
  , ⟨"graph architecture upper limit χ_f ≤ ρ+1", .directExclusion, .proved, .kernelProof⟩
  , ⟨"three-group A<3 architecture", .directExclusion, .superseded, .researchRecord⟩
  , ⟨"arbitrary-F A≥3 moment route", .directExclusion, .killedMethod, .researchRecord⟩
  , ⟨"Chen parameter tuning below 3", .directExclusion, .killedMethod, .researchRecord⟩
  , ⟨"ASRA = FULL WRITTEN CANDIDATE (pending hostile referee)", .asraFullWrittenCandidate,
      .superseded, .researchRecord⟩
  , ⟨"CRT/collision/prime-slot algebra", .asraCorrected, .proved, .kernelProof⟩
  , ⟨"polynomial-root CRT normalization (roots ↔ slot allocations)", .asraCorrected, .proved,
      .kernelProof⟩
  , ⟨"within-product collision zero", .asraCorrected, .proved, .kernelProof⟩
  , ⟨"correct main modulus lcm(B,D,d); clean totient normalization", .asraCorrected, .proved,
      .kernelProof⟩
  , ⟨"prime-slot truncation identity; upper-sieve majorization step", .asraCorrected, .proved,
      .kernelProof⟩
  , ⟨"Iwaniec/Maynard analytic upper sieve", .asraCorrected, .conditional, .externalInterface⟩
  , ⟨"large-overlap divisor decomposition", .asraCorrected, .proved, .kernelProof⟩
  , ⟨"large-overlap Shiu input", .asraCorrected, .conditional, .externalInterface⟩
  , ⟨"zero-mode density and centred kernel", .asraCorrected, .proved, .kernelProof⟩
  , ⟨"ratio-BV Zheng input", .asraCorrected, .conditional, .externalInterface⟩
  , ⟨"rational-root bilinear clearing (with base progression)", .asraCorrected, .proved,
      .kernelProof⟩
  , ⟨"ASRA_NonzeroFrequencyTransfer", .asraCorrected, .open, .researchRecord⟩
  , ⟨"ASRA_SignedSieveMainTerm", .asraCorrected, .open, .researchRecord⟩
  , ⟨"ASRA assembly implication (components ⟹ ASRA)", .asraCorrected, .conditional,
      .conditionalOnInterfaces⟩
  , ⟨"full ASRA", .asraCorrected, .open, .researchRecord⟩
  , ⟨"graph-selective occupancy + localization chain (edge supply)", .asraCorrected,
      .conditional, .conditionalOnInterfaces⟩
  , ⟨"eventual all-large exclusion", .asraCorrected, .conditional, .conditionalOnInterfaces⟩
  , ⟨"effective analytic threshold M_an", .asraCorrected, .open, .researchRecord⟩
  , ⟨"finite verification through M0-1", .asraCorrected, .open, .researchRecord⟩
  , ⟨"effective finite splice", .asraCorrected, .blocked, .researchRecord⟩
  , ⟨"historical finite endpoint ≈ 6.125×10^120", .asraCorrected, .historicalMetadata,
      .metadata⟩
  , ⟨"Erdős #287", .asraCorrected, .open, .researchRecord⟩ ]

/-- The complete V9 ledger. -/
def v9Ledger : List RowV8 := v8Ledger ++ v9New

set_option maxRecDepth 100000

/-- No V9 row is `CLOSED`. -/
theorem v9New_no_closed : ∀ r ∈ v9New, r.status ≠ .closed := by decide

/-- **No `CLOSED` row anywhere.** -/
theorem v9_no_closed : ∀ r ∈ v9Ledger, r.status ≠ .closed := by
  intro r hr
  rcases List.mem_append.1 hr with h | h
  · exact v8_no_closed r h
  · exact v9New_no_closed r h

/-- **Erdős #287 is listed only as `OPEN`** among the V9 rows (and never `CLOSED` anywhere). -/
theorem v9_erdos287_open :
    (∀ r ∈ v9New, r.name = "Erdős #287" → r.status = .open) ∧
    (∃ r ∈ v9New, r.name = "Erdős #287" ∧ r.status = .open) ∧
    (∀ r ∈ v9Ledger, r.status ≠ .closed) :=
  ⟨by decide, by decide, v9_no_closed⟩

/-- Research-record and external-interface rows are never `PROVED`. -/
theorem v9_record_external_not_proved :
    ∀ r ∈ v9New, (r.evidence = .researchRecord ∨ r.evidence = .externalInterface) →
      r.status ≠ .proved := by decide

/-- `PROVED` requires a kernel proof. -/
theorem v9_proved_implies_kernel :
    ∀ r ∈ v9New, r.status = .proved → r.evidence = .kernelProof := by decide

/-- **ASRA epochs**: the historical full-written-candidate row is `SUPERSEDED`, the current
full ASRA and its two open interfaces are `OPEN`. -/
theorem asra_epochs :
    (∃ r ∈ v9New, r.epoch = .asraFullWrittenCandidate ∧ r.status = .superseded) ∧
    (∃ r ∈ v9New, r.name = "full ASRA" ∧ r.epoch = .asraCorrected ∧ r.status = .open) ∧
    (∃ r ∈ v9New, r.name = "ASRA_NonzeroFrequencyTransfer" ∧ r.status = .open) ∧
    (∃ r ∈ v9New, r.name = "ASRA_SignedSieveMainTerm" ∧ r.status = .open) := by decide

/-- **Splice status**: effective finite splice `BLOCKED`, eventual exclusion `CONDITIONAL`. -/
theorem splice_blocked :
    (∃ r ∈ v9New, r.name = "effective finite splice" ∧ r.status = .blocked) ∧
    (∃ r ∈ v9New, r.name = "eventual all-large exclusion" ∧ r.status = .conditional) := by
  decide

/-! ## The closure DAG and the no-closing-path firewall -/

/-- A closure edge: all premises together yield the conclusion (schematic research DAG). -/
structure Edge where
  premises : List String
  conclusion : String
  deriving DecidableEq, Repr

/-- The recorded closure DAG of the direct-exclusion route. -/
def closureDAG : List Edge :=
  [ ⟨["ASRA_NonzeroFrequencyTransfer", "ASRA_SignedSieveMainTerm", "large-overlap Shiu input",
      "ratio-BV Zheng input", "CRT/collision/prime-slot algebra"], "full ASRA"⟩
  , ⟨["full ASRA", "graph-selective occupancy",
      "prescribed-shape gcd clique: box placement (union-bound argument)",
      "Maynard prime supply on the clique (PrimeValuesOnClique)"],
      "eventual all-large exclusion"⟩
  , ⟨["eventual all-large exclusion", "effective analytic threshold M_an",
      "finite verification through M0-1"], "effective finite splice"⟩
  , ⟨["effective finite splice"], "Erdős #287"⟩ ]

/-- The nodes of `v9New` with status `PROVED`. -/
def provedNodes : List String := (v9New.filter fun r => r.status = .proved).map (·.name)

/-- One propagation step. -/
def step (S : List String) : List String :=
  S ++ (closureDAG.filter fun e => e.premises.all fun p => p ∈ S).map (·.conclusion)

/-- `n` propagation steps from the proved nodes. -/
def derivable : ℕ → List String
  | 0 => provedNodes
  | n + 1 => step (derivable n)

/-- The proved set is already a fixpoint: no edge fires. -/
theorem step_provedNodes : step provedNodes = provedNodes := by decide

theorem derivable_eq (n : ℕ) : derivable n = provedNodes := by
  induction n with
  | zero => rfl
  | succ n ih => simp only [derivable, ih, step_provedNodes]

/-- **No ledger path closes Erdős #287.** -/
theorem no_ledger_path_closes_erdos287 (n : ℕ) : "Erdős #287" ∉ derivable n := by
  rw [derivable_eq]; decide

/-- The open premise blocking each edge: every edge of the DAG has a non-`PROVED` premise. -/
theorem every_edge_has_open_premise :
    ∀ e ∈ closureDAG, ∃ p ∈ e.premises, p ∉ provedNodes := by decide

end Ledger
end ResearchBankV9
end Erdos287

import RequestProject.Erdos287.ResearchBankV9.CircularGraph

/-!
# Erdős #287 — Research Bank V9 §3D: graph-selective occupancy

INTERNAL #287 RESEARCH PROGRAMME ONLY.  **Erdős #287 is `OPEN` here and is not claimed.**

Finite combinatorial theorem (kernel-proved, `occupancy_forces_edge`): if each graph vertex
receives at most `m` cells, every independent set has at most `r + 1` vertices, and at least
`(r + 1) m + 1` cells are occupied, then two occupied cells sit on adjacent vertices.

Programme parameterization (`occupancy_programme`): with `a = (r + 1) m` and
`Q = ⌈A a⌉ + 1` placed cells (`A ≥ 1`), if at most `Q − (a + 1)` cells are lost, the surviving
`a + 1` cells force a useful edge.  Specialization to the circular graph `G(n, r)`, `n > 3r`:
`circular_occupancy`.
-/

open scoped BigOperators

namespace Erdos287
namespace ResearchBankV9
namespace Occupancy

/-- **Graph-selective occupancy.** -/
theorem occupancy_forces_edge {V κ : Type*} [DecidableEq V] (Adj : V → V → Prop)
    (r m : ℕ) (hα : ∀ S : Finset V, (∀ x ∈ S, ∀ y ∈ S, ¬ Adj x y) → S.card ≤ r + 1)
    (cells : Finset κ) (f : κ → V) (hm : ∀ v, (cells.filter fun c => f c = v).card ≤ m)
    (hcells : (r + 1) * m + 1 ≤ cells.card) :
    ∃ c₁ ∈ cells, ∃ c₂ ∈ cells, Adj (f c₁) (f c₂) := by
  by_contra hno
  push_neg at hno
  have hind : ∀ x ∈ cells.image f, ∀ y ∈ cells.image f, ¬ Adj x y := by
    simp only [Finset.mem_image]
    rintro _ ⟨c₁, hc₁, rfl⟩ _ ⟨c₂, hc₂, rfl⟩
    exact hno c₁ hc₁ c₂ hc₂
  have hT := hα _ hind
  have hsum : cells.card ≤ (cells.image f).card * m := by
    rw [Finset.card_eq_sum_card_image f cells]
    calc ∑ v ∈ cells.image f, (cells.filter fun c => f c = v).card
        ≤ ∑ _v ∈ cells.image f, m := Finset.sum_le_sum fun v _ => hm v
      _ = (cells.image f).card * m := by simp
  have : (cells.image f).card * m ≤ (r + 1) * m := Nat.mul_le_mul_right m hT
  omega

/-- **Programme parameterization.**  With `a = (r + 1) m` and `Q = ⌈A a⌉ + 1` placed cells
(`A ≥ 1`), losing at most `Q − (a + 1)` cells still forces a useful edge. -/
theorem occupancy_programme {V κ : Type*} [DecidableEq V] (Adj : V → V → Prop)
    (r m : ℕ) (hα : ∀ S : Finset V, (∀ x ∈ S, ∀ y ∈ S, ¬ Adj x y) → S.card ≤ r + 1)
    (A : ℚ) (hA : 1 ≤ A) (placed survivors : Finset κ) (hsub : survivors ⊆ placed)
    (hQ : placed.card = ⌈A * ((r + 1) * m : ℕ)⌉.toNat + 1)
    (hloss : placed.card - survivors.card ≤ placed.card - ((r + 1) * m + 1))
    (f : κ → V) (hm : ∀ v, (survivors.filter fun c => f c = v).card ≤ m) :
    ∃ c₁ ∈ survivors, ∃ c₂ ∈ survivors, Adj (f c₁) (f c₂) := by
  have hQa : (r + 1) * m + 1 ≤ placed.card := by
    rw [hQ]
    generalize (r + 1) * m = N
    have h0 : (0 : ℚ) ≤ N := by positivity
    have h1 : (N : ℚ) ≤ A * N := by nlinarith
    have h3 : ((N : ℤ) : ℚ) ≤ ⌈A * (N : ℚ)⌉ := by
      have := Int.le_ceil (A * (N : ℚ)); push_cast; linarith
    have h2 : (N : ℤ) ≤ ⌈A * (N : ℚ)⌉ := by exact_mod_cast h3
    omega
  have hsc := Finset.card_le_card hsub
  exact occupancy_forces_edge Adj r m hα survivors f hm (by omega)

/-- **Occupancy on the circular annulus graph `G(n, r)`** (`n > 3r`): `(r+1) m + 1` cells on
vertices of `[0, n)`, at most `m` per vertex, force two cells at circular distance `≥ r + 1`. -/
theorem circular_occupancy {n : ℤ} {r m : ℕ} (hn : 3 * (r : ℤ) < n) {κ : Type*}
    (cells : Finset κ) (f : κ → ℤ) (hf : ∀ c ∈ cells, f c ∈ CircularGraph.V n)
    (hm : ∀ v, (cells.filter fun c => f c = v).card ≤ m)
    (hcells : (r + 1) * m + 1 ≤ cells.card) :
    ∃ c₁ ∈ cells, ∃ c₂ ∈ cells, CircularGraph.Adj n r (f c₁) (f c₂) := by
  classical
  -- restrict the graph to the vertex set `[0, n)` via the relation `Adj'`
  let Adj' : ℤ → ℤ → Prop := fun x y =>
    x ∉ CircularGraph.V n ∨ y ∉ CircularGraph.V n ∨ CircularGraph.Adj n r x y
  have hα : ∀ S : Finset ℤ, (∀ x ∈ S, ∀ y ∈ S, ¬ Adj' x y) → S.card ≤ r + 1 := by
    intro S hS
    have hsub : S ⊆ CircularGraph.V n := by
      intro x hx
      have := hS x hx x hx
      simp only [Adj', not_or, not_not] at this
      exact this.1
    have hind : CircularGraph.Indep n r S := by
      refine ⟨hsub, fun s hs t ht => ?_⟩
      have := hS s hs t ht
      simp only [Adj', not_or] at this
      exact (CircularGraph.near_iff (by omega) (by positivity) (by omega) s t).1 this.2.2
    have := CircularGraph.indep_card_le (by positivity) hn hind
    omega
  obtain ⟨c₁, h₁, c₂, h₂, hadj⟩ := occupancy_forces_edge Adj' r m hα cells f hm hcells
  refine ⟨c₁, h₁, c₂, h₂, ?_⟩
  rcases hadj with h | h | h
  · exact absurd (hf c₁ h₁) h
  · exact absurd (hf c₂ h₂) h
  · exact h

end Occupancy
end ResearchBankV9
end Erdos287

@@BEGIN_FILE bytes=6098 sha256=50411994eb4854c09a4d39004f8c11247427022c731efe29155ab53aedbf60ed path=LEAN_PROJECT/RequestProject/Erdos287/ResearchBankV9/Splice.lean@@
import RequestProject.Erdos287.ResearchBankV9.GraphLocalization
import RequestProject.Erdos287.ResearchBankV9.AsraInterfaces

/-!
# Erdős #287 — Research Bank V9 §5: eventual exclusion and the finite splice

INTERNAL #287 RESEARCH PROGRAMME ONLY.  **Erdős #287 is `OPEN` here and is not claimed.**

* `eventual_exclusion_conditional` — the implication chain, **only conditionally**:
  ASRA + (graph-selective occupancy + prescribed-shape/localization data + Maynard-type prime
  supply, packaged as the explicit chain hypothesis producing useful localized edges at every
  scale `≥ M_an`) ⟹ `EventualNoCounterexampleFrom M_an`.  No `M_an` is created.
* `splice` — finite verification through `U` + `U ≥ M₀ − 1` + eventual exclusion from `M₀`
  ⟹ full exclusion (no Erdős #287 counterexample at all).
* `SpliceThresholds`, `M₀` — `M₀ = max(M_an, M_geom, M_int, M_rig)`, defined only when the analytic
  threshold is present (`Option`).  The **current** state has `M_an = none`, hence
  `M₀ = none` (`current_M0_unavailable`); `EffectiveFiniteSplice` is an uninhabited proposition
  (it is equivalent to the full Erdős #287 statement, `effectiveSplice_iff_no_counterexample`).
* Historical metadata: the earlier finite endpoint `≈ 6.125 × 10^120` is recorded as a string only
  and is not reverified; `asymptotic_without_threshold_does_not_splice` shows that an eventual
  statement plus a finite check below its (unknown) threshold does not give full exclusion.
-/

namespace Erdos287
namespace ResearchBankV9
namespace Splice

open GraphLocalization AsraInterfaces

/-- No Erdős #287 counterexample has maximum `≥ M₀`. -/
def EventualNoCounterexampleFrom (M₀ : ℕ) : Prop :=
  ∀ A : Finset ℕ, ∀ h : Erdos287Counterexample A, A.max' h.nonempty < M₀

/-- Finite verification: no Erdős #287 counterexample has maximum `≤ U`. -/
def FiniteVerifiedThrough (U : ℕ) : Prop :=
  ∀ A : Finset ℕ, ∀ h : Erdos287Counterexample A, U < A.max' h.nonempty

/-- **The splice.** -/
theorem splice {U M₀ : ℕ} (hfin : FiniteVerifiedThrough U) (hU : M₀ ≤ U + 1)
    (hev : EventualNoCounterexampleFrom M₀) : ∀ A : Finset ℕ, ¬ Erdos287Counterexample A := by
  intro A h
  have h1 := hfin A h
  have h2 := hev A h
  omega

/-- **Conditional eventual exclusion.**  The chain hypothesis `hchain` is where graph-selective
occupancy, the prescribed-shape/localization data and the prime supply enter; it is a premise,
never inhabited here. -/
theorem eventual_exclusion_conditional (D : ASRAData) (PrimeSupply : Prop) {c : ℝ}
    (hc : 1 / Real.exp 1 < c) (M_an : ℕ) (hASRA : ASRA D) (hsupply : PrimeSupply)
    (hchain : ASRA D → PrimeSupply → ∀ M ≥ M_an, Nonempty (UsefulEdgeData M c)) :
    EventualNoCounterexampleFrom M_an := by
  intro A h
  by_contra hge
  push_neg at hge
  exact no_counterexample_above_of_edge_supply hc (hchain hASRA hsupply) h hge

/-- The explicit splice thresholds; the analytic threshold is optional. -/
structure SpliceThresholds where
  /-- Analytic threshold (absent in the current state). -/
  M_an : Option ℕ
  /-- Geometric threshold. -/
  M_geom : ℕ
  /-- Integrality threshold. -/
  M_int : ℕ
  /-- Rigidity threshold. -/
  M_rig : ℕ

/-- `M₀ = max(M_an, M_geom, M_int, M_rig)`, available only when `M_an` is. -/
def SpliceThresholds.M₀ (t : SpliceThresholds) : Option ℕ :=
  t.M_an.map fun a => max a (max t.M_geom (max t.M_int t.M_rig))

/-- The **current** thresholds: the analytic threshold is absent.  The finite thresholds are
recorded as `0` placeholders because no value is banked for them in this layer. -/
def currentThresholds : SpliceThresholds := ⟨none, 0, 0, 0⟩

/-- **`M₀` is unavailable in the current state.** -/
theorem current_M0_unavailable : currentThresholds.M₀ = none := rfl

theorem M0_ge {t : SpliceThresholds} {a m : ℕ} (ha : t.M_an = some a) (hm : t.M₀ = some m) :
    a ≤ m ∧ t.M_geom ≤ m ∧ t.M_int ≤ m ∧ t.M_rig ≤ m := by
  simp only [SpliceThresholds.M₀, ha, Option.map_some, Option.some.injEq] at hm
  subst hm
  omega

/-- The effective finite splice: an explicit threshold, a matching finite verification and the
eventual exclusion.  **OPEN / BLOCKED** — never inhabited. -/
def EffectiveFiniteSplice : Prop :=
  ∃ M₀ U : ℕ, FiniteVerifiedThrough U ∧ M₀ ≤ U + 1 ∧ EventualNoCounterexampleFrom M₀

/-- The effective splice is exactly the full statement "no Erdős #287 counterexample"; it is
therefore not claimed. -/
theorem effectiveSplice_iff_no_counterexample :
    EffectiveFiniteSplice ↔ ∀ A : Finset ℕ, ¬ Erdos287Counterexample A := by
  constructor
  · rintro ⟨M₀, U, hfin, hU, hev⟩
    exact splice hfin hU hev
  · intro h
    exact ⟨0, 0, fun A hA => (h A hA).elim, by omega, fun A hA => (h A hA).elim⟩

/-- Historical metadata only (not reverified, not used in any proof). -/
def historicalFiniteEndpoint : String :=
  "≈ 6.125 × 10^120 (historical metadata; the finite chain is not imported or reverified)"

/-- **Firewall: an asymptotic statement without an effective threshold does not splice.**  An
eventual exclusion from some unknown threshold plus a finite check through `U` does not give
full exclusion. -/
theorem asymptotic_without_threshold_does_not_splice (U : ℕ) :
    ¬ ∀ bad : ℕ → Prop, (∃ M₀, ∀ M ≥ M₀, ¬ bad M) → (∀ M ≤ U, ¬ bad M) → ∀ M, ¬ bad M := by
  intro h
  exact h (fun M => M = U + 1) ⟨U + 2, fun M hM hb => by omega⟩ (fun M hM hb => by omega)
    (U + 1) rfl

/-- **Firewall: a finite obstruction does not imply an asymptotic one.** -/
theorem finite_obstruction_not_asymptotic :
    ¬ ∀ bad : ℕ → Prop, (∃ M, bad M) → ∀ M₀, ∃ M ≥ M₀, bad M := by
  intro h
  obtain ⟨M, hM, hb⟩ := h (fun M => M = 0) ⟨0, rfl⟩ 1
  omega

/-- **Firewall: a conditional implication does not inhabit its premise.** -/
theorem conditional_does_not_inhabit_premise : ¬ ∀ P Q : Prop, (P → Q) → P := by
  intro h; exact h False True (fun _ => trivial)

end Splice
end ResearchBankV9
end Erdos287

import Mathlib

/-!
# W2.984 — exact congruence transfer for the fixed affine forms `L_i(t) = a_i t + 1`

**ERDŐS #287 REMAINS OPEN.  Exact integer / `ZMod` algebra; no analytic input.**

This file proves, as theorems, every arithmetic step of the affine `S₁, S₂, S₃` source
transformations of `AFFINE_CHEN_TRANSFER_W2984.md` (§§4, 6, 8).  The point is that **no local
density is inferred**: each density used in the paper is a literal residue count proved here.

## Designated prime coordinate (`S₁`, `S₂`)

* `transfer_identity` — `a_j (a_i t + 1) = a_i (a_j t + 1) + (a_j - a_i)`.
* `dvd_form_iff` — if `e` is coprime to `a_j` and `p = a_j t + 1`, then
  `e ∣ a_i t + 1 ↔ e ∣ a_i p + (a_j - a_i)` (the **literal congruence for `p`**).
* `coprime_of_dvd_form` — **every residue is a unit**: if moreover `e` is coprime to `a_j - a_i`,
  then `p` is coprime to `e`.
* `progression_iff` — `W ∣ t - t₀ ↔ a_j W ∣ p - (a_j t₀ + 1)`; `progression_surj` — every
  `p ≡ a_j t₀ + 1 (mod a_j W)` is `a_j t + 1` with `t ≡ t₀ (mod W)`: the **complete modulus
  includes `a_j W`**, and the map `t ↦ p` is a bijection of the two progressions.
* `base_residue_unit` — `a_j t₀ + 1` is a unit mod `a_j W` iff it is a unit mod `W`; with `t₀ = 0`
  it is `1`.
* `totient_mul_of_primeFactors_subset` — **`φ(a_j W) = a_j φ(W)`** when every prime factor of
  `a_j` divides `W` (exact normalisation); `totient_normalisation_needs_radical` shows the
  hypothesis cannot be dropped (`φ(3·2) ≠ 3 φ(2)`).

## CRT compatibility: distinct affine roots

* `prime_dvd_two_forms` — a prime dividing `a_i t + 1` and `a_k t + 1` divides `a_k - a_i`
  (and not `a_i`).
* `coprime_of_dvd_forms` — hence divisors of two different forms that are coprime to `W` are
  coprime whenever every prime factor of `a_k - a_i` divides `W`: the moduli
  `d`, `[d_i, d_i']`, `a_j W` are **pairwise coprime on the support**, not "may be assumed".
* `roots_distinct` — modulo a prime `q ∤ a_i a_k (a_i - a_k)` the roots `-a_i⁻¹`, `-a_k⁻¹` are
  distinct; `card_root_one` — exactly one residue class; `local_density_designated` —
  among the `q - 1` classes with `q ∤ L_j(t)` exactly one has `q ∣ L_ℓ(t)`: the literal
  local factor `g(q) = 1/(q - 1)` of Merikoski's Lemma 15.
* `overlap_empty` — **the spectator-overlap set is empty**: if `q ∣ L_ℓ(t)` and `q ∣ L_i(t)`
  for `i ≠ ℓ` with `q` prime to the slope difference, there is no such `t`.  This is the precise
  reason the first sum in Merikoski's `r_d` vanishes while the second does not (v3 §6).

## Switched coordinate (`S₃`)

* `switched_identity` — with `x = a_ℓ t + 1`: `a_ℓ (a_j t + 1) = a_j x + a_ℓ - a_j`.
* `switched_progression` — `W ∣ t → a_ℓ W ∣ x - 1`; the base progression is
  `x ≡ 1 (mod a_ℓ W)`; `switched_modulus_not_squarefree` — `a_ℓ W` need not be squarefree
  (`a_ℓ = 4`, `W = 2`).
-/

namespace Erdos287.W2984Publication

/-! ### Designated prime coordinate -/

theorem transfer_identity (ai aj t : ℤ) :
    aj * (ai * t + 1) = ai * (aj * t + 1) + (aj - ai) := by ring

/-- The literal congruence for `p = a_j t + 1`. -/
theorem dvd_form_iff {e ai aj t : ℤ} (hcop : IsCoprime e aj) :
    e ∣ ai * t + 1 ↔ e ∣ ai * (aj * t + 1) + (aj - ai) := by
  rw [← transfer_identity]
  constructor
  · intro h; exact Dvd.dvd.mul_left h aj
  · intro h; exact hcop.dvd_of_dvd_mul_left h

/-- Every residue is a unit. -/
theorem coprime_of_dvd_form {e ai aj p : ℤ} (hd : e ∣ ai * p + (aj - ai))
    (hcop : IsCoprime e (aj - ai)) : IsCoprime e p := by
  obtain ⟨k, hk⟩ := hd
  obtain ⟨u, v, huv⟩ := hcop
  refine ⟨u + v * k, -(v * ai), ?_⟩
  have : aj - ai = e * k - ai * p := by linarith
  rw [this] at huv
  linarith [huv]

theorem progression_iff {aj W t t₀ : ℤ} (haj : aj ≠ 0) :
    W ∣ t - t₀ ↔ aj * W ∣ (aj * t + 1) - (aj * t₀ + 1) := by
  rw [show (aj * t + 1) - (aj * t₀ + 1) = aj * (t - t₀) by ring]
  exact (mul_dvd_mul_iff_left haj).symm

theorem progression_surj {aj W t₀ p : ℤ} (h : aj * W ∣ p - (aj * t₀ + 1)) :
    ∃ t : ℤ, p = aj * t + 1 ∧ W ∣ t - t₀ := by
  obtain ⟨m, hm⟩ := h
  refine ⟨t₀ + W * m, by linarith [hm], ⟨m, by ring⟩⟩

theorem base_residue_unit {aj W t₀ : ℤ} :
    IsCoprime (aj * t₀ + 1) (aj * W) ↔ IsCoprime (aj * t₀ + 1) W := by
  have ha : IsCoprime (aj * t₀ + 1) aj := ⟨1, -t₀, by ring⟩
  constructor
  · intro h; exact h.of_mul_right_right
  · intro h; exact IsCoprime.mul_right ha h

theorem base_residue_zero (aj W : ℤ) : IsCoprime (aj * 0 + 1) (aj * W) := by
  simpa using isCoprime_one_left

/-- **Exact normalisation** `φ(a W) = a φ(W)` when `rad a ∣ W`. -/
theorem totient_mul_of_primeFactors_subset {a W : ℕ} (ha : 0 < a) (hW : 0 < W)
    (hsub : ∀ q, q.Prime → q ∣ a → q ∣ W) : Nat.totient (a * W) = a * Nat.totient W := by
  have hpf : (a * W).primeFactors = W.primeFactors := by
    rw [Nat.primeFactors_mul ha.ne' hW.ne']
    apply Finset.union_eq_right.2
    intro q hq
    rw [Nat.mem_primeFactors] at hq ⊢
    exact ⟨hq.1, hsub q hq.1 hq.2.1, hW.ne'⟩
  rw [Nat.totient_eq_div_primeFactors_mul, Nat.totient_eq_div_primeFactors_mul W, hpf]
  have hdvd : (∏ p ∈ W.primeFactors, p) ∣ W := Nat.prod_primeFactors_dvd W
  rw [Nat.mul_div_assoc a hdvd, mul_assoc]

/-- The radical hypothesis cannot be dropped. -/
theorem totient_normalisation_needs_radical : Nat.totient (3 * 2) ≠ 3 * Nat.totient 2 := by
  decide

/-! ### Distinct affine roots and CRT compatibility -/

theorem prime_dvd_two_forms {q : ℕ} {ai ak t : ℤ} (hi : (q : ℤ) ∣ ai * t + 1)
    (hk : (q : ℤ) ∣ ak * t + 1) : (q : ℤ) ∣ ak - ai := by
  have : ak - ai = ak * (ai * t + 1) - ai * (ak * t + 1) := by ring
  rw [this]
  exact dvd_sub (Dvd.dvd.mul_left hi _) (Dvd.dvd.mul_left hk _)

theorem prime_not_dvd_slope {q : ℕ} (hq : q.Prime) {ai t : ℤ} (hi : (q : ℤ) ∣ ai * t + 1) :
    ¬ (q : ℤ) ∣ ai := by
  intro h
  have : (q : ℤ) ∣ 1 := by
    have := dvd_sub hi (Dvd.dvd.mul_right h t)
    simpa using this
  have := Int.eq_one_of_dvd_one (by positivity) this
  exact hq.one_lt.ne' (by exact_mod_cast this)

/-- **Pairwise coprimality on the support.** Divisors of two different forms that are coprime
to `W` are coprime, when every prime factor of the slope difference divides `W`. -/
theorem coprime_of_dvd_forms {di dk W : ℕ} {ai ak t : ℤ}
    (hdi : (di : ℤ) ∣ ai * t + 1) (hdk : (dk : ℤ) ∣ ak * t + 1)
    (hW : ∀ q : ℕ, q.Prime → (q : ℤ) ∣ ak - ai → q ∣ W) (hiW : Nat.Coprime di W) :
    Nat.Coprime di dk := by
  apply Nat.coprime_of_dvd
  intro q hq hqi hqk
  have h1 : (q : ℤ) ∣ ai * t + 1 := (Int.natCast_dvd_natCast.2 hqi).trans hdi
  have h2 : (q : ℤ) ∣ ak * t + 1 := (Int.natCast_dvd_natCast.2 hqk).trans hdk
  have hqW := hW q hq (prime_dvd_two_forms h1 h2)
  exact hq.one_lt.ne' (Nat.Coprime.eq_one_of_dvd (Nat.Coprime.coprime_dvd_left hqi hiW) hqW)

section ZModRoots

variable {q : ℕ} [Fact q.Prime]

/-- Distinct roots modulo `q`. -/
theorem roots_distinct {ai ak : ZMod q} (hd : ai ≠ ak) :
    -ai⁻¹ ≠ -ak⁻¹ := by
  intro h
  apply hd
  have := neg_inj.1 h
  exact inv_inj.1 this

theorem form_eq_zero_iff {a t : ZMod q} (ha : a ≠ 0) : a * t + 1 = 0 ↔ t = -a⁻¹ := by
  constructor
  · intro h
    have : a * t = -1 := by linear_combination h
    calc t = a⁻¹ * (a * t) := by rw [← mul_assoc, inv_mul_cancel₀ ha, one_mul]
      _ = -a⁻¹ := by rw [this]; ring
  · rintro rfl; rw [mul_neg, mul_inv_cancel₀ ha]; ring

/-- Exactly one residue class `t` with `q ∣ a t + 1`. -/
theorem card_root_one {a : ZMod q} (ha : a ≠ 0) :
    (Finset.univ.filter (fun t : ZMod q => a * t + 1 = 0)).card = 1 := by
  rw [Finset.card_eq_one]
  exact ⟨-a⁻¹, by ext t; simp [form_eq_zero_iff ha]⟩

/-- **Literal local factor of Merikoski's Lemma 15.**  Among residue classes `t` with
`q ∤ L_j(t)` (there are `q - 1`), exactly one has `q ∣ L_ℓ(t)`. -/
theorem local_density_designated {aj aℓ : ZMod q} (hj : aj ≠ 0) (hℓ : aℓ ≠ 0) (hd : aj ≠ aℓ) :
    (Finset.univ.filter (fun t : ZMod q => aj * t + 1 ≠ 0)).card = q - 1 ∧
      (Finset.univ.filter (fun t : ZMod q => aj * t + 1 ≠ 0 ∧ aℓ * t + 1 = 0)).card = 1 := by
  constructor
  · have h := Finset.card_filter_add_card_filter_not
      (s := (Finset.univ : Finset (ZMod q))) (fun t : ZMod q => aj * t + 1 = 0)
    rw [card_root_one hj, Finset.card_univ, ZMod.card] at h
    simp only [ne_eq]
    omega
  · rw [Finset.card_eq_one]
    refine ⟨-aℓ⁻¹, ?_⟩
    ext t
    simp only [Finset.mem_filter, Finset.mem_univ, true_and, Finset.mem_singleton, ne_eq]
    rw [form_eq_zero_iff hℓ, form_eq_zero_iff hj]
    constructor
    · exact fun h => h.2
    · rintro rfl
      exact ⟨fun h => roots_distinct (Ne.symm hd) h, rfl⟩

/-- **Spectator-overlap set is empty** (distinct affine roots). -/
theorem overlap_empty {ai aℓ : ZMod q} (hi : ai ≠ 0) (hℓ : aℓ ≠ 0) (hd : ai ≠ aℓ) :
    (Finset.univ.filter (fun t : ZMod q => ai * t + 1 = 0 ∧ aℓ * t + 1 = 0)).card = 0 := by
  rw [Finset.card_eq_zero, Finset.filter_eq_empty_iff]
  rintro t - ⟨h1, h2⟩
  rw [form_eq_zero_iff hi] at h1
  rw [form_eq_zero_iff hℓ] at h2
  exact roots_distinct hd (h1 ▸ h2 ▸ rfl)

end ZModRoots

/-! ### Switched coordinate -/

theorem switched_identity (aj aℓ t : ℤ) :
    aℓ * (aj * t + 1) = aj * (aℓ * t + 1) + aℓ - aj := by ring

theorem switched_progression {aℓ W t : ℤ} (h : W ∣ t) : aℓ * W ∣ (aℓ * t + 1) - 1 := by
  rw [show aℓ * t + 1 - 1 = aℓ * t by ring]
  exact mul_dvd_mul_left aℓ h

/-- The switched base modulus `a_ℓ W` need not be squarefree. -/
theorem switched_modulus_not_squarefree : ¬ Squarefree (4 * 2 : ℕ) := by decide

end Erdos287.W2984Publication

@@END_FILE@@
@@BEGIN_FILE bytes=10760 sha256=ac70bd27c9781d1a572b0bb1c0d988df8f744a997640e7420f34497357153aa7 path=LEAN_PROJECT/RequestProject/Erdos287/W2984Publication/AxiomAudit.lean@@
import RequestProject.Erdos287.W2984Publication.RegressionSuite

/-!
# W2.984 — axiom, provider and semantic-firewall audit (runs at build time)

* `#assert_std_axioms_v90 foo` (imported from the W3 audit) fails the build unless `foo` depends
  only on `propext`, `Classical.choice`, `Quot.sound` (so `sorryAx`, custom axioms and the
  `native_decide` axiom `Lean.ofReduceBool` are rejected).
* `#audit_providers_w2984` fails the build if any declaration of `Erdos287.W2984Publication`
  *produces* one of the provider structures without taking a provider as hypothesis, or takes a
  hypothesis of type `False` / `IsEmpty _`.
* `#assert_mentions foo [consts]` / `#assert_avoids foo [consts]` — statement-level firewall:
  the W2.984 theorem must visibly mention all four Chen providers and the W3 framework, and the
  providers must not mention `W3Statement`, `WindowMomentData`, `occupied`, `ContactWitness`
  (no provider contains W2.984 or an occupancy/contact conclusion).
-/

open Lean Elab Command Meta

/-- Providers of the W2.984 subtree. -/
def providersW2984 : List Name :=
  [`Erdos287.W2984Publication.W3FrameworkProvider,
   `Erdos287.W2984Publication.AffineChenS1Provider,
   `Erdos287.W2984Publication.AffineChenS2Provider,
   `Erdos287.W2984Publication.AffineChenS3Provider,
   `Erdos287.W2984Publication.AffineChenSquareTailProvider,
   `Erdos287.W2984Publication.PairBoundProvider]

/-- Fail if some declaration produces a provider unguardedly or from a vacuous hypothesis. -/
elab "#audit_providers_w2984" : command => do
  let env ← getEnv
  let pre : Name := `Erdos287.W2984Publication
  for p in providersW2984 do
    unless env.contains p do throwError "provider {p} not found"
  let skipSuffix : List String :=
    ["mk", "casesOn", "recOn", "rec", "brecOn", "binductionOn", "below", "ibelow",
     "noConfusion", "noConfusionType", "ctorIdx", "ctorElim", "ctorElimType", "injEq", "inj",
     "sizeOf_spec", "mk.injEq", "mk.inj", "mk.sizeOf_spec"]
  let mut checked : Array Name := #[]
  for (n, ci) in env.constants.toList do
    unless pre.isPrefixOf n do continue
    if n.isInternal then continue
    let last := n.getString!
    if skipSuffix.contains last then continue
    if (← liftCoreM <| isProjectionFn n) then continue
    let r ← liftTermElabM <| forallTelescopeReducing ci.type fun xs body => do
      let concl := body.getAppFn.constName?
      match concl with
      | some c =>
        if providersW2984.contains c then
          let mut guarded := false
          let mut vacuous := false
          for x in xs do
            let ty ← inferType x
            let ty ← whnf ty
            if let some h := ty.getAppFn.constName? then
              if providersW2984.contains h then guarded := true
              if h == ``False || h == ``IsEmpty then vacuous := true
          return some (guarded, vacuous)
        else return none
      | none => return none
    if let some (g, v) := r then
      checked := checked.push n
      unless g do throwError "{n} produces a provider without a provider hypothesis"
      if v then throwError "{n} produces a provider from a vacuous hypothesis"
  logInfo m!"W2.984 provider audit passed; guarded provider-producing declarations: {checked}"

/-- Fail unless the statement of `id` mentions every constant in the list. -/
elab "#assert_mentions " id:ident " [" cs:ident,* "]" : command => do
  let n ← liftCoreM <| realizeGlobalConstNoOverloadWithInfo id
  let used := (← getConstInfo n).type.getUsedConstants
  for c in cs.getElems do
    let cn ← liftCoreM <| realizeGlobalConstNoOverloadWithInfo c
    unless used.contains cn do throwError "{n} does not mention {cn}"
  logInfo m!"{n} mentions all required constants"

/-- Fail if the statement or *any field type* of structure `id` mentions a listed constant. -/
elab "#assert_avoids " id:ident " [" cs:ident,* "]" : command => do
  let n ← liftCoreM <| realizeGlobalConstNoOverloadWithInfo id
  let env ← getEnv
  let mut used := (← getConstInfo n).type.getUsedConstants
  if let some info := getStructureInfo? env n then
    for f in info.fieldNames do
      if let some pf := getProjFnForField? env n f then
        used := used ++ (← getConstInfo pf).type.getUsedConstants
  for c in cs.getElems do
    let cn ← liftCoreM <| realizeGlobalConstNoOverloadWithInfo c
    if used.contains cn then throwError "{n} mentions forbidden {cn}"
  logInfo m!"{n} avoids all forbidden constants"

namespace Erdos287.W2984Publication
open Erdos287.PostV87V90R
end Erdos287.W2984Publication

/-! ## Axioms of the principal kernel theorems -/

-- scalar layer
#assert_std_axioms_v90 Erdos287.W2984Publication.Omega1_sub_Omega2
#assert_std_axioms_v90 Erdos287.W2984Publication.Omega1_seventh
#assert_std_axioms_v90 Erdos287.W2984Publication.Omega2_seventh
#assert_std_axioms_v90 Erdos287.W2984Publication.buchstab_le
#assert_std_axioms_v90 Erdos287.W2984Publication.buchstab_dde_mid
#assert_std_axioms_v90 Erdos287.W2984Publication.buchstab_dde_tail
#assert_std_axioms_v90 Erdos287.W2984Publication.Flin_dde
#assert_std_axioms_v90 Erdos287.W2984Publication.flin_dde
#assert_std_axioms_v90 Erdos287.W2984Publication.Omega3_le
#assert_std_axioms_v90 Erdos287.W2984Publication.J_lower
#assert_std_axioms_v90 Erdos287.W2984Publication.log_three_halves_le
#assert_std_axioms_v90 Erdos287.W2984Publication.log_five_fourths_le
#assert_std_axioms_v90 Erdos287.W2984Publication.pairConstant_le_certificate

import Mathlib

/-!
# W2.984 — the affine Chen decomposition (analogue of Merikoski v3, Lemma 13)

**ERDŐS #287 REMAINS OPEN.  Exact combinatorics; no analytic input.**

Fix a finite set `Ps` of primes (the sifting primes; Merikoski's `P₀` variant is `Ps = {p ≤ Z,
p ∤ Z_exc}`), and levels `Y ≤ Z`.  For an integer `n` put

* `rough Ps w n` : no `p ∈ Ps` with `p ≤ w` divides `n` (i.e. `(n, P_Ps(w)) = 1`);
* `band Ps Y Z n = {p ∈ Ps : Y < p ≤ Z, p ∣ n}`, `k(n) = #band`;
* `T₃(n) = #{(p,q,r) ∈ Ps³ : Y < p < q < r ≤ Z, pqr ∣ n, rough Ps q (n/(pqr))}` — this is
  Merikoski's `∑_{Y<p<q<r≤Z} ∑_{(s,P(q))=1} 1_{n = pqrs}`;
* `sq(n) = k(n) · #{p ∈ band : p² ∣ n}` — the **non-squarefree correction** (new).

## Audit finding (kernel-checked)

Merikoski's proof of Lemma 13 asserts the pointwise inequality
`1_{(n,P(Z))=1} ≤ 1_{(n,P(Y))=1} - ½ k(n) 1_{(n,P(Y))=1} + ½ T₃(n)`
"for any `n`", arguing that for `k ≥ 2` there are exactly `k - 2` triples.  That count is only
right when the two smallest band primes divide `n` exactly once.  **The pointwise inequality is
false** (`merikoski_pointwise_fails`): with `Ps = {primes ≤ 20}`, `Y = 4`, `Z = 20`,
`n = 1925 = 5²·7·11` the left side is `0` and the right side is `1 - 3/2 + 0 = -1/2`.
Consequently Lemma 13 is **not** a consequence of positivity of the weight alone
(`merikoski_weighted_fails`: one parameter, weight `1`, `L_j = 2`, `L_ℓ = 1925`).

## Repair (kernel-checked)

* `chen_pointwise` — for **every** `n` (and `Y ≤ Z`):
  `1_{rough Z} ≤ 1_{rough Y} - ½ k 1_{rough Y} + ½ T₃ + ½ sq`.
* `chen_weighted` — for any finite parameter set, any **non-negative** weight `ν` (the only
  place positivity is used), and any two integer-valued maps `L_j, L_ℓ` with
  `L_ℓ(t)` prime `⇒ L_ℓ(t) > Z`:
  `S ≤ S₁ - ½ S₂ + ½ S₃ + ½ S_sq`.
* `affine_chen_weighted` — the specialisation to the fixed affine forms `L_i(t) = a_i t + 1`.
  Nothing about shifts, equal slopes, or the shape of the forms is used: the inequality is
  pointwise in the single integer `n = L_ℓ(t)`.

`S_sq` is a trivially negligible tail (`≪ X^{1-α+o(1)}`, see the written proof §5.4); it is a
separate, narrow analytic estimate (`AffineChenSquareTail` in `Providers.lean`).
-/

open scoped BigOperators
open Finset

namespace Erdos287.W2984Publication

/-- `(n, P_Ps(w)) = 1`. -/
def rough (Ps : Finset ℕ) (w n : ℕ) : Prop := ∀ p ∈ Ps, p ≤ w → ¬ p ∣ n

instance (Ps : Finset ℕ) (w n : ℕ) : Decidable (rough Ps w n) := by
  unfold rough; infer_instance

/-- Band primes `Y < p ≤ Z` of `Ps` dividing `n`. -/
def band (Ps : Finset ℕ) (Y Z n : ℕ) : Finset ℕ := Ps.filter (fun p => Y < p ∧ p ≤ Z ∧ p ∣ n)

/-- Merikoski's triple set: `Y < p < q < r ≤ Z`, `n = pqrs`, `(s, P_Ps(q)) = 1`. -/
def triples (Ps : Finset ℕ) (Y Z n : ℕ) : Finset (ℕ × ℕ × ℕ) :=
  (Ps ×ˢ Ps ×ˢ Ps).filter (fun x => Y < x.1 ∧ x.1 < x.2.1 ∧ x.2.1 < x.2.2 ∧ x.2.2 ≤ Z ∧
    x.1 * x.2.1 * x.2.2 ∣ n ∧ rough Ps x.2.1 (n / (x.1 * x.2.1 * x.2.2)))

/-- Non-squarefree correction `sq(n) = k(n) · #{p ∈ band : p² ∣ n}`. -/
def sqCorr (Ps : Finset ℕ) (Y Z n : ℕ) : ℕ :=
  (band Ps Y Z n).card * ((band Ps Y Z n).filter (fun p => p ^ 2 ∣ n)).card

/-- Indicator as a real number. -/
noncomputable def ind (P : Prop) [Decidable P] : ℝ := if P then 1 else 0

theorem ind_nonneg (P : Prop) [Decidable P] : 0 ≤ ind P := by unfold ind; split_ifs <;> norm_num

/-- Merikoski's literal right-hand side (no square correction). -/
noncomputable def chenRHSLiteral (Ps : Finset ℕ) (Y Z n : ℕ) : ℝ :=
  ind (rough Ps Y n) - 1/2 * (ind (rough Ps Y n) * (band Ps Y Z n).card) +
    1/2 * ((triples Ps Y Z n).card : ℝ)

/-- Corrected right-hand side. -/
noncomputable def chenRHS (Ps : Finset ℕ) (Y Z n : ℕ) : ℝ :=
  chenRHSLiteral Ps Y Z n + 1/2 * (sqCorr Ps Y Z n : ℝ)

section Pointwise

variable {Ps : Finset ℕ} {Y Z : ℕ}

theorem rough_mono {w w' n : ℕ} (h : w ≤ w') (hr : rough Ps w' n) : rough Ps w n :=
  fun p hp hpw => hr p hp (le_trans hpw h)

/-- Key counting step: if `n` is `Y`-rough, all band primes divide `n` exactly once and
`k ≥ 2`, then `T₃(n) ≥ k - 2`. -/
theorem card_triples_ge (hP : ∀ p ∈ Ps, p.Prime) {n : ℕ} (hY : rough Ps Y n)
    (hsf : ∀ p ∈ band Ps Y Z n, ¬ p ^ 2 ∣ n) (hk : 2 ≤ (band Ps Y Z n).card) :
    (band Ps Y Z n).card - 2 ≤ (triples Ps Y Z n).card := by
  set B := band Ps Y Z n with hB
  have hBne : B.Nonempty := card_pos.1 (by omega)
  set p₁ := B.min' hBne with hp₁
  have hp₁B : p₁ ∈ B := min'_mem B hBne
  have hB'card : (B.erase p₁).card = B.card - 1 := card_erase_of_mem hp₁B
  have hB'ne : (B.erase p₁).Nonempty := card_pos.1 (by omega)
  set p₂ := (B.erase p₁).min' hB'ne with hp₂
  have hp₂B' : p₂ ∈ B.erase p₁ := min'_mem _ hB'ne
  have hp₂B : p₂ ∈ B := mem_of_mem_erase hp₂B'
  have hp₁₂ : p₁ < p₂ := lt_of_le_of_ne (min'_le B p₂ hp₂B) (fun h => (ne_of_mem_erase hp₂B') h.symm)
  have hB''card : ((B.erase p₁).erase p₂).card = B.card - 2 := by
    rw [card_erase_of_mem hp₂B', hB'card]; omega
  have memB : ∀ {p}, p ∈ B → p ∈ Ps ∧ Y < p ∧ p ≤ Z ∧ p ∣ n := fun h => by
    rw [hB, band, mem_filter] at h; exact ⟨h.1, h.2.1, h.2.2.1, h.2.2.2⟩
  -- every band prime `≤ p₂` is `p₁` or `p₂`
  have small : ∀ p ∈ B, p ≤ p₂ → p = p₁ ∨ p = p₂ := by
    intro p hp hle
    by_cases h1 : p = p₁
    · exact Or.inl h1
    · right
      exact le_antisymm hle (min'_le _ p (mem_erase.2 ⟨h1, hp⟩))
  rw [← hB''card]
  refine card_le_card_of_injOn (fun r => (p₁, p₂, r)) ?_ ?_
  · intro r hr
    have hr' : r ∈ B.erase p₁ := mem_of_mem_erase hr
    have hrB : r ∈ B := mem_of_mem_erase hr'
    have hp₂r : p₂ < r := lt_of_le_of_ne (min'_le _ r hr') (fun h => (ne_of_mem_erase hr) h.symm)
    obtain ⟨h1P, h1Y, h1Z, h1n⟩ := memB hp₁B
    obtain ⟨h2P, -, h2Z, h2n⟩ := memB hp₂B
    obtain ⟨hrP, -, hrZ, hrn⟩ := memB hrB
    have pr1 := hP _ h1P
    have pr2 := hP _ h2P
    have prr := hP _ hrP
    have c12 : Nat.Coprime p₁ p₂ := (Nat.coprime_primes pr1 pr2).2 (ne_of_lt hp₁₂)
    have c1r : Nat.Coprime p₁ r := (Nat.coprime_primes pr1 prr).2 (by omega)
    have c2r : Nat.Coprime p₂ r := (Nat.coprime_primes pr2 prr).2 (ne_of_lt hp₂r)
    have hdiv : p₁ * p₂ * r ∣ n :=
      Nat.Coprime.mul_dvd_of_dvd_of_dvd (Nat.Coprime.mul_left c1r c2r)
        (Nat.Coprime.mul_dvd_of_dvd_of_dvd c12 h1n h2n) hrn
    simp only [coe_filter, triples, Set.mem_setOf_eq, mem_product]
    refine ⟨⟨h1P, h2P, hrP⟩, h1Y, hp₁₂, hp₂r, hrZ, hdiv, ?_⟩
    -- roughness of the cofactor below `p₂`
    intro p hp hle hps
    obtain ⟨s, hs⟩ := hdiv
    have hsn : n / (p₁ * p₂ * r) = s := by
      rw [hs]; exact Nat.mul_div_cancel_left s (by positivity [pr1.pos, pr2.pos, prr.pos])
    rw [hsn] at hps
    have hpn : p ∣ n := hs ▸ Dvd.dvd.mul_left hps _
    by_cases hpY : p ≤ Y
    · exact hY p hp hpY hpn
    · have hpB : p ∈ B := by
        rw [hB, band, mem_filter]; exact ⟨hp, by omega, le_trans hle h2Z, hpn⟩
      rcases small p hpB hle with rfl | rfl
      · apply hsf _ hp₁B
        rw [hs, pow_two, show p₁ * p₂ * r * s = p₁ * (p₂ * r * s) by ring]
        exact Nat.mul_dvd_mul_left _ (Dvd.dvd.mul_left hps _)
      · apply hsf _ hp₂B
        rw [hs, pow_two, show p₁ * p₂ * r * s = p₂ * (p₁ * r * s) by ring]
        exact Nat.mul_dvd_mul_left _ (Dvd.dvd.mul_left hps _)
  · intro a _ b _ h
    simp only [Prod.mk.injEq] at h
    exact h.2.2

/-- **Corrected Chen pointwise inequality** (all `n`, `Y ≤ Z`). -/
theorem chen_pointwise (hP : ∀ p ∈ Ps, p.Prime) (hYZ : Y ≤ Z) (n : ℕ) :
    ind (rough Ps Z n) ≤ chenRHS Ps Y Z n := by
  unfold chenRHS chenRHSLiteral
  have hT : (0 : ℝ) ≤ (triples Ps Y Z n).card := by positivity
  have hS : (0 : ℝ) ≤ (sqCorr Ps Y Z n : ℝ) := by positivity
  by_cases hY : rough Ps Y n
  · have hYi : ind (rough Ps Y n) = 1 := if_pos hY
    rw [hYi]
    set k := (band Ps Y Z n).card with hk
    by_cases hk0 : k = 0
    · -- `Z`-rough
      have hZ : rough Ps Z n := by
        intro p hp hpZ hpn
        by_cases hpY : p ≤ Y
        · exact hY p hp hpY hpn
        · have : p ∈ band Ps Y Z n := by
            rw [band, mem_filter]; exact ⟨hp, by omega, hpZ, hpn⟩
          rw [hk, card_eq_zero] at hk0
          rw [hk0] at this; simp at this
      have : ind (rough Ps Z n) = 1 := if_pos hZ
      rw [this, hk0]; push_cast; linarith
    · -- not `Z`-rough
      obtain ⟨p, hp⟩ : (band Ps Y Z n).Nonempty := card_pos.1 (by omega)
      have hnZ : ¬ rough Ps Z n := by
        rw [band, mem_filter] at hp
        exact fun h => h p hp.1 hp.2.2.1 hp.2.2.2
      have : ind (rough Ps Z n) = 0 := if_neg hnZ
      rw [this]
      by_cases hsq : ∃ q ∈ band Ps Y Z n, q ^ 2 ∣ n
      · obtain ⟨q, hq, hq2⟩ := hsq
        have h1 : 1 ≤ ((band Ps Y Z n).filter (fun p => p ^ 2 ∣ n)).card :=
          card_pos.2 ⟨q, mem_filter.2 ⟨hq, hq2⟩⟩
        have : (k : ℝ) ≤ sqCorr Ps Y Z n := by
          unfold sqCorr; rw [← hk]; push_cast
          have : (1 : ℝ) ≤ ((band Ps Y Z n).filter (fun p => p ^ 2 ∣ n)).card := by
            exact_mod_cast h1
          nlinarith [show (0 : ℝ) ≤ k by positivity]
        nlinarith
      · push_neg at hsq
        by_cases hk2 : 2 ≤ k
        · have := card_triples_ge hP hY hsq hk2
          have : (k : ℝ) - 2 ≤ (triples Ps Y Z n).card := by
            have h' : ((k - 2 : ℕ) : ℝ) ≤ (triples Ps Y Z n).card := by exact_mod_cast this
            rw [Nat.cast_sub hk2] at h'; push_cast at h'; exact h'
          nlinarith
        · have : (k : ℝ) ≤ 2 := by exact_mod_cast (by omega : k ≤ 2)
          nlinarith
  · have hYi : ind (rough Ps Y n) = 0 := if_neg hY
    have hZ : ind (rough Ps Z n) = 0 := if_neg (fun h => hY (rough_mono hYZ h))
    rw [hYi, hZ]
    nlinarith

end Pointwise

/-! ### Kernel-checked failure of the uncorrected pointwise inequality -/

/-- The sifting primes `≤ 20`. -/
def primesTo20 : Finset ℕ := {2, 3, 5, 7, 11, 13, 17, 19}

theorem primesTo20_prime : ∀ p ∈ primesTo20, p.Prime := by decide

/-- Triples live on band primes. -/
theorem triples_eq_band (Ps : Finset ℕ) (Y Z n : ℕ) :
    triples Ps Y Z n = (band Ps Y Z n ×ˢ band Ps Y Z n ×ˢ band Ps Y Z n).filter
      (fun x => Y < x.1 ∧ x.1 < x.2.1 ∧ x.2.1 < x.2.2 ∧ x.2.2 ≤ Z ∧
        x.1 * x.2.1 * x.2.2 ∣ n ∧ rough Ps x.2.1 (n / (x.1 * x.2.1 * x.2.2))) := by
  ext ⟨p, q, r⟩
  simp only [triples, band, mem_filter, mem_product]
  constructor
  · rintro ⟨⟨hp, hq, hr⟩, h1, h2, h3, h4, h5, h6⟩
    have hpn : p ∣ n := (dvd_mul_right p q).mul_right r |>.trans h5
    have hqn : q ∣ n := (dvd_mul_left q p).mul_right r |>.trans h5
    have hrn : r ∣ n := (dvd_mul_left r (p * q)).trans h5
    exact ⟨⟨⟨hp, h1, by omega, hpn⟩, ⟨hq, by omega, by omega, hqn⟩, ⟨hr, by omega, h4, hrn⟩⟩,
      h1, h2, h3, h4, h5, h6⟩
  · rintro ⟨⟨⟨hp, -⟩, ⟨hq, -⟩, ⟨hr, -⟩⟩, h⟩
    exact ⟨⟨hp, hq, hr⟩, h⟩

theorem band_1925 : band primesTo20 4 20 1925 = {5, 7, 11} := by decide

theorem fixture_1925 :
    rough primesTo20 4 1925 ∧ ¬ rough primesTo20 20 1925 ∧ (band primesTo20 4 20 1925).card = 3 ∧
      (triples primesTo20 4 20 1925).card = 0 := by
  refine ⟨by decide, by decide, by rw [band_1925]; rfl, ?_⟩
  rw [triples_eq_band, band_1925]
  decide

/-- **Audit: Merikoski's pointwise inequality (Lemma 13 proof) is false as stated.** -/
theorem merikoski_pointwise_fails :
    ¬ ∀ n : ℕ, ind (rough primesTo20 20 n) ≤ chenRHSLiteral primesTo20 4 20 n := by
  intro h
  have h1 := h 1925
  obtain ⟨h4, h20, hk, hT⟩ := fixture_1925
  unfold chenRHSLiteral ind at h1
  rw [if_neg h20, if_pos h4, hk, hT] at h1
  norm_num at h1

/-- **Audit: Lemma 13 does not follow from positivity of the weight alone.**  With one
parameter, weight `1`, `L_j = 2` (prime) and `L_ℓ = 1925`, the literal Chen combination is
`-1/2 < 0 = S`. -/
theorem merikoski_weighted_fails :
    ¬ (ind ((2 : ℕ).Prime ∧ (1925 : ℕ).Prime) ≤
        ind (Nat.Prime 2) * chenRHSLiteral primesTo20 4 20 1925) := by
  obtain ⟨h4, h20, hk, hT⟩ := fixture_1925
  have hn : ¬ (1925 : ℕ).Prime := by norm_num
  unfold chenRHSLiteral ind
  rw [if_neg (fun h => hn h.2), if_pos Nat.prime_two, if_pos h4, hk, hT]
  norm_num

/-! ### The weighted (summed) affine Chen decomposition -/

section Weighted

variable (Ps : Finset ℕ) (Y Z : ℕ) (T : Finset ℕ) (ν : ℕ → ℝ) (Lj Lℓ : ℕ → ℕ)

/-- `S = ∑ ν 1_P(L_j) 1_P(L_ℓ)`. -/
noncomputable def chenS : ℝ := ∑ t ∈ T, ν t * ind (Lj t).Prime * ind (Lℓ t).Prime

/-- `S₁ = ∑ ν 1_P(L_j) 1_{(L_ℓ, P(Y))=1}`. -/
noncomputable def chenS1 : ℝ := ∑ t ∈ T, ν t * ind (Lj t).Prime * ind (rough Ps Y (Lℓ t))

/-- `S₂ = ∑_{Y<p≤Z} ∑ ν 1_P(L_j) 1_{p ∣ L_ℓ} 1_{(L_ℓ,P(Y))=1}`. -/
noncomputable def chenS2 : ℝ :=
  ∑ t ∈ T, ν t * ind (Lj t).Prime * (ind (rough Ps Y (Lℓ t)) * (band Ps Y Z (Lℓ t)).card)

/-- `S₃ = ∑ ν 1_P(L_j) ∑_{Y<p<q<r≤Z} ∑_{(s,P(q))=1} 1_{L_ℓ = pqrs}`. -/
noncomputable def chenS3 : ℝ :=
  ∑ t ∈ T, ν t * ind (Lj t).Prime * ((triples Ps Y Z (Lℓ t)).card : ℝ)

/-- Non-squarefree tail `S_sq = ∑ ν 1_P(L_j) sq(L_ℓ)`. -/
noncomputable def chenSsq : ℝ :=
  ∑ t ∈ T, ν t * ind (Lj t).Prime * (sqCorr Ps Y Z (Lℓ t) : ℝ)

/-- **Weighted Chen decomposition.**  Positivity of `ν` is used exactly once: to multiply the
pointwise inequality by `ν(t) 1_P(L_j(t)) ≥ 0`. -/
theorem chen_weighted (hP : ∀ p ∈ Ps, p.Prime) (hYZ : Y ≤ Z) (hν : ∀ t ∈ T, 0 ≤ ν t)
    (hbig : ∀ t ∈ T, (Lℓ t).Prime → Z < Lℓ t) :
    chenS T ν Lj Lℓ ≤ chenS1 Ps Y T ν Lj Lℓ - 1/2 * chenS2 Ps Y Z T ν Lj Lℓ +
      1/2 * chenS3 Ps Y Z T ν Lj Lℓ + 1/2 * chenSsq Ps Y Z T ν Lj Lℓ := by
  unfold chenS chenS1 chenS2 chenS3 chenSsq
  rw [Finset.mul_sum, Finset.mul_sum, Finset.mul_sum, ← Finset.sum_sub_distrib,
    ← Finset.sum_add_distrib, ← Finset.sum_add_distrib]
  apply Finset.sum_le_sum
  intro t ht
  have hw : 0 ≤ ν t * ind (Lj t).Prime := mul_nonneg (hν t ht) (ind_nonneg _)
  -- `1_P(L_ℓ) ≤ 1_{rough Z}(L_ℓ)`
  have hprime : ind (Lℓ t).Prime ≤ ind (rough Ps Z (Lℓ t)) := by
    unfold ind
    by_cases hp : (Lℓ t).Prime
    · have hr : rough Ps Z (Lℓ t) := by
        intro p hpPs hpZ hpd
        have := (Nat.prime_dvd_prime_iff_eq (hP p hpPs) hp).1 hpd
        have := hbig t ht hp
        omega
      rw [if_pos hp, if_pos hr]
    · rw [if_neg hp]; split_ifs <;> norm_num
  have key := le_trans hprime (chen_pointwise hP hYZ (Lℓ t))
  have := mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left key hw
  unfold chenRHS chenRHSLiteral at this
  linarith

/-- **Affine Chen decomposition** for the fixed affine forms `L_i(t) = a_i t + 1`. -/
theorem affine_chen_weighted (aj aℓ : ℕ) (hP : ∀ p ∈ Ps, p.Prime) (hYZ : Y ≤ Z)
    (hν : ∀ t ∈ T, 0 ≤ ν t) (hbig : ∀ t ∈ T, Z < aℓ * t + 1) :
    chenS T ν (fun t => aj * t + 1) (fun t => aℓ * t + 1) ≤
      chenS1 Ps Y T ν (fun t => aj * t + 1) (fun t => aℓ * t + 1) -
        1/2 * chenS2 Ps Y Z T ν (fun t => aj * t + 1) (fun t => aℓ * t + 1) +
        1/2 * chenS3 Ps Y Z T ν (fun t => aj * t + 1) (fun t => aℓ * t + 1) +
        1/2 * chenSsq Ps Y Z T ν (fun t => aj * t + 1) (fun t => aℓ * t + 1) :=
  chen_weighted Ps Y Z T ν _ _ hP hYZ hν (fun t ht _ => hbig t ht)

end Weighted

end Erdos287.W2984Publication
